chaeldar.name: Chaeldar
notes: Combat level requirement can be bypassed by showing a Slayer cape (99 Slayer).
Commonly assigns tasks of 110-170 kills.
Reachable only via a fairy ring to Zanaris or the Lumbridge Swamp shed while wielding a dramen or lunar staff.

duradel.name: Duradel
notes: Replaced by Kuradal, his daughter, after the events of While Guthix Sleeps; Kuradal has the same requirements and assigns the identical task list.
The only master with a Slayer level requirement; the combat level requirement (but not Slayer 50) can be bypassed by showing a Slayer cape.
Shilo Village quest completion is needed to enter Shilo Village; Karamja gloves 4 teleport directly to him.
Assigns very similar tasks to Nieve but in slightly higher quantities.
Reached via the ladder in the fishing shop south of the river - he cannot be accessed from the north bank.

konar.name: Konar quo Maten
notes: Assigns a specific location alongside each monster; kills only count toward the task in that location.
Never assigns Wilderness locations (outside of boss Slayer) - those belong to Krystilia.
Task monsters can drop brimstone keys (drop rates similar to Larran's keys) for the brimstone chest beside her.
Offers the most points per task outside the Wilderness - more than Duradel.
Combat level requirement can be bypassed by showing a Slayer cape (99 Slayer).

krystilia.name: Krystilia
notes: All tasks must be completed within the Wilderness.
Has no combat or Slayer level requirement and ignores the player's combat level, so she can assign monsters of any level.
Task monsters can drop Larran's keys (rate scales with monster combat level) for Larran's small or big chest.
The free 'I Wildy More Slayer' reward toggle controls whether she can assign jellies, dust devils, nechryael, and abyssal demons; toggling it off removes only those four tasks from her list.

Assignments run a separate task-completion counter from standard masters: the first four completions on that counter award no points, and resetting one of those early assignments restarts the counter.
Cannot assign a new task while the player holds an incomplete task from a standard master.
Highest points per task of any master, at the cost of the separate Wilderness streak.
Found by the jailhouse in Edgeville, north-east of the bank.

mazchna.name: Mazchna
notes: Temporarily replaced by Achtryn during the events of While Guthix Sleeps.
Base points were raised from 2 to 6 in the Summer Sweep Up update (27 August 2025).
Combat level requirement can be bypassed by showing a Slayer cape (99 Slayer).
Tasks are relatively easy and short; located north-east of Canifis.

mortimer.name: Mortimer
requirements: Fallen From Grace (partial completion for Wyrmscraig Cavern access)
notes: Offers two tasks, increasing to three choices after completing 50 Mortimer tasks.
Assigns tasks with superior variants. Venators are assigned directly only by Mortimer.
Slayer points are awarded only with the point modifier; the default task gives no points.
Task modifiers can change quantity, points, clue rates, superior rewards, and Slayer experience.
Skipping costs 100 points and there are only two block slots. Turael cannot replace Mortimer tasks.
Mortimer maintains a separate task streak. Combat requirement can be bypassed by showing a Slayer cape at 99 Slayer.

nieve.name: Nieve
notes: Replaced by Steve after the events of Monkey Madness II; Steve assigns the identical task list.
Combat level requirement can be bypassed by showing a Slayer cape (99 Slayer).
Located by the Stronghold Slayer Cave entrance near the Tree Gnome Stronghold's southern bank; a Slayer ring teleports directly there.

spria.name: Spria
notes: Turael's daughter; assigns the same task list as Turael plus sourhogs, which no other master assigns.
Cannot change a task from another master into an easier one - she directs players to Turael/Aya for that - so unlike Turael she never resets the task streak.
Completed tasks award no points but still count toward the four completions needed before points start accruing, and they advance the streak toward milestone bonuses.
Block list is shared with Turael/Aya.
Tasks she assigns cannot be skipped through Turael.

turael.name: Turael
notes: Replaced by Aya, his sister, during and after While Guthix Sleeps; Aya assigns the identical task list.
Can replace a task assigned by another master with an easier one, but only if the current task is not one Turael himself assigns; accepting the replacement resets the task streak to zero.
Cannot reassign a task that he (or Aya) gave out.
Completed tasks award no points but still count toward the four completions needed before points start accruing, and they advance the streak toward the 10th/50th/100th/250th/1000th milestone bonuses.
Block list is shared with Spria and Aya.
Asking Turael or Aya for a new assignment reveals the current streak count when the held task is not one they assign; confirming the dialogue takes the replacement and resets the streak.

vannaka.name: Vannaka
notes: Base points were raised from 4 to 8 in the Summer Sweep Up update (27 August 2025).
Combat level requirement can be bypassed by showing a Slayer cape (99 Slayer).
Commonly assigns tasks of 60-120 kills and can assign difficult monsters such as abyssal demons.
Located in Edgeville Dungeon east of the Wilderness gate; entering via the Cooks' Guild entrance requires a brass key.

aberrant-spectres.name: Aberrant spectres
notes: A nose peg or Slayer helmet is required; without one, aberrant spectres use a special attack that hits through protection prayers and rapidly drains stats.
Aberrant spectres use a normal magic attack with max hit 8; Protect from Magic fully neutralizes it.
Abhorrent spectres have max hit 33; Protect from Magic still prevents their normal damage.
Deviant and Repugnant spectres also require a nose peg or Slayer helmet, and Protect from Magic negates their damage.
Aberrant spectres are undead, so Salve amulet variants work, but Salve does not stack with Slayer helmet and the Slayer helmet is usually preferred.
Aberrant spectres are popular for herb drops; bring a herb sack and consider a Seed box.
A cannon can be used in the Stronghold Slayer Cave and Deepfin Mine, but those locations are not multicombat and safespotting is needed to cannon more than one at a time.
Aberrant spectres killed in the Slayer Tower benefit from Morytania Diary Slayer experience bonuses.
Aberrant spectres have the Spectral attribute, so carrying an Ectoplasmator gives a small amount of Prayer experience per kill.

Wear a nose peg or Slayer helmet. Use Protect from Magic. Use Stronghold Slayer Cave or Deepfin Mine for cannoning, Slayer Tower for Morytania Diary XP, or Catacombs for Deviant spectres and Dark totem drops. Bring a herb sack.

slayer-tower.name: Slayer Tower
notes: Bloodvelds on the first floor can be safespotted and receive additional Slayer experience from completed Morytania Diary tiers; other Slayer Tower tasks may have different floor-specific mechanics.
Fairy ring CKS is beside the Slayer Tower (needs a Dramen or Lunar staff).
Can be safespotted using walls, brick piles, or suits of armour to block movement.
Keep a distance of 6 tiles to avoid their attack range.
Can provide increased Slayer experience per kill from Morytania Diary completion.

stronghold-slayer-cave.name: Stronghold Slayer Cave
notes: Bloodvelds here are close to Nieve, support a dwarf multicannon, and can be safespotted. Use a Slayer ring, Spirit tree to Tree Gnome Stronghold, or necklace of passage to Outpost. Hellhounds here are the primary non-Wilderness task option, with 13 spawns across four rooms of three or four Hellhounds, cannon support, and safespots.
Slayer ring teleports directly to the Stronghold Slayer Cave.
Can be safespotted after the NPC aggression timer has run out.

catacombs-of-kourend.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: Black demons here can be safespotted and give access to Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces, but their higher Defence makes them an inefficient Black demons task option. Mutated bloodvelds appear in three groups, can be safespotted, and use the Catacombs drop table including ancient shards and dark totem pieces. Brutal blue dragons here are safespottable, cannot be cannoned, and can drop ancient shards and Dark totem parts. Hellhounds here are multicombat, safespottable, cannot be cannoned, and can reset aggression by running south and up the vine to the Giants' Den.
Xeric's Heart (Xeric's talisman) is beside the Catacombs entrance.
Deviant spectres can be safespotted from north of the western Catacombs spawns.
Deviant and Repugnant spectres have access to Catacombs drops including Dark totem pieces.

deepfin-mine.name: Deepfin Mine
notes: Aberrant spectres can be safespotted from the eastern side near the standing torch. A bank chest can be built in a Deepfin Mine hotspot, and quick access uses an 84 Agility shortcut.
Can be safespotted from the eastern side near the standing torch.
A bank chest can be built in a hotspot within the Deepfin Mine.
A shortcut requiring 84 Agility gives quick access.

abyssal-demons.name: Abyssal demons
notes: Abyssal demons use accurate melee stab attacks with a max hit of 8; Protect from Melee neutralizes normal Abyssal demon damage.
Greater abyssal demons can spawn after Bigger and Badder, have a max hit of 27, teleport around the player, and always land a hit after teleporting if not prayed against.
Teleport anchoring scroll is highly recommended because it prevents Abyssal demons from teleporting the player up to 20 tiles away.
If the player has not read a Teleport anchoring scroll, Auto Retaliate helps resume attacking after being teleported.

Demonbane weaponry works because Abyssal demons are demons: Arclight, Emberlight, Scorching bow, and Demonbane spells receive their relevant bonuses, though AoE magic or Venator bow methods are usually preferred for experience.
Extend Abyssal demon tasks with Augment my abbies because they can provide very high Slayer experience.
Abyssal whip is a 1/512 drop and Abyssal dagger is an extremely rare drop.
Ensouled abyssal heads appear several times per task, making Soul bearer useful; herb sack and Explorer's ring 4 help with herbs and alchables.
Players on Abyssal demon tasks may kill Abyssal Sire instead for profit, accepting significantly lower Slayer experience rates than regular Abyssal demons.

Use Catacombs magic for high Slayer experience: tag or goad Abyssal demons, stack them, and cast Smoke Barrage or Smoke Burst with Protect from Melee. Venator bow is a lower-attention ranged alternative. Wilderness Slayer Cave supports cannon plus Accursed sceptre but carries PK risk. Use Emberlight or Arclight for single-combat melee or Slayer Tower tasks.
requirements: Priest in Peril or Fairytale II - Cure a Queen

abyssal-area.name: Abyssal Area
notes: Fairy ring ALR. Inefficient outside Konar tasks because of other aggressive abyssal creatures and distant spawns.
Not efficient due to aggressive abyssal creatures and distant spawns, except for Konar tasks.
Ensouled heads dropped here can be reanimated for slightly faster task progression.

catacombs-of-kourend.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: Black demons here can be safespotted and give access to Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces, but their higher Defence makes them an inefficient Black demons task option. Mutated bloodvelds appear in three groups, can be safespotted, and use the Catacombs drop table including ancient shards and dark totem pieces. Brutal blue dragons here are safespottable, cannot be cannoned, and can drop ancient shards and Dark totem parts. Hellhounds here are multicombat, safespottable, cannot be cannoned, and can reset aggression by running south and up the vine to the Giants' Den.
Xeric's Heart (Xeric's talisman) is beside the Catacombs entrance.
Multi-combat area allows barraging in the primary rooms and more AFK play in both primary and secondary rooms.
Catacombs kills can drop Dark totem pieces; Greater abyssal demons in the Catacombs always drop a Dark totem piece.

slayer-tower.name: Slayer Tower
notes: Bloodvelds on the first floor can be safespotted and receive additional Slayer experience from completed Morytania Diary tiers; other Slayer Tower tasks may have different floor-specific mechanics.
Fairy ring CKS is beside the Slayer Tower (needs a Dramen or Lunar staff).
Very far to reach without 71 Agility; use the basement for Slayer tasks when possible.
Morytania Diary completion grants bonus Slayer experience in the Slayer Tower.

slayer-tower-basement.name: Slayer Tower Basement
notes: Task-only basement. Gargoyles can only be killed here while on a Slayer task and Raulyn stops off-task attacks; the Gargoyles task page lists 12 spawns and safespot support. Safespotting requires the Teleport anchoring scroll permanent unlock for Abyssal demons. Bloodveld access is task-only, can be reached from the tower with a Slayer ring route, and may be less busy.
Fairy ring CKS by the Slayer Tower, then descend to the basement (needs a Dramen or Lunar staff).
Task only. Safespot requires the Teleport anchoring scroll permanent unlock.

wilderness-slayer-cave.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: Level 18-22 Wilderness Hellhound area is multicombat, cannonable, safespottable, and fast with Wilderness weapons. The cave is a popular player killing hotspot; stand as far south as practical to stay near one-click teleport range, and do not risk items you are unwilling to lose.
Ring of dueling to Ferox Enclave, then run north into the cave.
Level 29-32 Wilderness and task only.
Only Abyssal demon location where a cannon can be used.
Includes blighted item drops and Last Man Standing reward-shop drops.

ankou.name: Ankou
notes: Ankou require 40 combat to be assigned and have no Slayer level or quest requirement.
Ankou attack with relatively inaccurate melee and a max hit from 8 to 10; Protect from Melee negates all damage.
Ankou are undead, so Salve amulet variants can boost accuracy and damage.
Salve amulet bonuses do not stack with Slayer helmet or Black mask; use the better option for the player's stats and gear.
Unextended tasks are fast even with melee in single combat.
In multicombat areas such as Catacombs of Kourend and Wilderness Slayer Cave, Burst spells, Barrage spells, and Venator bow can be viable, but even extended tasks are consumed quickly.
Salve necklace effects do not apply to secondary monsters hit by area-of-effect spells.
Cannon may be used against Ankou in all listed locations except the Catacombs of Kourend.
Typical tasks yield dozens of Death runes and Blood runes; Catacombs kills can also drop Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces.

Ankou are Spectral creatures, so Ectoplasmator grants Prayer experience; they also drop bones, so Bonecrusher or Bonecrusher necklace adds Prayer experience and restores one Prayer point per Catacombs kill.
In Wilderness locations, minimise risk and carry a one-click teleport usable in the 20-30 Wilderness range, such as a Royal seed pod.

Use melee for quick single-combat tasks, especially Stronghold of Security or Stronghold Slayer Cave. For Catacombs or Wilderness Slayer Cave, Burst/Barrage or Venator bow can clear tasks very quickly. Use cannon anywhere except Catacombs, and treat Wilderness locations as PK hotspots requiring low risk and a one-click teleport.

catacombs-of-kourend.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: Black demons here can be safespotted and give access to Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces, but their higher Defence makes them an inefficient Black demons task option. Mutated bloodvelds appear in three groups, can be safespotted, and use the Catacombs drop table including ancient shards and dark totem pieces. Brutal blue dragons here are safespottable, cannot be cannoned, and can drop ancient shards and Dark totem parts. Hellhounds here are multicombat, safespottable, cannot be cannoned, and can reset aggression by running south and up the vine to the Giants' Den.
Xeric's Heart (Xeric's talisman) is beside the Catacombs entrance.
Bonecrusher helps keep Prayer topped up because burying bones in the Catacombs returns Prayer points.
Ankou in the Catacombs can drop Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces.

stronghold-of-security.name: Stronghold of Security
notes: Ankou safespot is in the Sepulchre of Death south-west room, on the south side of the south-easternmost skeleton.
Amulet of glory to Edgeville, then run west to the Stronghold of Security under Barbarian Village.
Safespot in the south-west room by standing on the south side of the south-easternmost skeleton.

stronghold-slayer-cave.name: Stronghold Slayer Cave
notes: Bloodvelds here are close to Nieve, support a dwarf multicannon, and can be safespotted. Use a Slayer ring, Spirit tree to Tree Gnome Stronghold, or necklace of passage to Outpost. Hellhounds here are the primary non-Wilderness task option, with 13 spawns across four rooms of three or four Hellhounds, cannon support, and safespots.
Slayer ring teleports directly to the Stronghold Slayer Cave.
May be crowded due to easy access and cannon allowance.

wilderness-slayer-cave.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: Level 18-22 Wilderness Hellhound area is multicombat, cannonable, safespottable, and fast with Wilderness weapons. The cave is a popular player killing hotspot; stand as far south as practical to stay near one-click teleport range, and do not risk items you are unwilling to lose.
Ring of dueling to Ferox Enclave, then run north into the cave.
Expect PKers, lower risk, and bring a one-click level-30 Wilderness teleport such as a Royal seed pod.
Ankou in the Wilderness Slayer Cave straddle level 20 Wilderness.

forgotten-cemetery.name: The Forgotten Cemetery
notes: Wilderness Ankou location straddling level 30 Wilderness. Safespot behind the south-west coffin on the square between the bone spawns; bring a one-click teleport such as a Royal seed pod.
Safespot is behind the south-west coffin, on the square between the bone spawns.
Ankou in the Forgotten Cemetery straddle level 30 Wilderness.

aquanites.name: Aquanites
notes: Aquanites require 78 Slayer to kill and no combat level requirement.
Mooring at Ynysdail requires 73 Sailing; the first trip must be sailed with an adamant keel or better, entering through the green portal east of Lledrith Island.
Nieve and Duradel assign Aquanites only after the Lured In unlock (80 Slayer reward points); Mortimer can assign them without it.
Nieve assigns 40-60, Duradel 30-50 and Mortimer 40-60 Aquanites.
Let's Stay All Aquanite (100 points) extends Aquanite assignments to 150-200.
Mortimer's quantity modifier adds 50-100 Aquanites (90-160, or 200-300 when extended).
Aquanites drop the Aquanite tendon (1/3500, or 1/750 on task), used to make the Aquanite hopper.
Aquanites attack with Magic and have high accuracy, so Protect from Magic is highly recommended.
Aquanites can be safespotted with a 9 or 10 tile attack range.
Aquanites are in single-way combat, and a Dwarf multicannon cannot be used because the ground is too damp.
A slash attack severs the Aquanite lure, reducing stab Defence by 50 from 60 to 10; damage is not required, but the attack option must be set to slash.
Use a fast 4-tick slash weapon such as a scimitar or Abyssal whip to sever the lure before using stab weapons, or swap a two-style weapon such as the Ghrazi rapier between slash and stab.
Saradomin godsword special attack can sever the lure if no other special attack weapon is brought.
Elder aquanites can spawn at 1/200 on task after Bigger and Badder (1/150 with the elite Combat Achievements); flick Protect from Magic to avoid their prayer-disabling special, which hits up to 50.
For first-time access, sail manually to Ynysdail and build the rowboat hotspot.
Building the rowboat requires 50 Construction, hammer, saw, 10 swamp paste, and 8 camphor planks (the Rowboat amenity recipe; the Slayer task page states 70).
After the rowboat is built, travel is possible between Ynysdail and north of Gwenith (teleport to Prifddinas and exit north); using that rowboat requires Song of the Elves.
Without the rowboat or a greater teleport focus on the ship, returning may require resetting the ship to a mooring point.

Use Protect from Magic. For melee, sever the Aquanite lure with a slash attack from Abyssal whip, a scimitar or a weapon set to slash, then use strong stab or high-DPS melee such as Soulreaper axe, Scythe of Vitur, Ghrazi rapier, Osmumten's fang, Blade of Saeldor or Voidwaker. For ranged, use Toxic blowpipe or Twisted bow, Bow of Faerdhinen or Zaryte crossbow; a 9-10 tile safespot is available. Flick Protect from Magic against Elder aquanites.

aquanite-cavern-sailing.name: Ynysdail Cavern
notes: Ynysdail Cavern beneath Ynysdail, north of Gwenith; the only Aquanite location (16 spawns). Mooring at Ynysdail requires 73 Sailing, and the first trip must be sailed with an adamant keel or better. Build the Ynysdail rowboat (50 Construction) to travel between Ynysdail and north of Gwenith afterwards; using it requires Song of the Elves.
Teleport crystal to Prifddinas (Song of the Elves), exit north and take the Ynysdail rowboat north of Gwenith once it is built; otherwise sail to Ynysdail with an adamant keel or better.
Aquanites are found only in Ynysdail Cavern beneath Ynysdail (16 spawns).
The area is single-way combat.
A Dwarf multicannon cannot be used because the ground is too damp.
Aquanites can be safespotted with a 9 or 10 tile attack range.

araxytes.name: Araxytes
notes: Araxytes require 92 Slayer to harm and Priest in Peril to be assigned directly by Nieve or Duradel.
Turael/Aya and Spria can assign Araxytes indirectly as a spiders task.
Araxytes are found exclusively in the Morytania Spider Cave.
Araxytes attack with melee and can inflict venom starting at 6 damage.
Bring venom immunity to all encounters, preferably extended anti-venom+ for long trips.
A spider cave teleport brings players to the cave entrance, but the cave is still far from a bank.
Avoid killing level 96 araxytes during normal tasks because their drop table is worse and they cannot spawn Dreadborn Araxytes.
Level 146 araxytes should be used for normal tasks because they can spawn the superior.
Dreadborn Araxyte is the superior and can only spawn from level 146 araxytes.
Normal Araxyte tasks are profitable due to stackable and alchemy drops.
Use a seed box and herb sack to reduce banking.
Picking up Araxyte venom sacks is especially valuable.
A dwarf multicannon can be used throughout the cave and kills araxytes quickly in multicombat areas.
Combine cannon with Venator bow because the larger level 146 araxytes have 2x2 hitboxes, making barrages less useful.
Barrages can be used on 1x1 level 96 araxytes, but they should generally be avoided.
Bracelets of slaughter can extend profitable tasks.
Araxxor can be killed as part of an Araxyte task for more profit at much slower task completion; a strong crush weapon is highly recommended for Araxxor.

Use level 146 araxytes, avoid level 96 araxytes, bring extended anti-venom+, seed box, herb sack, and bracelets of slaughter. Cannon plus Venator bow is the main fast normal-task method in multicombat areas. Kill Araxxor instead only when choosing profit over task speed and bring a strong crush weapon.

araxyte-lair-morytania.name: Araxyte Lair (Morytania)
notes: Morytania Spider Cave. Contains normal Araxytes and the Araxxor boss; spider cave teleport reaches the cave entrance.
Amount: A lot.
Also contains the boss Araxxor.
The main chamber mixes level 96 and level 146 araxytes.
Three on-task caves are east of the main chamber: north is single-way with level 146 araxytes, east is multi-way with level 96 araxytes, and south is multi-way with level 146 araxytes.

aviansie.name: Aviansie
notes: Aviansie assignments require completion of Death Plateau, access to the God Wars Dungeon, and the Watch the birdie unlock.
Watch the birdie requires 60 Agility or 60 Strength to unlock.
Aviansie can be found in the normal God Wars Dungeon and the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon.
As followers of Armadyl, Armadylean God-aligned items are required to make them tolerant.
Aviansie will attack players if attacked even while they are in combat with another monster.
Their flying height means they can only be harmed with ranged and magic, although salamanders and halberds are direct-target exceptions.
Aviansie drops mostly revolve around adamantite bars, runite limbs, ensouled aviansie heads, and poisoned rune daggers.
God Wars Dungeon Aviansie only drop noted adamantite bars after the Hard Fremennik Diary.
Wilderness God Wars Dungeon Aviansie drop noted adamantite bars regardless of diary completion but add player-killing risk.
Kree'arra and his bodyguards can be killed as alternatives for an Aviansie task.
Armadylean spiritual warrior, spiritual ranger, and spiritual mage kills do not count as Aviansie task alternatives.
Aviansie are usually toggled off unless killing Kree'arra because the regular task is generally unpopular.
At Kree'arra, bring an emergency teleport and consider banking at Nex after gathering Zarosian kill count.
Use an ecumenical key to avoid wasting time on Armadyl kill count when killing Kree'arra.
Accessing Kree'arra requires two extra inventory slots for a crossbow that can fire a mith grapple.
With max mage gear, an Eldritch nightmare staff, and optional Lightbearer, full Aviansie tasks can often be completed at Kree'arra without banking.
Reanimated aviansie can be killed as an alternative, but ensouled aviansie heads can be troublesome to obtain.

Range or mage regular Aviansie in God Wars Dungeon after Watch the birdie, wearing Armadyl-aligned protection. Use Wilderness God Wars Dungeon only when accepting player-killing risk. Kill Kree'arra instead when choosing boss profit over normal task completion.

god-wars-dungeon-armadyl.name: God Wars Dungeon (Armadyl)
requirements: God Wars Dungeon Armadyl killcount or valid entry bypass
notes: Requires Death Plateau and God Wars Dungeon access. Armadyl-aligned protection is required to make Aviansie tolerant; Kree'arra access also needs 70 Ranged, a crossbow, and a mith grapple.
Aviansie are considered Armadylean followers.

wilderness-god-wars-dungeon.name: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon
notes: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon is a multicombat Wilderness area with player killing risk. Aviansie drop noted adamantite bars regardless of Fremennik Diary completion. Bloodveld access is closer through the Trollheim Agility shortcut with 64 Agility; God Wars followers are aggressive without god item protection. Cannon nuance: a cannon can physically be set up but GWD inhabitants may destroy it (Dwarf multicannon pageid 13551); wiki task tables split on the verdict, so trust the per-task row here.
Multicombat area and player killing make this a very dangerous location.

bandits.name: Bandits
notes: Bandits are assigned only by Krystilia and must be killed in the Wilderness to count; there is no combat, Slayer or quest requirement.
slayerTargetId 252 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract: 252 + worklist index); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
This task refers to the Wilderness Bandit Camp bandits (level 22 and level 130) east of the Ruins, NOT the Kharidian Desert or Pollnivneach bandits, which do not count.
The bandits are aggressive to all players; take caution when approaching the camp.
Their defensive bonuses are negligible, so any accurate melee weapon works well; magic and ranged are also viable given zero magic/ranged defence.
No task extension unlock exists for Bandits.

Kill the aggressive Wilderness Bandit Camp bandits (level 22 and level 130) with any accurate melee weapon; their defensive bonuses are negligible. Bring Wilderness-appropriate risk gear as the camp is deep in a PvP zone.

bandit-camp-wilderness.name: Bandit Camp (Wilderness)
notes: The Bandit Camp east of the Ruins in the Wilderness (around level 14-20) holds the level 22 and level 130 bandits assigned by Krystilia. The bandits are aggressive to all players, so approach with caution. This is a PvP zone; bring Wilderness-appropriate risk gear. The Slayer task/Bandits location table (pageid 298779) lists the Wilderness Bandit Camp as multi-combat and cannonable (not safespottable).
The Bandit Camp east of the Ruins holds both the level 22 and level 130 bandits.
Bandits are aggressive; approach with caution.
Multicombat area where a cannon can be set up; this location is well populated.

wilderness-slayer-cave.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: Level 18-22 Wilderness Hellhound area is multicombat, cannonable, safespottable, and fast with Wilderness weapons. The cave is a popular player killing hotspot; stand as far south as practical to stay near one-click teleport range, and do not risk items you are unwilling to lose.
Ring of dueling to Ferox Enclave, then run north into the cave.
Only a single level 130 bandit spawns here, so it is not recommended.
Multicombat area where a cannon can be set up.

banshees.name: Banshees
notes: Banshees require 15 Slayer, 20 combat, and Priest in Peril to be assigned by Turael, Spria, or Mazchna.
slayerTargetId 275 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
Earmuffs (ItemID 4166) or a Slayer helmet must be worn, or each Banshee scream deals 6 damage and greatly drains Attack, Strength, Defence, Ranged, Magic, Prayer, and Agility.
Banshees are undead and spectral: the salve amulet and Crumble Undead apply.
Banshees have a 30% elemental weakness to air spells (Twisted Banshee 25%).
The standard Banshee (level 23) is on the Slayer Tower ground floor; the Twisted Banshee (level 89, 69 Slayer to harm) is in the Catacombs of Kourend and regenerates 1 HP per attack.
No task extension unlock exists for Banshees.

Wear earmuffs or a Slayer helmet, then kill the ground-floor Banshees with any melee weapon; their low Defence makes weapon choice unimportant. Air spells exploit the 30% elemental weakness for a magic alternative. Higher-level players assigned Twisted Banshees in the Catacombs should still wear earmuffs and out-damage the 1 HP-per-attack regeneration.

slayer-tower.name: Slayer Tower
notes: Bloodvelds on the first floor can be safespotted and receive additional Slayer experience from completed Morytania Diary tiers; other Slayer Tower tasks may have different floor-specific mechanics.
Fairy ring CKS is beside the Slayer Tower (needs a Dramen or Lunar staff).
8 standard Banshees spawn on the eastern side of the ground floor.
Cannon cannot be placed anywhere in the Slayer Tower (prohibited area).
Wear earmuffs or a Slayer helmet to avoid the 6-damage stat-draining scream.

catacombs-of-kourend.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: Black demons here can be safespotted and give access to Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces, but their higher Defence makes them an inefficient Black demons task option. Mutated bloodvelds appear in three groups, can be safespotted, and use the Catacombs drop table including ancient shards and dark totem pieces. Brutal blue dragons here are safespottable, cannot be cannoned, and can drop ancient shards and Dark totem parts. Hellhounds here are multicombat, safespottable, cannot be cannoned, and can reset aggression by running south and up the vine to the Giants' Den.
Xeric's Heart (Xeric's talisman) is beside the Catacombs entrance.
6 Twisted Banshee spawns; requires 69 Slayer to harm them.
Cannon cannot be placed in the Catacombs of Kourend (prohibited area).

basilisks.name: Basilisks
notes: Basilisks require 40 Slayer, 40 combat, and 20 Defence to be assigned.
Vannaka and Chaeldar can assign ordinary Basilisks before the high-level master unlock.
Konar, Nieve, and Duradel require the Basilocked unlock before assigning Basilisks.
Ordinary basilisks are found in Fremennik Slayer Dungeon and Jormungand's Prison.
Ordinary basilisks attack only with an extremely inaccurate melee attack with a max hit of 5.
Ordinary basilisks have a thin drop table and high Defence, making them generally worthwhile to skip but not worth blocking because of low weighting.
A mirror shield or V's shield must be equipped against any basilisk.
Without a mirror shield or V's shield, the basilisk gaze deals immense damage and massively drains player stats.
After The Fremennik Exiles, players gain access to Basilisk Knights in Jormungand's Prison.
Basilisk Knights give basilisk tasks a new purpose for obtaining the Neitiznot faceguard through the Basilisk jaw.
Basilisk Knights use melee and magic, each with a max hit of 20.
Basilisk Knights match the player's attack speed with a maximum frequency of four ticks.
At distance, Basilisk Knights exclusively use magic while trying to move into melee range.
Protection prayers can block either Basilisk Knight melee or magic attacks, but not both simultaneously.
Basilisk jaw drop rate is 1/5000 off task and 1/1000 on task.
Basilisk Knight tasks are slow because of high Defence, with a maximum possible kill rate of about 100 per hour.
The Basilocked unlock can be toggled off after receiving a jaw, but reactivating it costs Slayer points.
Ordinary basilisks can spawn Monstrous basilisk after Bigger and Badder.
Basilisk Knights can spawn Basilisk Sentinel after Bigger and Badder.
Basilisk Sentinel launches a slow-moving projectile; move one tile to avoid it or click rapidly to escape stone before taking massive damage.
Basilisk Knights frequently drop alchable equipment, catalytic runes, and occasional high-level herbs.
Cannons cannot be placed anywhere with any kind of basilisk.

Use a mirror shield or V's shield for every basilisk. Ordinary basilisks are simple melee safespot tasks but are usually skips. After The Fremennik Exiles, kill Basilisk Knights for Basilisk jaw chance, using melee for speed or ranged safespots for lower damage.

fremennik-slayer-dungeon.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
notes: Contains standard Basilisks. A mirror shield or V's shield is required to avoid basilisk gaze damage and stat drain.
Slayer ring teleports to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (Rellekka).
8 Basilisks.

jormungand-s-prison.name: Jormungand's Prison
notes: Requires The Fremennik Exiles for Basilisk Knight access. Contains standard Basilisks, Basilisk Knights, and The Jormungand quest fight; a mirror shield or V's shield is required.
12 Basilisks and 20 Knights.
Contains both basilisks and Basilisk Knights.
Only accessible after completion of The Fremennik Exiles.
Basilisk knights will still retaliate with magic, but it is possible to prevent their melee attacks using a safespot.

bats.name: Bats
notes: Bats require combat level 5 to be assigned by Turael, Spria, or Mazchna; there is no Slayer level or quest requirement.
slayerTargetId 276 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.

Five bat types count: Bat (lvl6), Giant bat (lvl27, most common), Albino bat (lvl52, Cabin Fever), Death wing (lvl83, Legends' Quest), and other bats; only Bat and Giant bat stats are authored, the rest are honest-UNKNOWN.
The Giant bat has 32 Hitpoints, max hit 3 (stab melee), 4-tick attack speed, and Defence level 22.
Bats have an elemental weakness to air spells (35% on the Bat, 10% on the Giant bat).
No required protective item and no task extension unlock exist for Bats.

A low-level Slayer-XP task: kill Giant bats (the most common variety) or regular Bats with any melee weapon. Air spells exploit the elemental weakness for a Magic-training alternative. Bats drop only bat bones, so the task is done for Slayer XP and the streak rather than loot.

bat-spawns.name: Bat spawns (various)
notes: Bats (level 6) and Giant bats (level 27) are common at low-density spots across Kandarin and Morytania; Giant bats also spawn in Arceuus near the Dark Altar. There is no single canonical bat location, so multi, cannon and safespot are conservative defaults and not wiki-confirmed for one spot. Some spots border the Wilderness, but a non-Wilderness spot is the safe default. Cannon permission is MIXED across the Slayer task/Bats location table (pageid 268303): most surface spots allow it, but Haunted Woods, Underground Pass and Brine Rat Cavern do not; the aggregate flag stays false.
Bats and giant bats are spread across many low-density spots; no single canonical spawn count is wiki-stated (honest UNKNOWN), so no amount overlay is authored.
Bats drop only bat bones or nothing, so the task is a starter Slayer-XP task.

bears.name: Bears
notes: Bears can be assigned by Krystilia (Wilderness, 65-100), Turael and Spria (10-20), and Mazchna (30-50); no Slayer level is required, only 13 combat.
Black bears, bear cubs, grizzly bears, grizzly bear cubs, reanimated bears, Artio, and Callisto count for the task; Angry bears, the Headless Beast, and Crystalline/Corrupted Bears do NOT count.
Krystilia's bears must be killed in the Wilderness (west of the Graveyard of Shadows or near the Dark Warriors' Fortress); starter-master bears are killed anywhere.
Grizzly bear cubs are found only in Isafdar and require partial completion of Regicide to reach.
Bears have a fire spell weakness (grizzly 20%, black bear 30% as of June 2025) but are trivial with any melee weapon.
The slayerTargetId 253 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract, worklist §1); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.

Kill ordinary bears with any melee weapon - they have negligible Defence and low Hitpoints. Krystilia tasks must be done in the Wilderness (bring only risk-appropriate gear); starter-master tasks are fastest at the Fremennik Province woods or around the Mind Altar. Callisto and Artio are slower boss alternatives with dedicated preparation.

bears-wilderness.name: Wilderness bears
notes: Grizzly bears spawn in the low-level Wilderness west of the Graveyard of Shadows (about 10 spawns) and near the Dark Warriors' Fortress, plus north-west of the Ferox Enclave. Required for Krystilia's Wilderness bears task; bring only risk-appropriate gear as PKers frequent the area. The Slayer task/Bears location table (pageid 297754) lists the Wilderness bear spots as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat).
West of the Graveyard of Shadows (~10 grizzly bears) and near the Dark Warriors' Fortress; north-west of Ferox Enclave.
Required for Krystilia's Wilderness bears task; carries PKer risk.
Single-way combat; a cannon can be set up and the bears can be safespotted per the wiki location table.

bears-area.name: Non-Wilderness bears
notes: Non-Wilderness bears for Turael, Spria, and Mazchna tasks: the Fremennik Province woods just outside Rellekka hold about 10 grizzly bears, with more in the Kebos Lowlands south of Mount Quidamortem; black bears cluster around the Mind Altar and Varrock south-east mine. Grizzly bear cubs are in Isafdar (partial Regicide required). The Slayer task/Bears location table (pageid 297754) lists these spots as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat).
Fremennik Province woods outside Rellekka (~10 bears), Kebos Lowlands, and around the Mind Altar (black bears).
Used for Turael, Spria, and Mazchna bears tasks.
Single-way combat; the wiki location table lists these bear spots as cannonable and safespottable.

birds.name: Birds
notes: Birds are assigned by Turael and Spria (Spria after completing A Porcine of Interest); there is no combat, Slayer, or quest requirement to be assigned.

The Chicken has 3 Hitpoints, max hit 0, 4-tick attack speed, and Defence level 1 (strongly negative defence bonuses).
Birds have no elemental weakness; any melee weapon clears them.
No required protective item and no task extension unlock exist for Birds.

A trivial low-level Slayer-XP task: kill Chickens (the most efficient bird) or any other counted bird with any weapon. Birds have negligible Defence and barely fight back, so no food or special gear is needed; the task is done for Slayer XP and the streak.

bird-spawns.name: Bird spawns (various)
notes: Chickens and ducks cluster at low-level farms such as Lumbridge, Fred the Farmer's field, and Falador; other counted birds (seagulls, penguins, terrorbirds, vultures) are spread widely. Every spot in the Slayer task/Birds location table (pageid 259880) is single-combat, cannonable and safespottable.
Chickens and ducks cluster in Lumbridge/Falador farms; no single canonical spawn count is wiki-stated (honest UNKNOWN), so no amount overlay is authored.
Every bird spawn on the wiki location table is single-way, cannonable, and safespottable.
Birds drop feathers, bones or nothing, so the task is a starter Slayer-XP task.

black-demons.name: Black demons
notes: Black demons can be assigned at 80 combat by various Slayer masters.
Black demons are found in a variety of dungeons around Gielinor.
Black demons can be easily killed using safespots when attacking with Ranged or Magic.
Melee is viable with the Protect from Melee prayer.
Black demons are weak to demonbane weapons and water spells.
Lower-level players may find black demon tasks daunting because high stats force safespotting and lower kill rates.
Higher-level players may still skip regular black demons because the drop table is nearly non-existent for the time and experience.
The two best regular spots are Taverley Dungeon and the Chasm of Fire.
Taverley Dungeon packs many demons together, while the Chasm of Fire has more safespots and both locations are cannonable.
Players who completed A Kingdom Divided and signed a contract with Yama can get contracts from Chasm of Fire kills.
Catacombs of Kourend black demons have access to Catacombs drops, but are generally not worth killing because of unusually higher Defence and awkward spawn use.
In the Wilderness, black demons are found in Edgeville Dungeon and the Wilderness Slayer Cave.
Edgeville Dungeon is easier to escape from, while the Wilderness Slayer Cave is multicombat, has a different drop table, and has one entrance.
Demonic gorillas can be killed instead when assigned by any Slayer master other than Krystilia or Konar.
Demonic gorillas require Monkey Madness II and two combat styles.
Demonic gorillas are slower but profitable due to Zenyte shard chance.
The Grand Tree black demon can be killed again in the Nightmare Zone and counts for Black demon Slayer tasks.
Kolodion can only be killed once during the Mage Arena miniquest.

Use Taverley Dungeon or Chasm of Fire for regular black demons, ideally with cannon plus demonbane melee, Ranged, or Magic safespots. Use Wilderness locations only with low risk. Use demonic gorillas instead for non-Krystilia/non-Konar assignments when choosing profit over speed.

brimhaven-dungeon.name: Brimhaven Dungeon
notes: Black demon safespot near the agility pipe allows cannon coverage on 2-3 of the 4 demons.
Safespot near agility pipe allows you to cannon 2-3 of the 4 demons.

catacombs-of-kourend.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: Black demons here can be safespotted and give access to Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces, but their higher Defence makes them an inefficient Black demons task option. Hellhounds here are multicombat, safespottable, cannot be cannoned, and can reset aggression by running south and up the vine to the Giants' Den.
Xeric's Heart (Xeric's talisman) is beside the Catacombs entrance.
Killing Black demons here gives access to Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces.
Generally not worth using because Catacombs black demons have unusually higher Defence and it is not possible to utilise all four spawns.

Xeric's talisman into the Kebos Lowlands for the Chasm of Fire.

chasm-of-fire-bottom.name: Chasm of Fire (Bottom level)

Xeric's talisman into the Kebos Lowlands for the Chasm of Fire.

crash-site-cavern.name: Crash Site Cavern

Demonic Gorillas, an upgraded version of Black Demons.
Requires completion of Monkey Madness II.

edgeville-dungeon-wilderness.name: Edgeville Dungeon (Wilderness)

taverley-dungeon.name: Taverley Dungeon
notes: Black demon area has safespots by the south-west stalagmites and in a north-east crevice; requires Dusty Key or 70 Agility. Also contains lower-level Black dragon spawns and task-only baby black dragon access. Blue dragon area contains 9 adult Blue dragons and 12 baby Blue dragons, supports a cannon, and is the fast baby-blue-dragon task option; ring of dueling plus Enlightened Journey can speed banking. Hellhounds here have 13 spawns, support a cannon, can be safespotted on rocks and columns, and 80 Agility is highly recommended.
Falador teleport, then run west to the Taverley Dungeon.
Safespot by the two stalagmites in the south-west corner.
There is also a safespot in a crevice in the north-east corner, useful for cannon multicombat-style positioning.
Requires Dusty Key or 70 Agility.

wilderness-slayer-cave.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: Level 18-22 Wilderness Hellhound area is multicombat, cannonable, safespottable, and fast with Wilderness weapons. The cave is a popular player killing hotspot; stand as far south as practical to stay near one-click teleport range, and do not risk items you are unwilling to lose.
Ring of dueling to Ferox Enclave, then run north into the cave.
Multicombat area and high-risk player killing makes this a very dangerous location.
Under 30 Wilderness, but hopping inside is difficult due to demon aggression.

god-wars-dungeon.name: God Wars Dungeon
notes: Bloodveld safespotting requires Saradomin and Zamorak item protection; first-time access requires rope. God Wars Bloodveld are Zamorak followers and no superior Bloodveld can spawn here. God Wars Hellhounds are Zamorak followers, count for Zamorak kill count, are safespottable, and are discouraged because their spawns are far and sparse. Spiritual creatures require Death Plateau and either 60 Strength or 60 Agility to receive assignments; main Spiritual creature variants require god-affiliated item protection for tolerance, with Zamorak and usually Saradomin protection recommended. Cannon nuance: a cannon can physically be set up in the God Wars Dungeon but its inhabitants may destroy it (Dwarf multicannon pageid 13551); wiki task tables split on the verdict (ogres/vampyres Yes, aviansie/bloodveld/hellhounds No), so trust the per-task row here.
Rope is required on first entry via the Trollheim crevice.
Boss alternative only: Balfrug Kreeyath in the Zamorak Fortress counts as a Black demon.
Requires God Wars Dungeon access, Zamorak kill count, and boss-trip gear.

black-dragons.name: Black dragons
notes: Black dragons can be assigned at level 80 combat after partial completion of Dragon Slayer I.
Black dragons are the rarest chromatic dragons.
As with all other chromatic dragons, they use melee and short-ranged dragonfire.
For standard Black dragons, use Protect from Melee and basic dragonfire protection such as an anti-dragon shield and extended antifire potion.
Black dragons are quite accurate and hit relatively hard.
Players can additionally kill baby black dragons, brutal black dragons, or the King Black Dragon as alternatives for a black dragon task.
Optimal strategies involve quickly killing baby black dragons or brutal black dragons.
brutal black dragons require 77 Slayer.
Brutal black dragons have long-ranged dragonfire and a ranged magical attack that deals high damage.
For brutal black dragons, use a strong crossbow, Protect from Magic, and stand out of melee range.
Dragon hunter crossbow is the most effective brutal black dragon ranged weapon, but Hunters' sunlight crossbow, Dragon crossbow, and Rune crossbow can be sufficient.
Faster brutal black dragon methods use Dragon hunter lance or other melee.
With melee brutal black dragon methods, keep Protect from Magic on at all times and use flinching to avoid accurate melee attacks.
For baby black dragons, use Taverley Dungeon and its task-only area with five spawns for quick AFK task completion.
Corsair Cove Dungeon standard black dragons are closest to a bank with a quick Mythical cape teleport.
Players who started Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Sir Amik Varze can sacrifice a raw chicken at the Chicken Shrine in Zanaris to access Evil Chicken's Lair.
Lava Maze Dungeon access is significantly troublesome without 82 Agility because it requires traversing the Lava Maze and bringing a knife to cut webs.
Wilderness Slayer Cave is more accessible than Lava Maze Dungeon, but is multicombat and a popular player killing spot.
In the Wilderness Slayer Cave, players can teleport out with a one-click teleport such as a royal seed pod, but must be safespotted.
If killing King Black Dragon, do not bring items you are unwilling to lose.
The trek from the level 44 Wilderness Obelisk to the King Black Dragon lair is short, but it is a popular player killing spot and escape is likely impossible if attacked.

For speed, kill baby black dragons in the Taverley task-only area. For profit, kill brutal black dragons with 77 Slayer using dragonfire protection, Protect from Magic, and dragonbane ranged or melee. Use Wilderness options only with low risk, and treat King Black Dragon as a separate boss-profit option.

Hellhounds here have 13 spawns, support a cannon, can be safespotted on rocks and columns, and 80 Agility is highly recommended.
Falador teleport, then run west to the Taverley Dungeon.
2 Adult dragons.

taverley-dungeon-upper.name: Taverley Dungeon (upper level)
notes: Black dragons in this upper level can only be killed while on a Slayer task. Includes 12 adult dragons and 5 baby dragons; the baby black dragon task-only area can be AFKed quickly. Blue dragons here are task-only adults and require level 70 Agility for a shortcut or a dusty key.
Falador teleport, then run west to the Taverley Dungeon.
12 Adult dragons and 5 Baby dragons.

They have very high melee and ranged defence (+70 to +76) but a negative magic defence (-11), so magic is by far the fastest style.
No task extension unlock exists for Black knights.
Attack the level 33 Wilderness Black Knights with magic; their magic defence is negative (-11) while melee and ranged defence are very high (+70 to +76). Bring Wilderness-appropriate risk gear.

notes: Level 33 Wilderness Black Knights spawn south of the Bandit Camp (Lava Maze area, ~level 33) with a further cluster north-east of the Bone Yard. Family-tuned copy of bandit-camp-wilderness (CT-L rule 2): the black knights occupy a distinct adjacent spot. Multicombat, cannon placement and safespots are not wiki-stated, so conservative defaults are used. This is a PvP zone; bring Wilderness risk gear.
9 spawns south of the Bandit Camp plus 7 north-east of the Bone Yard, all level 33 Wilderness.

bloodveld.name: Bloodveld
notes: Bloodvelds require 50 Slayer to damage and 50 combat to receive as a task.
Bloodvelds are demons and are affected by demonbane weapons.
An ash sanctifier may be brought for Prayer experience from ashes.
Bloodvelds have high Hitpoints and low Defence, making them good sources of combat and Slayer experience.
Bloodvelds attack with magic-based melee: they use melee attacks, but player magic defence determines their accuracy.
Use armour with decent magic defence, such as dragonhide or blood moon armour.
Players using protection prayers should use Protect from Melee rather than Protect from Magic.
Stronghold Slayer Cave is common because it is close to a bank and supports a dwarf multicannon.
Meiyerditch Laboratories are multi-combat and cannonable, and the mutated bloodveld room has a cluster of seven mutated bloodvelds.
Buccaneers' Laboratory requires 76 Sailing, is multicombat, is cannonable, and has no obstacles blocking bloodvelds.
Building the Buccaneers' Laboratory rowboat and bank chest makes accessing and banking there much faster.
Other mutated bloodveld locations, Catacombs of Kourend and Iorwerth Dungeon, are mainly recommended when assigned by Konar.
If assigned by Konar to the Slayer Tower, it is reasonable to kill bloodvelds there.
Konar tasks sending the player to God Wars Dungeon should be skipped because insatiable bloodvelds cannot spawn and AFK killing is impractical around aggressive monsters.
It is not recommended to kill Bloodveld assigned by Krystilia because Wilderness God Wars Dungeon is dangerous multicombat Wilderness with sparse spawns.
Expert Reanimation on ensouled bloodveld heads can be used as a low-Slayer-experience Prayer-training alternative that still counts toward the task.

For regular tasks, use Stronghold Slayer Cave with a cannon for low attention or Meiyerditch Laboratories/Buccaneers' Laboratory mutated bloodvelds for high experience. Wear magic-defence armour, pray Protect from Melee if using Prayer, and prefer demonbane melee where using direct combat.

buccaneers-laboratory.name: Buccaneers' Laboratory
notes: Requires 76 Sailing. Mutated bloodvelds are multicombat, cannonable, safespottable, and become much easier to access after building the rowboat from Pirates' Cove and the bank chest. Hellhounds here are multicombat and cannonable, with 5 spawns reached by rowboat from Pirates' Cove.
8 Mutated Bloodvelds.
Requires 76 Sailing to access the island.
The rowboat can be used to travel to Buccaneers' Haven from Pirates' Cove.
Since the area is multi-combat, it is one of the best places to use a dwarf multicannon for high Slayer experience per hour.
The drops will cover the use of the dwarf multicannon.

notes: Black demons here can be safespotted and give access to Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces, but their higher Defence makes them an inefficient Black demons task option. meiyerditch-laboratories.name: Meiyerditch Laboratories

blue-dragons.name: Blue dragons
notes: Blue dragons can be assigned at 65 combat after starting Dragon Slayer I.

Blue dragons attack with melee and dragonfire.
dragonfire protection should be considered for adult, brutal, and Vorkath kills.
brutal blue dragons can also attack with magic and use long-ranged dragonfire.
Due to their large size, blue dragons can usually be safespotted with ranged, magic, or halberd-like weapons.

cave-horrors.name: Cave horrors
notes: Cave horrors require 58 Slayer, 85 combat, and completion of Cabin Fever.

A witchwood icon blocks their special attack when fighting at melee distance; without it, the special always deals 10% of the player's base Hitpoints level, rounded down.
Protect from Melee completely mitigates the special attack and their magic-based melee damage.
A light source is required unless a Fire of eternal light is lit in the cave.
Cave horrors attack with magic-based melee: Protect from Melee blocks damage, while high magic defence helps when not praying.

Melee can be used with high Prayer bonus gear such as Proselyte armour and Protect from Melee, or with dragonhide-style magic defence and a witchwood icon when conserving prayer.
A dwarf multicannon can speed up kills, and one cannon safespot placement allows monsters targeted by the cannon to get stuck on the wall.
Safespots are available by the entrance, swamp, mushrooms, stalagmites, boulders, and other obstacles in the cave.
Bones to Peaches or tablets can extend melee trips by converting big bones into food.
Herb sack, seed box, log basket or plank sack, reagent pouch, Bonecrusher, and Soul bearer are useful because of common drops.
Cave horrors are often killed for the black mask drop and hard clue scrolls.

notes: Cows are assigned by Turael and Spria. Turael has no requirement; Spria requires combat level 5 to assign the task (per-master gate, so the task-level combatLevel is left null).
