frost-dragons.name: Frost Dragons
notes: Frost dragons require 87 Sailing to access Grimstone and 85 combat to receive as a Slayer assignment.
The wiki slayer infobox leaves the Slayer skill requirement blank; the source uses slayerLevel 1 to represent no Slayer skill requirement.
They can be assigned by Nieve/Steve and Duradel/Kuradal.
The fastest return after visiting Grimstone at least once is fairy ring DLP.
A boat moored at Grimstone with a greater teleport focus can also be used, or players can sail from a nearby port such as Weiss.
Frost dragons attack with melee and short-ranged dragonfire.
Their dragonfire is icy and briefly freeze players who lack adequate dragonfire protection.
A regular antifire potion partially negates the icy dragonfire.
A regular antifire potion with an anti-dragon shield fully negates the icy dragonfire.
A super antifire potion alone fully negates the icy dragonfire.
Protect from Melee combined with full dragonfire protection nullifies all Frost dragon damage.
Frost dragons can be Safespotted because they only use melee and short-ranged dragonfire.
They are weakest to crush, then stab, and have a 100% elemental weakness to fire spells.
Heavy ranged remains the best ranged option, though Frost dragons are more resistant to ranged than chromatic dragons.
As dragons, they are weak to dragonbane weapons.
Being on a Frost dragon task increases the Dragon metal sheet drop rate from 1/100 to 1/40.
They have high drop rates for Dragon metal sheets and Dragon nails.
Loot from Frost dragons appears on their central north-eastern tile instead of the south-western tile used by most monsters.
Frost dragons do not count as blue dragons or metal dragons for Slayer tasks.
A task-only area is west of the main Grimstone Dungeon area and blocks off-task kills with a strange coldness message.
Use dragonbane melee on crush with Protect from Melee and full dragonfire protection, or use Ranged/Magic safespots. 87 Sailing and Grimstone access are required.

grimstone-dungeon.name: Grimstone Dungeon
notes: Frost dragon area on Grimstone, requiring 87 Sailing to access. After visiting Grimstone once, fairy ring DLP is the fastest return route. Contains the main Frost dragon area with 20 listed spawns; frost dragons are immune to dwarf multicannon damage and can be safespotted.
Main Frost dragon area in Grimstone Dungeon.
Requires 87 Sailing to access Grimstone.
The monster page lists 20 Frost dragon spawns in the main Grimstone Dungeon area.
Frost dragons are immune to dwarf multicannon damage.
Can be safespotted because they only use melee and short-ranged dragonfire.

grimstone-dungeon-task-only.name: Grimstone Dungeon task-only cavern
notes: Task-only Frost dragon cavern west of the main Grimstone Dungeon area. Requires a Frost dragon Slayer task; off-task attacks are blocked with the strange coldness permission message. Requires 87 Sailing access to Grimstone and can be safespotted.
Task-only area west of the main Frost dragon area.
Attempting to attack these off task gives a message about a strange coldness and deciding not to attack without permission.
Added as a Frost dragon Slayer task-only cavern on 3 December 2025.
Can be safespotted because frost dragons only use melee and short-ranged dragonfire.

gargoyles.name: Gargoyles
notes: Gargoyles require 75 Slayer, 80 combat, and Priest in Peril completion to be assigned.
They are only found in the Slayer Tower on the top floor, in the basement, or on the rooftop boss arena.
Gargoyles in the basement can only be killed on a Slayer task; Raulyn stops off-task attacks.
Gargoyles are weak to both magic and crush attacks, but melee is commonly used due to cost, their low melee defence, and limited safespot reliability.
Gargoyles have -2 flat armour, so weapons such as Dual macuahuitl are recommended to use the extra damage.
To kill a Gargoyle, use a rock hammer, rock thrownhammer, or granite hammer when it reaches 9 or lower Hitpoints.
Gargoyle Smasher costs 120 Slayer points and automatically smashes Gargoyles at 9 or lower Hitpoints if a rock hammer or equivalent is in inventory.
The granite hammer will automatically smash Gargoyles even without Gargoyle Smasher if it is equipped.
The rock hammer is faster than the rock thrownhammer because the thrownhammer has travel time.
If both rock hammer and rock thrownhammer are in inventory, the rock hammer is used in melee distance and thrownhammers are used outside melee distance.
Marble gargoyle is the superior variant and can spawn after Bigger and Badder; it uses ranged attacks in addition to melee.
Marble gargoyles can launch a white-red orb special attack that deals heavy 1x1 area damage and entraps players if not dodged.
Grotesque Guardians require a brittle key from on-task Gargoyles to unlock the rooftop boss arena.
Regular Gargoyles are much faster and need fewer supplies than the Grotesque Guardians.
Grotesque Guardians are more time-consuming, need higher stats and gear, and require more effort and supplies.
Grotesque Guardians are the only source of untradeable granite dust, which upgrades cannonballs into granite cannonballs with a max hit of 35 instead of 30.
It is strongly recommended to avoid Double Trouble when killing Grotesque Guardians because it makes the boss consume two task kills instead of one.
The basement is recommended during a task because many Gargoyles are close together and aggression can be reset twice for around 30 minutes of semi-AFK combat.
For basement semi-AFK, start from the north, run south-west after the first aggression loss, then east after the second aggression loss.

Use melee crush in the Slayer Tower basement with a rock hammer or granite hammer finisher. Use Protect from Melee for regular Gargoyles, watch Marble gargoyle specials, and avoid Double Trouble if choosing Grotesque Guardians.

slayer-tower-top-floor.name: Slayer Tower (top floor)
notes: Gargoyles on the top floor of the Slayer Tower. The Gargoyles task page lists 8 spawns, no multicombat, no cannon, and a bookcase safespot; reaching the top floor may require passing banshees and aberrant spectres.
Contains 8 Gargoyles.
Running through the Slayer Tower floors passes dangerous monsters, notably banshees and aberrant spectres.
The task page image shows a safespot at the east side of the adjacent bookcase.

slayer-tower-basement.name: Slayer Tower Basement
notes: Task-only basement. Gargoyles can only be killed here while on a Slayer task and Raulyn stops off-task attacks; the Gargoyles task page lists 12 spawns and safespot support. Safespotting requires the Teleport anchoring scroll permanent unlock for Abyssal demons. Bloodveld access is task-only, can be reached from the tower with a Slayer ring route, and may be less busy.
Fairy ring CKS by the Slayer Tower, then descend to the basement (needs a Dramen or Lunar staff).
Contains 12 Gargoyles.
Gargoyles can only be killed here while on a Slayer task.
Raulyn stops players attempting to fight basement Gargoyles off task.
Recommended for tasks because many Gargoyles are in a fairly small area.

slayer-tower-roof.name: Slayer Tower roof
requirements: Brittle key used to unlock the Slayer Tower roof
notes: Grotesque Guardians boss arena on the Slayer Tower roof. Requires a brittle key drop from regular Gargoyles to unlock; contains Dawn and Dusk, counts as one task kill unless Double Trouble makes the boss count as two.
Grotesque Guardians boss arena with Dawn and Dusk.
Only available after receiving a brittle key drop from regular Gargoyles.
The Grotesque Guardians count as one kill unless Double Trouble is unlocked, after which they count as two.
Use the Grotesque Guardians strategy source for boss-specific mechanics.

ghosts.name: Ghosts
notes: Ghosts require combat level 13 to be assigned by Turael, Spria, or Mazchna; there is no Slayer level or quest requirement for the base task.
slayerTargetId 289 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
The standard level-19 Ghost has 25 Hitpoints, max hit 2 (crush melee), 4-tick attack speed, and Defence level 18.
Ghosts are undead and spectral: the salve amulet and Crumble Undead both apply.
Ghosts have a 50% elemental weakness to air spells (magic defence -5).
Higher-level Ghost variants (levels 25, 76/77) exist in the Sepulchre of Death; the level-25 variant gives 75 Slayer XP but its combat stats are honest-UNKNOWN.
No required protective item and no task extension unlock exist for Ghosts.
All currently modelled revenant forms count for Ghosts tasks. Their Wilderness location and dedicated encounter requirements apply even when the assignment comes from a starter master.

A low-level Slayer-XP task: kill the level-19 Ghosts with any melee weapon, or cast air spells to exploit the 50% elemental weakness. A salve amulet gives an undead damage bonus. Ghosts drop nothing at most spots, so they are done for the Slayer XP and task streak rather than loot.

ghost-spawns.name: Ghost spawns (various)
notes: Level-19 Ghosts are common at low-level spots such as the Draynor Manor basement, the Wilderness graveyards, and the Haunted Woods; higher-level Ghosts (levels 25 and 76/77) appear in the Sepulchre of Death within the Stronghold of Security. Some ghost spawns are inside the Wilderness, but a non-Wilderness spot (e.g. Draynor Manor basement) is the safe default. Multi, cannon and safespot availability vary by spot and are not wiki-confirmed for a single canonical location (conservative defaults).

Ghosts are spread across ~20 low-density spots (e.g. Catacombs of Kourend, Crumbling Tower, Taverley Dungeon, Wilderness graveyards); this dataset uses one generic catch-all row instead of per-location rows.

Cannonability varies by spot per the wiki task table: cannon-prohibited at Catacombs of Kourend and Revenant Caves, but permitted at most other ghost spots; multicombat and safespot also vary. The all-false booleans here are a conservative placeholder, not a per-spot verification.
Ghosts drop nothing at most locations, so they are rarely trained; this is a starter Slayer-XP task.

ghouls.name: Ghoul
notes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 290 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Ghouls is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
Assigned only by Mazchna (10-20) in this dataset; no Slayer level required (slayerLevel 1). Mazchna's combat-level threshold is around 25.
Ghouls are NOT undead - the Salve amulet does not apply. undead is honestly false despite the folk assumption in the worklist.
Access requires Priest in Peril (to cross the River Salve into Morytania).
All defensive bonuses are +0, so any melee style clears them; there is no elemental weakness (weakness.element honest null).

Ghouls are a low-level Mazchna task west of Canifis, north of Mort Myre Swamp (Priest in Peril required for Morytania access). They have Defence 30 with all defensive bonuses +0, so any melee weapon is equally accurate - bring your best melee setup and a Slayer helmet. They hit up to 5 with melee, so a little food covers the trip. Note they are NOT undead, so the Salve amulet gives no bonus.

canifis-ghoul-area.name: Canifis ghoul area
notes: Ghouls roam the area west of Canifis, north of Mort Myre Swamp, by the River Salve. Priest in Peril is required to cross into Morytania. Multi, cannon and safespot status are not wiki-stated and left conservative (false).
Ghouls roam west of Canifis by the River Salve, north of Mort Myre Swamp.
Multi, cannon and safespot status are not wiki-stated, so treated conservatively as false.

goblins.name: Goblins
notes: Goblins are assigned by Turael and Spria (Spria after completing A Porcine of Interest); there is no combat, Slayer, or quest requirement to be assigned.
slayerTargetId 291 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
The common level-2 Goblin has 5 Hitpoints, max hit 1 (crush melee), 4-tick attack speed, and Defence level 1 (all defence bonuses -15).
Goblins have no elemental weakness; any melee weapon clears them.
Many variants count and benefit from the Slayer helmet/black mask: level 5/13 Goblins, Cave goblins and guards, and the Bandos room Sergeants (Strongstack, Grimspike, Steelwill).
No required protective item and no task extension unlock exist for Goblins.

A fast, trivial low-level Slayer-XP task: kill the common level-2 Goblins near Lumbridge or at Goblin Village with any melee weapon. Goblins have negligible Defence and a max hit of 1, so no food or special gear is needed; the task is done for Slayer XP and the streak.

goblin-spawns.name: Goblin spawns (various)
notes: Goblins are very common along the Lumbridge-to-Goblin-Village road, at Goblin Village north of Falador, and near Draynor. There is no single canonical goblin location for a slayer task, so multi, cannon and safespot are conservative defaults and not wiki-confirmed for one spot.
Goblins are very common across Lumbridge and Goblin Village; no single canonical spawn count is wiki-stated (honest UNKNOWN), so no amount overlay is authored.
Goblins are a fast, trivial starter Slayer-XP task.

greater-demons.name: Greater demons
notes: Greater demons require 70 combat to be assigned by normal Slayer masters.
Greater Challenge extends assignments to 200-250 Greater demons.
Greater demons are demons and are weak to water spells, Arclight, Emberlight, and other demonbane options.
Chasm of Fire is a strong task-only cannon option with Fairy Ring DJR access.
Brimhaven Dungeon is cannonable but the spawns are spread out.
Catacombs of Kourend is multicombat and drops ancient shards and dark totem pieces, but cannot be cannoned.
Wilderness Slayer Cave is fast, multicombat, and cannonable, but carries player-killing risk.
Tormented Demon can be killed on Greater demon tasks after While Guthix Sleeps for higher-value kills.
Skotizo and K'ril Tsutsaroth are boss alternatives for profit or boss-specific goals.
Tstanon Karlak counts as a Greater demon while fighting K'ril Tsutsaroth.

Use Chasm of Fire or Brimhaven Dungeon with a cannon for normal tasks, Catacombs of Kourend for ancient shards and dark totem pieces, or Wilderness Slayer Cave for fast cannonable multicombat kills when accepting PK risk. Use Tormented Demon, Skotizo, or K'ril Tsutsaroth only when choosing boss or profit alternatives over fast task completion.

brimhaven-dungeon.name: Brimhaven Dungeon
notes: Black demon safespot near the agility pipe allows cannon coverage on 2-3 of the 4 demons.
Axe needed.
875 coin entry each time, one-time fee of 1,000,000 coins, or one-off 5,000 trading sticks alternative.
Greater demon spawns are fairly far apart, so it is cannonable but not ideal unless assigned by Konar.

chasm-of-fire-bottom.name: Chasm of Fire (Bottom level)
notes: Bottom level Black demon area with stalagmite safespots and another safespot near the Voice of Yama; Yama contracts are available after A Kingdom Divided and signing with Yama.
Xeric's talisman into the Kebos Lowlands for the Chasm of Fire.
Easily accessed through Fairy Ring DJR.
Can drop Yama contracts after speaking to Yama after A Kingdom Divided.

catacombs-of-kourend.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: Black demons here can be safespotted and give access to Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces, but their higher Defence makes them an inefficient Black demons task option. Mutated bloodvelds appear in three groups, can be safespotted, and use the Catacombs drop table including ancient shards and dark totem pieces. Brutal blue dragons here are safespottable, cannot be cannoned, and can drop ancient shards and Dark totem parts. Hellhounds here are multicombat, safespottable, cannot be cannoned, and can reset aggression by running south and up the vine to the Giants' Den.
Xeric's Heart (Xeric's talisman) is beside the Catacombs entrance.
Contains 10 to 13 Greater demons depending on the counted side room.
Drops ancient shard and dark totem pieces.

entrana-dungeon.name: Entrana Dungeon
notes: Greater demon location under Entrana. Weapons and armour cannot be taken through Entrana (bring cannon parts and unarmed/allowed gear only), but the dungeon itself allows cannon placement: the Slayer task/Greater demons table (pageid 298108) lists Entrana Dungeon as cannonable - the multicannon prohibited-list Entrana entry covers the island surface.
Due to not being able to take weapons and armour to Entrana, it is not advisable to complete a Slayer task there.

lava-maze-dungeon.name: Lava Maze Dungeon
notes: Wilderness Black dragon location. Access is significantly troublesome without 82 Agility and otherwise requires traversing the Lava Maze with a knife to cut webs; poison protection is useful due to poison spiders.
Burning amulet teleports to the Lava Maze in the Wilderness.
A single-combat Wilderness option.
82 Agility is highly recommended if completing tasks here.

demonic-ruins.name: Demonic Ruins
notes: Deep Wilderness Greater demon location near the Annakarl teleport destination. Prayer points regenerate there, but the area is multicombat and high PK risk.
Annakarl teleport (Ancient Magicks) lands beside the Demonic Ruins in the deep Wilderness.
Prayer points regenerate over time at the Demonic Ruins.
Very unsafe because it is deep in the Wilderness, multicombat, and near the Annakarl teleport destination.

ogre-enclave-watchtower.name: Ogre Enclave
notes: Requires Watchtower. Blue dragons are far apart, can be cannoned and safespotted, and banking can use Ring of dueling to Castle Wars then run east to Gu'Tanoth; cannon also targets nearby spiders and skeletons.
Ring of dueling to Castle Wars, then run to the Watchtower ogre enclave.
Most Greater demons are behind a cage.
Requires a halberd or other ranged methods for caged demons.

isle-of-souls-dungeon.name: Isle of Souls Dungeon
notes: Blue dragons here include 4 adults and 3 babies. A cannon can be placed, making this an acceptable Konar Blue dragons location even though the room mixes adults and babies.
Safespot behind the rocks on the eastern side of the inner wall.
Fairly compact, though a lesser demon may interrupt the player.

karuulm-slayer-dungeon-greater-demons.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon - Greater demons
notes: Greater demon area with a safespot between two stone chests on the northern side. Stone boots or equivalent heat protection are required unless the relevant diary protection applies.
Safespot is between the two stone chests on the northern side.
Bring Stone Boots.

requiredItems.name: Karuulm heat protection
requiredItems.waiverRequirement: Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary reward claimed

wilderness-slayer-cave.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: Level 18-22 Wilderness Hellhound area is multicombat, cannonable, safespottable, and fast with Wilderness weapons. The cave is a popular player killing hotspot; stand as far south as practical to stay near one-click teleport range, and do not risk items you are unwilling to lose.
Ring of dueling to Ferox Enclave, then run north into the cave.
Level 28 Wilderness.
Fast experience with Viggora's chainmace before acquiring Arclight or Emberlight.
One of the only Greater demon areas that is both cannonable and multicombat.

god-wars-dungeon.name: God Wars Dungeon
notes: Bloodveld safespotting requires Saradomin and Zamorak item protection; first-time access requires rope. God Wars Bloodveld are Zamorak followers and no superior Bloodveld can spawn here. God Wars Hellhounds are Zamorak followers, count for Zamorak kill count, are safespottable, and are discouraged because their spawns are far and sparse. Spiritual creatures require Death Plateau and either 60 Strength or 60 Agility to receive assignments; main Spiritual creature variants require god-affiliated item protection for tolerance, with Zamorak and usually Saradomin protection recommended. Cannon nuance: a cannon can physically be set up in the God Wars Dungeon but its inhabitants may destroy it (Dwarf multicannon pageid 13551); wiki task tables split on the verdict (ogres/vampyres Yes, aviansie/bloodveld/hellhounds No), so trust the per-task row here.
Rope is required on first entry via the Trollheim crevice.
Boss alternative only: K'ril Tsutsaroth and Tstanon Karlak in the Zamorak Fortress count as Greater demons.
Requires God Wars Dungeon access, Zamorak kill count, and boss-trip gear.

ancient-guthixian-temple.name: Ancient Guthixian Temple
notes: Requires While Guthix Sleeps. Enter via a Guthixian temple teleport or by riding a light creature (sapphire lantern) down the Chasm of Tears. A cannon cannot be set up here and tormented demons are immune to cannon damage. Single-way combat zone with pseudo-multicombat rooms allowing up to 2-3 demons to engage at once.
Tormented demons count as Greater demons here after While Guthix Sleeps.
A cannon cannot be set up and tormented demons are immune to cannon damage.

green-dragons.name: Green dragons
notes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 259 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Green dragons is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
Krystilia assigns green dragons as a Wilderness-only task; only Wilderness green dragon kills count.
Green dragons use melee and short-ranged dragonfire; bring an anti-dragon shield or dragonfire shield plus an antifire potion.
Green dragons have low defence and are killed quickly with any strong weapon; dragonbane gear is optional.
Green dragons are weak to water spells (50%).
Wilderness green dragon spots are popular player-killing areas; do not bring items you are unwilling to lose and keep a one-click teleport ready.

Take a Krystilia Wilderness green dragon spawn (Graveyard of Shadows or south of the Lava Maze), wear dragonfire protection (anti-dragon shield plus antifire), and use a fast melee or ranged weapon such as Viggora's chainmace or Craw's bow. Bring only low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport.

graveyard-of-shadows-green-dragons.name: Graveyard of Shadows (green dragons)
notes: Five green dragon spawns north of the Graveyard of Shadows in the low-level Wilderness (around levels 18-21). Cannon placement verified for the Graveyard of Shadows area (Slayer task/Zombies table, pageid 298268; green dragon row itself is unmarked on the wiki).
5 green dragon spawns north of the Graveyard of Shadows.
In the Wilderness (around levels 18-21); a popular player-killing area.
Single-way combat, open Wilderness so cannonable (the wiki table leaves the boolean as Unknown, but Wilderness green dragons are a common cannon target).

green-dragons-wilderness.name: Wilderness green dragon spawns
notes: Other Wilderness green dragon clusters: south of the Lava Maze (5 spawns), west of the Dark Warriors' Fortress (3 spawns), and the Boneyard. The Slayer task/Green dragons table (pageid 270386) lists these Wilderness spots as cannonable.
Other Wilderness green dragon clusters: south of the Lava Maze (5 spawns), west of the Dark Warriors' Fortress (3 spawns), and the Boneyard.

All are single-way Wilderness spawns and cannonable per the wiki (west of Dark Warriors' Fortress and south of the Lava Maze are both Yes); the Boneyard/south-of-Venenatis cluster is also safespottable.

gryphons.name: Gryphons
notes: Gryphons require 51 Slayer and completion of Troubled Tortugans.
The Great Conch access requires 45 Sailing, as described on the Gryphon monster page.
Vannaka and Chaeldar can assign Gryphons after Troubled Tortugans without a points unlock.
Wings Spread costs 80 Slayer points and allows Nieve/Steve and Duradel/Kuradal to assign Gryphons.
For players seeking Gryphon tasks, Vannaka is recommended because Gryphons are Vannaka's highest weighted task even though his amount is lower than Duradel's.
Gryphons are found exclusively on The Great Conch in a western cavern, eastern task-only cavern, and the central Shellbane Gryphon Cave.
Both eastern and western caverns have a southern room that is multicombat and cannonable.
Gryphons attack with melee and have a special attack that causes knockback and moderate damage if equipped weight is too low.
The equipped weight threshold is 30 kg for normal gryphons and 40 kg for the boss.
If the weight threshold is met, the Gryphon stuns itself and the player can click the Gryphon within 2 ticks to knock it back and perform one additional attack without attack delay.
Normal Gryphons do not require a tortugan shield.
A tortugan shield is required for Dire gryphons and Shellbane Gryphon; without it their attacks deal frequent moderate damage even through prayer.
Dire gryphons have mechanics similar to the boss variant.
Gryphons are weakest to melee, ideally stabbing attacks, and have a 50% weakness to air spells.
Players not safespotting are recommended to use melee equipment.
Gryphons are best killed in the south-western multicombat room of the eastern task-only cave using a venator bow and a dwarf multicannon.
A maxed ranged setup can reach 30 kg by using a black mask (i) instead of a Slayer helmet (i), a granite ring, or avernic treads (max) instead of echo boots.
Bring a tortugan shield for the superior, and bring a cannon.
Gryphons have relatively poor drops and players not planning to kill the boss should avoid toggling them on for Nieve or Duradel.
The Shellbane Gryphon has somewhat lackluster drops too, but is slightly better compared to normal Gryphons.
On task, Horn of plenty (empty) improves from 1/2500 to 1/1000 on regular Gryphons.

Use the eastern task-only cave's south-west multicombat room with Venator bow and dwarf multicannon. Keep at least 30 kg equipped weight for normal Gryphons and bring a tortugan shield for Dire gryphons or Shellbane Gryphon.

western-gryphon-dungeon.name: Western gryphon dungeon
notes: Western Gryphons dungeon on the Great Conch. Contains 18 gryphons, has a southern room that is multicombat and cannonable, and has a west cave safespot that avoids all attacks.
The western cave on the Great Conch.
Contains 18 gryphons and may be fought off task.
Has a southern room that is multicombat and cannonable.
The task page includes a west cave safespot image that avoids all attacks.

eastern-gryphon-dungeon.name: Eastern gryphon dungeon
notes: Task-only Eastern Gryphons dungeon on the Great Conch. Contains 18 gryphons; the south-west part is multicombat and cannonable, while the rest is single-way combat.
Task-only eastern cave on the Great Conch.
Contains 18 gryphons.
Task-only. The south-west part of the dungeon is multicombat and cannonable, while the rest is single-way combat.
Recommended task location with venator bow and dwarf multicannon.

shellbane-gryphon-cave.name: Shellbane Gryphon Cave
notes: Task-only boss cave in the centre of the Great Conch leading to the solo instanced Shellbane Gryphon encounter.
Task-only boss.
Central Great Conch lair leading to the Shellbane Gryphon.
Solo instanced boss encounter.
Use Shellbane Gryphon/Strategies for boss-specific mechanics.

harpie-bug-swarms.name: Harpie Bug Swarms
notes: Harpie bug swarms require Slayer 33, combat level 45, and Firemaking 33 to be assigned; without 33 Firemaking the task cannot be given (Mod Ash confirmed all three checks remain in effect).

A lit bug lantern (needs Firemaking 33 to light) must be lit AND equipped to deal any damage; requiredItemName records this, but requiredItemId is left null as it is a damage-enabling worn item rather than a modelled RuneLite item gate.
Only Vannaka assigns this task; Chaeldar stopped assigning it on 8 May 2024 and Duradel on 10 September 2015.
slayerTargetId is null because the Slayer_task/Harpie Bug Swarms wiki page does not exist (redirect/missing); the SLAYER_TARGET varp value is unverified and left for QA. The monster NPC id is 464.
Harpie Bug Swarm has 25 Hitpoints, max hit 6 (Crush), 4-tick attack speed, and Defence level 32.

Monster gained a 50% elemental weakness to fire spells on 25 June 2025; weakness.style is MAGIC with element FIRE to reflect the recommended fire-spell method, though melee also works given low defensive bonuses.
No task extension unlock exists for Harpie bug swarms.

Ensure Slayer 33, combat level 45, and Firemaking 33, then light and equip a bug lantern (mandatory to deal damage). The best location is east of the Colossal Wyrm Remains in Varlamore, which has safespots and no poison hazards; the Karamja spot north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai also works but needs antipoison. Exploit the 50% fire weakness with fire spells, or use melee given the low defensive bonuses. Swarms are very accurate, so bring 40-50+ Defence gear and food such as lobsters, or keep Protect from Melee active. A cannon can speed up kills, but the bug lantern must stay equipped for it to damage the swarms.
Required protection or damage restriction: Lit bug lantern

colossal-wyrm-remains.name: East of the Colossal Wyrm Remains
notes: Varlamore savannah east of the Colossal Wyrm Remains; several safespots and free of Karamja poison hazards, so no antipoison is needed. A quetzal landing site at Colossal Wyrm Remains gives a quick shortcut to an Auburnvale bank and a prayer altar at The Teomat; nearest fairy ring is AJP.
Varlamore location east of the Colossal Wyrm Remains; several safespots and free of the poison hazards found on Karamja, so no antipoison is needed.
Building a quetzal landing site at Colossal Wyrm Remains gives a quick shortcut to an Auburnvale bank and a prayer altar at The Teomat; nearest fairy ring is AJP.
Recommended over the Karamja location for convenience and safety.

evidence.title: East of the Colossal Wyrm Remains

tai-bwo-wannai.name: North-east of Tai Bwo Wannai
notes: Karamja jungle north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai (fairy ring DKP); reached via Tai Bwo Wannai teleport scroll or the Brimhaven boat. Two safespots exist and a dwarf multicannon can be used, but the bug lantern must stay equipped for the cannon to damage swarms. Bring antipoison for nearby aggressive, poisonous creatures; Tai Bwo Wannai Trio unlocks the Tribal Statue prayer recharge.
Karamja location north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai (fairy ring DKP); reachable via Tai Bwo Wannai teleport scroll or the Brimhaven boat.
Two safespots exist; a dwarf multicannon can be used, but the bug lantern must be equipped for the cannon to deal damage, and telegrab runes are needed to collect drops.
Bring antipoison due to other aggressive, poisonous creatures nearby; completing Tai Bwo Wannai Trio enables the Tribal Statue to recharge prayer.

hellhounds.name: Hellhounds
notes: Hellhounds can be assigned as a Slayer task at 75 combat level by various Slayer masters.
Regular Hellhounds only attack with fairly accurate melee bites, so safespotting or Protect from Melee is recommended.
Hellhounds are primarily known for hard clue scrolls at 1/64, or 1/32 in the Wilderness with an imbued ring of wealth.
They also drop ensouled hellhound heads and the smouldering stone.
Hellhound monster page marks them as demonic creatures, so demonbane weapons work against them.
Level 122 and level 136 Hellhounds have a 50% water weakness and virtually nonexistent magic defence.
Outside the Wilderness, Hellhounds are primarily killed in the Stronghold Slayer Cave because there are four rooms of three or four Hellhounds and a dwarf multicannon can be set up.
Catacombs of Kourend Hellhounds are used for Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces.
The Catacombs do not allow a cannon but are multicombat and allow relative AFK training, especially with a Venator Bow.
After Catacombs aggression expires, players can run south and up the vine to the Giants' Den to reset aggression.
In the Wilderness, Hellhounds are primarily killed in the Wilderness Slayer Cave by Krystilia task users.
Wilderness Slayer Cave Hellhounds have a 50% increased smouldering stone drop rate and access to the Wilderness Slayer Cave drop table.
The Wilderness Slayer Cave is a popular player killing hotspot and players should not bring items they are unwilling to lose.
Revenant hellhounds do not count towards a normal Hellhound task and only count for Revenants tasks assigned by Krystilia.
The Skeleton Hellhound fought during In Search of the Myreque counts towards a Hellhound Slayer task during the quest, but its Nightmare Zone refight does not.
Bouncer fought during Fight Arena counts towards a Hellhound Slayer task during the quest, but its Nightmare Zone refight does not.
Bouncer's ghost fought during The General's Shadow does not count toward Hellhound Slayer tasks and cannot be fought after completing the miniquest.
Skeleton Hellhounds summoned by Calvar'ion and Vet'ion can progress the task and each boss kill spawns four Hellhounds total.
Calvar'ion and Vet'ion are player killing hotspots and players should not bring items they are unwilling to lose.
Cerberus is an alternative for players with 91 Slayer or 86 Slayer with a wild pie boost.
Cerberus is stronger than other Hellhounds, has additional mechanics, and can drop valuable uniques.
Cerberus is recommended only with Ward of Arceuus and either Arclight, Emberlight, or Scythe of Vitur because worse setups may use too many prayer potions.

Use Protect from Melee with demonbane melee in Stronghold Slayer Cave for cannon tasks, Catacombs with Venator bow for AFK shards/totems, or Wilderness Slayer Cave only when accepting player killing risk.

buccaneers-laboratory-hellhounds.name: Buccaneers' Laboratory
notes: Hellhounds here require 76 Sailing to access the island. The Rowboat can be used to travel to Buccaneers' Haven from Pirates' Cove; the area has 5 spawns and supports multicombat cannoning.
Requires 76 Sailing to access the Island.
The Rowboat can be used to travel to Buccaneers' Haven from Pirates' Cove.
Since this area is multi-combat, players can place and use a dwarf multicannon.

catacombs-of-kourend.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: Black demons here can be safespotted and give access to Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces, but their higher Defence makes them an inefficient Black demons task option. Mutated bloodvelds appear in three groups, can be safespotted, and use the Catacombs drop table including ancient shards and dark totem pieces. Brutal blue dragons here are safespottable, cannot be cannoned, and can drop ancient shards and Dark totem parts. Hellhounds here are multicombat, safespottable, cannot be cannoned, and can reset aggression by running south and up the vine to the Giants' Den.
Xeric's Heart (Xeric's talisman) is beside the Catacombs entrance.
Killing Hellhounds here gives access to Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces as bonus drops.
No cannon is allowed, but the area is multicombat and supports relative AFK training.
After aggression expires, run south and up the vine to the Giants' Den to reset aggression.

charred-dungeon-hellhounds.name: Charred Dungeon
notes: Hellhounds here require 60 Sailing to access. Contains 5 spawns, supports multicombat cannoning, and is discouraged due to the low spawn count.
Requires 60 Sailing to access.
Discouraged due to few spawns.

god-wars-dungeon.name: God Wars Dungeon
notes: Bloodveld safespotting requires Saradomin and Zamorak item protection; first-time access requires rope. God Wars Bloodveld are Zamorak followers and no superior Bloodveld can spawn here. God Wars Hellhounds are Zamorak followers, count for Zamorak kill count, are safespottable, and are discouraged because their spawns are far and sparse. Spiritual creatures require Death Plateau and either 60 Strength or 60 Agility to receive assignments; main Spiritual creature variants require god-affiliated item protection for tolerance, with Zamorak and usually Saradomin protection recommended. Cannon nuance: a cannon can physically be set up in the God Wars Dungeon but its inhabitants may destroy it (Dwarf multicannon pageid 13551); wiki task tables split on the verdict (ogres/vampyres Yes, aviansie/bloodveld/hellhounds No), so trust the per-task row here.
Rope is required on first entry via the Trollheim crevice.
Hellhounds are considered Zamorak followers.
It is recommended to wear God-aligned items to avoid getting attacked by multiple monsters.
Highly discouraged due to generally far and sparse spawns.

karuulm-slayer-dungeon-hellhounds.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon
notes: Hellhounds here require boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots unless the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete. Contains 12 Hellhounds, supports a cannon, and has a safespot near the Hellhound section entrance.
Players who have not completed the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary must wear boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots.
The boots protect from the extreme heat of the dungeon floor.
Hellhounds can be safespotted near the Hellhound section entrance.

requiredItems.name: Karuulm heat protection
requiredItems.waiverRequirement: Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary reward claimed

stronghold-slayer-cave.name: Stronghold Slayer Cave
notes: Bloodvelds here are close to Nieve, support a dwarf multicannon, and can be safespotted. Use a Slayer ring, Spirit tree to Tree Gnome Stronghold, or necklace of passage to Outpost. Hellhounds here are the primary non-Wilderness task option, with 13 spawns across four rooms of three or four Hellhounds, cannon support, and safespots.
Slayer ring teleports directly to the Stronghold Slayer Cave.
Stronghold Slayer Dungeon is the primary general Slayer location outside the Wilderness.
Contains four rooms of three or four Hellhounds.
A dwarf multicannon can be set up in their caves.

taverley-dungeon.name: Taverley Dungeon
notes: Black demon area has safespots by the south-west stalagmites and in a north-east crevice; requires Dusty Key or 70 Agility. Also contains lower-level Black dragon spawns and task-only baby black dragon access. Blue dragon area contains 9 adult Blue dragons and 12 baby Blue dragons, supports a cannon, and is the fast baby-blue-dragon task option; ring of dueling plus Enlightened Journey can speed banking. Hellhounds here have 13 spawns, support a cannon, can be safespotted on rocks and columns, and 80 Agility is highly recommended.
Falador teleport, then run west to the Taverley Dungeon.
80 Agility is highly recommended and boostable at 75 with a summer pie.
Hellhounds can be safespotted on rocks and columns.
Contains multiple lower-section safespots.

witchaven-dungeon.name: Witchaven Dungeon
notes: Hellhounds here have 8 spawns, support a cannon, and have a safespot near the entrance of the Hellhound area. A short puzzle is required to access the Hellhounds area for the first time, and the dungeon is far from convenient banking.
Long distance from a bank or convenient teleport makes it less recommended than other dungeons.
A short puzzle is required to access the Hellhounds area for the first time.
Has a safespot near the entrance of the Hellhound area.

wilderness-resource-area-hellhounds.name: Wilderness near Resource Area
notes: Level 49-55 Wilderness Hellhound area near the Resource Area. Contains 6 Hellhounds, supports a cannon and safespots, but has high Wilderness player killing danger; the Edgeville lever provides bank access.
High danger of player killing due to high traffic and high Wilderness level.
The Edgeville lever provides easy access to the Edgeville bank.
Area is level 49-55 Wilderness near the Resource Area.

wilderness-slayer-cave-hellhounds.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: Level 18-22 Wilderness Hellhound area is multicombat, cannonable, safespottable, and fast with Wilderness weapons. The cave is a popular player killing hotspot; do not risk items you are unwilling to lose.
Multicombat area in the Wilderness.
Fast experience if using Wilderness weapons.
Popular player killing hotspot, even though the Hellhounds are below level 20 Wilderness.

vetion-hellhound-spawns.name: Wilderness near Vet'ion
notes: Vet'ion and Calvar'ion summon Skeleton Hellhounds and Greater Skeleton Hellhounds that can progress a Hellhound task. This Wilderness boss area is a common player killing hotspot and the spawns have no drops other than the looting bag.
Vet'ion summons two Skeleton Hellhounds and two Greater Skeleton Hellhounds during the fight.
Highly discouraged due to the area being a common hotspot for player killing.
The Hellhound spawns have no drops other than the looting bag.

hill-giants.name: Hill giants
notes: Hill giants can be assigned by Krystilia (75-125, Wilderness only) and Mazchna (30-50, combat level 25 required).
Hill giants are combat level 28 with 35 Hitpoints and 26 Defence; they attack with crush and are aggressive to players below combat level 57.
They are 25% susceptible to earth spells; their low Defence means any combat style is effective.
Krystilia's assignment must be completed in the Wilderness (Deep Wilderness Dungeon, Boneyard Hunter area, or Lava Maze).
Mazchna's assignment can be completed anywhere; the free-to-play Edgeville Dungeon is the most convenient spot.
Hill giants always drop big bones and drop a limpwurt root commonly, and are a source of the Giant key for the Obor boss.
The slayerTargetId 260 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract, worklist §1); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.

Any combat style works given their low Defence. Melee them with a decent weapon such as a Dragon scimitar, or safespot/cannon where allowed. Krystilia tasks must be killed in the Wilderness; Mazchna tasks are most convenient at the Edgeville Dungeon.

hill-giants-area.name: Edgeville Dungeon
notes: Free-to-play; enter the Edgeville Dungeon via the trapdoor in the house south of Edgeville bank or the Wilderness ditch entrance. 12 hill giant spawns, the most convenient non-Wilderness spot for Mazchna's assignment. The Slayer task/Hill giants table (pageid 298054) lists Edgeville Dungeon as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat).
Free-to-play; 12 hill giant spawns in the Edgeville Dungeon, the most convenient spot for Mazchna's assignment.
Single-way combat but cannonable and safespottable per the wiki Location Comparison; a common cannon spot due to their high Hitpoints.

hill-giants-wilderness.name: Deep Wilderness Dungeon
notes: Wilderness hill giants for Krystilia: the Deep Wilderness Dungeon holds 6 spawns (~level 50 Wilderness), with further F2P Wilderness spawns at the Boneyard Hunter area and the Lava Maze. Kills count for Krystilia only in the Wilderness. The Slayer task/Hill giants table (pageid 298054) lists the Deep Wilderness Dungeon as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat).
Wilderness hill giants for Krystilia: the Deep Wilderness Dungeon (~level 50), plus the Boneyard Hunter area and Lava Maze at lower Wilderness levels.
Deep Wilderness Dungeon is single-way, cannonable and safespottable per the wiki; the Lava Maze spawns are also cannonable and the Boneyard Hunter area is multicombat.

hobgoblins.name: Hobgoblin
notes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 292 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Hobgoblins is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.

Authored as Mazchna-only (30-50, weight 7) per the C3 starter-tier worklist. The live wiki ALSO lists Vannaka as an assigner; that is documented here and can be folded in later as an additive masterIds/amount/weight edit if desired (same decision as cockatrice/pyrefiends).
No Slayer level required (slayerLevel 1). Mazchna's combat-level threshold is around 20.
Two forms count: the level-28 unarmed hobgoblin and the level-42 armed hobgoblin; the default variant pins the level-28 form.
All defensive bonuses are +0, so any melee style clears them; there is no elemental weakness (weakness.element honest null).

Hobgoblins are a low-level Mazchna task in the Edgeville Dungeon and on the peninsula west of the Crafting Guild. They have Defence 24 with all defensive bonuses +0, so any melee weapon is equally accurate - bring your best melee setup and a Slayer helmet. They hit up to 3 with melee, so minimal food is needed. Both the unarmed level-28 and armed level-42 forms count toward the task.

hobgoblin-area.name: Hobgoblin area
notes: Hobgoblins in the Edgeville Dungeon (non-Wilderness section) and on the peninsula west of the Crafting Guild. Not the Wilderness hobgoblin spawns. The Slayer task/Hobgoblins table (pageid 298252) lists Edgeville Dungeon and the Crafting Guild peninsula as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat).
Hobgoblins gather in the Edgeville Dungeon and on the peninsula west of the Crafting Guild.
Both spots are single-way combat but cannonable and safespottable per the wiki Location Comparison.

hydras.name: Hydras
notes: Hydras are assigned exclusively by Konar quo Maten and require 95 Slayer.
Boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots are mandatory in Karuulm Slayer Dungeon unless the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete.
Hydras are draconic, so dragonbane weapons such as the dragon hunter crossbow and dragon hunter lance are effective.
Hydras alternate ranged and magic attacks, switching after three attacks; pray against the style you have the lowest defence towards and switch when the hydra switches.
After roughly 30 seconds hydras spit poison at three random tiles dealing 4 poison damage every two ticks; poison immunity reduces this to 1-2 damage.
The Alchemical Hydra boss can only be killed while on a hydra Slayer task and is the lucrative alternative for the task.
No task-extension unlock exists for Hydras; Konar assigns 125-190 at weight 10.
Blocking high-weight Konar tasks such as metal dragons, wyrms, drakes, abyssal demons, cave krakens, and black demons increases hydra assignment odds.
Brimstone keys drop from task-only kills in Konar-assigned areas.

slayerTargetId 245 is a synthetic placeholder per the WC-1..11 contract (240 + WC index); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value for Hydras is unverified and detection falls back to the RuneLite task-name path.

Kill the 17 hydras in the task-only Karuulm area with ranged (their ranged defence is 0) using dragonbane weapons where owned, prayer-switching against their alternating ranged/magic attacks and stepping off poison tiles; or kill the Alchemical Hydra boss for profit while on task.

karuulm-slayer-dungeon-hydras.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon
notes: The task-only hydra area holds 17 hydras and is single-combat but cannonable. Boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots are required against the floor heat unless the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete.
17 Hydras in the task-only area of the dungeon.
Boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots are required against the dungeon floor heat unless the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete.

ice-giants.name: Ice giants
notes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 261 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Ice giants is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
Krystilia assigns ice giants as a Wilderness-only task; only Wilderness ice giant kills (Frozen Waste Plateau or Wilderness Slayer Cave) count.
Ice giants are weak to fire (100%); fire spells and any melee are effective given their very low defence.
The Wilderness Slayer Cave holds a higher-level combat level 67 variant that grants 100 Slayer XP and is multicombat/cannonable.
Vannaka assignments can instead be completed at Eldric the Ice King in the Royal Titans encounter. Ice giant task buffs do not apply to Branda; both bosses must still be fought.

Kill ice giants at the Frozen Waste Plateau or, for faster XP with a cannon, the level 67 variant in the Wilderness Slayer Cave. Ice giants have very low defence, so any strong melee weapon (or fire spells) works; wear low-risk Wilderness gear and keep a one-click escape teleport ready. On a Vannaka assignment, Eldric the Ice King is a boss alternative; use the shared Royal Titans preparation and bring all required combat styles.

frozen-waste-plateau.name: Frozen Waste Plateau
notes: Frozen Waste Plateau in the western Wilderness (around level 50). Ice giants (9 spawns) and ice warriors also spawn here. Bring low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport. The Slayer task/Ice giants table (pageid 566858) lists the Frozen Waste Plateau as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat).
9 ice giant spawns in the western Wilderness (around level 50).
Ice warriors also spawn here.
Single-way combat but cannonable and safespottable per the wiki Location Comparison.

wilderness-slayer-cave-ice-giants.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave (ice giants)
notes: The higher-level ice giant variant (combat level 67) spawns in the Wilderness Slayer Cave (around levels 18-22). Multicombat, cannonable, and burstable. The cave is a popular player-killing hotspot; stand as far south as practical to stay near one-click teleport range and do not risk items you are unwilling to lose.
14 spawns of the combat level 67 variant; multicombat, cannonable and safespottable per the wiki Location Comparison.
A popular player-killing hotspot; keep near one-click teleport range.

royal-titans-arena.name: Royal Titans
notes: Royal Titans encounter in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon. No quest, skill or item is required to access the encounter; prepare for both Branda and Eldric using the shared strategy. Solo and duo approaches are supported. The fight is outside the Wilderness and bosses are immune to cannons.
Eldric counts for Vannaka Ice giant assignments. Fight both Royal Titans using the shared complete encounter preparation.
The encounter has no access requirements and supports solo or duo play. It is outside the Wilderness and cannot satisfy Krystilia assignments.

ice-warriors.name: Ice warriors
notes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 262 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Ice warriors is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
SHARED family: Krystilia (Wilderness, 100-150) and Mazchna (starter, 40-50) both assign ice warriors; only Wilderness kills count for Krystilia.
Ice warriors have 100% weakness to fire spells; fire spells are fastest, but their low-ish defence also falls to crush melee.
Turael and Spria do NOT assign ice warriors; only Mazchna does among the starter masters.
Frozen Waste Plateau is a Wilderness location; bring risk-appropriate gear and a one-click escape teleport.

Cast fire spells (Fire Bolt/Fire Blast) to exploit their 100% fire weakness, or use any strong crush/slash melee weapon such as a Dragon scimitar given their modest defence. Krystilia's task must be done at the Frozen Waste Plateau or another Wilderness spawn with risk-appropriate gear and an escape teleport; Mazchna's task can be done safely in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon.

frozen-waste-plateau.name: Frozen Waste Plateau
notes: Frozen Waste Plateau in the western Wilderness (around level 50). Ice giants (9 spawns) and ice warriors also spawn here. Bring low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport. The Slayer task/Ice giants table (pageid 566858) lists the Frozen Waste Plateau as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat).
Ice warriors and ice giants share the Frozen Waste Plateau in the western Wilderness (~level 50).
The Slayer task/Ice giants location table (pageid 566858) lists the plateau as cannonable and safespottable; cannon permission is area-based, so it applies to ice warriors here too.
Krystilia's task counts only here (or other Wilderness ice warrior spawns).

ice-warriors-area.name: Non-Wilderness ice warriors
notes: Non-Wilderness ice warriors for Mazchna's starter task: the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon (south of Port Sarim) and White Wolf Mountain, plus God Wars Dungeon routes. Multicombat, cannon, and safespot status are not documented on the wiki and are left conservative (false).
Asgarnian Ice Dungeon and White Wolf Mountain hold ice warriors for Mazchna's starter task.
Multi and cannon status are not wiki-stated, so treated conservatively as false.

icefiends.name: Icefiend
notes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 293 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Icefiends is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
Assigned by Turael (15-20) and Spria (15-20) in this dataset; no Slayer level required (slayerLevel 1). Their combat-level threshold is around 20.
100% weak to fire spells: cast Fire Strike/Bolt/Wave (fire-battlestaff plugin weapon). weakness.style MAGIC / element fire.
Attacks with magical melee, so Protect from Magic reduces incoming damage; max hit is only 2.
A level-18 Icefiend variant exists at some spawns; the default variant pins the level-13 Ice Mountain form.

Icefiends are a low-level Turael/Spria task on top of Ice Mountain (and the God Wars Dungeon entrance). They are 100% weak to fire spells, so cast a fire spell (Fire Strike, Bolt or Wave) with a fire staff for the fastest kills. Defence is only 12 and their max hit is 2 (magical melee), so Protect from Magic and a couple of food are ample. They can be safespotted behind the rocks on the mountain.

ice-mountain.name: Ice Mountain
notes: Icefiends on top of Ice Mountain, north-west of Falador and west of Edgeville. They can be safespotted behind the rocks. Multi and cannon are not wiki-stated and left conservative (false).
Around 10 Icefiend spawns on top of Ice Mountain, north-west of Falador / west of Edgeville.
Icefiends can be safespotted behind rocks; multi and cannon are not wiki-stated and treated conservatively as false.

infernal-mages.name: Infernal Mages
notes: Infernal Mages require 45 Slayer and Priest in Peril for Morytania access. Vannaka assigns 40-90 (weight 8); Mortimer assigns a base 35-50 (weight 10), before task modifiers. Each master also has their own access requirements.
Chaeldar stopped assigning Infernal Mages on 8 May 2024, and Duradel on 10 September 2015.

Infernal Mages have 60 Hitpoints, a max hit of 8 and a 4-tick Magic attack. Their Magic level is 75, Defence level 60, and defensive bonuses are 0 against melee/ranged and +40 against Magic. No elemental weakness is listed.
Protect from Magic negates their attacks. They are immune to weak burns.
The superior encounter is the Malevolent Mage; it is not a separately selectable repeatable setup.
No task extension unlock is listed. Mortimer can offer a quantity modifier.
Completed Morytania Diary tiers grant 2.5%, 5%, 7.5% or 10% bonus Slayer experience in the tower.

Melee Infernal Mages in the north-east room on the first floor of the Slayer Tower. Use your best owned melee equipment and a Slayer helmet or black mask on task. Protect from Magic (37 Prayer) blocks their magic attacks; bring prayer restoration and food. Cannons cannot be used in the tower.

slayer-tower.name: Slayer Tower
notes: Bloodvelds on the first floor can be safespotted and receive additional Slayer experience from completed Morytania Diary tiers; other Slayer Tower tasks may have different floor-specific mechanics.
Fairy ring CKS is beside the Slayer Tower (needs a Dramen or Lunar staff).
Infernal Mages are found only in the Slayer Tower, in the north-east room on the first floor (one level above ground). The Wiki lists 15 spawn tiles.
A Slayer ring teleports to the entrance. Alternatives include fairy ring CKS south of the tower, Salve Graveyard Teleport, or Kharyrll teleport to Canifis, then running north-west.

Fenkenstrain's Castle Teleport followed by a run west, an Ectophial followed by a longer walk, or walking through Paterdomus are further alternatives. Shortest Path checks available transports and their unlocks.
Use the south-east stairs. The normal ground-floor route passes Banshees, so wear Earmuffs or a Slayer helmet while passing them; the eastern broken-window shortcut at 18 Agility avoids that route.

The 61 Agility spiked chain reaches the Aberrant spectre room instead. Wear a Nose peg or Slayer helmet if taking that route; 60 Slayer is needed to equip a Nose peg, not to use the stairs to Infernal Mages.
Cannons are prohibited throughout the Slayer Tower. The Infernal Mage page does not document a safespot; their Magic attacks can still reach ranged attackers.

jellies.name: Jellies
notes: Jellies can be assigned by Krystilia, Vannaka, Chaeldar, and Konar upon reaching 52 Slayer and 57 combat.
Jellies attack with magic-based melee; Protect from Melee will negate all damage taken.
Jellies have an unusually high Defence level compared to other similar monsters around their level.
In multicombat areas, Jellies may be killed with Magic for the fastest possible kills by using multi-target Ancient Magicks such as Ice Burst or Ice Barrage.
Ranged with the Venator bow is a lower-effort alternative that cannot match Magic kill speed.
Krystilia tasks must be completed in the Wilderness, at the Wilderness Slayer Cave.
Warped Jellies in the Catacombs of Kourend have a better loot table and drop ancient shards and dark totem pieces.
Chilled Jellies in the Ruins of Tapoyauik are 50% susceptible to fire spells and sit in a single combat area.
Jellies drop hard clue scrolls, making them a popular clue farming target.
Vitreous, Vitreous warped, and Vitreous chilled Jellies are the superior versions unlocked with Bigger and Badder.
The slayerTargetId 242 is SYNTHETIC (WC-1..11 allocation contract, 240 + WC index); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.

Melee with Protect from Melee is the simple default. In the multicombat Catacombs of Kourend, Ice Burst or Ice Barrage Warped Jellies for the fastest kills; the Venator bow is a low-effort ranged alternative.

fremennik-slayer-dungeon.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
notes: Contains standard Basilisks. A mirror shield or V's shield is required to avoid basilisk gaze damage and stat drain.
Slayer ring teleports to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (Rellekka).
Safespotting is possible by firing over the corner of the rocks in the west and south sides.

catacombs-of-kourend.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: Black demons here can be safespotted and give access to Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces, but their higher Defence makes them an inefficient Black demons task option. Mutated bloodvelds appear in three groups, can be safespotted, and use the Catacombs drop table including ancient shards and dark totem pieces. Brutal blue dragons here are safespottable, cannot be cannoned, and can drop ancient shards and Dark totem parts. Hellhounds here are multicombat, safespottable, cannot be cannoned, and can reset aggression by running south and up the vine to the Giants' Den.
Xeric's Heart (Xeric's talisman) is beside the Catacombs entrance.
Warped Jellies here have a better loot table, including ancient shards and dark totem pieces.
Safespotting is possible by firing over corners.
Multicombat - Ice Burst or Ice Barrage give the fastest kills.

wilderness-slayer-cave-jellies.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: Contains 9 Jellies. Multicombat and cannonable; safespottable per the task page. Popular player killing hotspot - keep a one-click teleport such as a royal seed pod ready and do not risk items you are unwilling to lose.
Players can easily escape with a one-click teleport such as a royal seed pod.
Popular player killing hotspot - do not risk items you are unwilling to lose.

ruins-of-tapoyauik-jellies.name: Ruins of Tapoyauik
notes: Requires The Heart of Darkness. Contains 10 Chilled Jellies in a single-combat area; they can be safespotted by standing behind the smaller icicles. Chilled Jellies are 50% susceptible to fire spells.
Chilled Jellies can be safespotted by standing behind the smaller icicles.
Single combat area; Chilled Jellies are 50% susceptible to fire spells.

jungle-horrors.name: Jungle horrors
notes: Jungle horrors require 65 combat and completion of Cabin Fever; there is no Slayer level requirement.
Jungle horrors roam the Mos Le'Harmless island surface, not the Mos Le'Harmless Cave (that cave holds Cave horrors).
The task is assigned by Vannaka (40-90, weight 8) and Chaeldar (70-130, weight 10) and is not extendable.
Jungle horrors have a 25% elemental weakness to fire spells.
They drop pineapples frequently; bringing a knife lets the drops be sliced for food to extend trips.
Players under 70 Defence should bring food and decent armour; safespots behind walls, plants, and trees avoid damage entirely.

slayerTargetId 250 is a SYNTHETIC placeholder (240 + WC index 10, team contract 2026-07-02, Frost-Dragons precedent); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value for Jungle horrors is not wiki-published, so varp-based detection falls back to the task-name path.
Melee them with your best weapon, or pick them off from wall, plant, and tree safespots; fire spells exploit their 25% elemental weakness. Slice dropped pineapples with a knife for free food.

mos-le-harmless.name: Mos Le'Harmless
notes: Requires Cabin Fever to reach the island. About 50 Jungle horror spawns roam the surface, densest in the camp north of the cave exit; walls, plants, and trees provide safespots. Multicombat and cannon-placement status of the surface are unverified on the wiki, so both default to false. Jungle horrors are not cannon-immune and the island surface is not a prohibited area, so a cannon can be used (single-combat).
Roughly 50 Jungle horror spawns across the island surface; the largest camp holds 10-12 north of the cave exit.
Multiple safespots are available using walls, plants, and trees.

Jungle horrors are not immune to cannon damage (monster page immunecannon=No) and Mos Le'Harmless is not a cannon-prohibited area, so a cannon can be set up; the island surface is single-combat (no wiki task table exists, multicombat treated as false).

kalphite.name: Kalphite
notes: Kalphites can be assigned as a Slayer task at 15 combat by all Slayer masters with the exception of Wilderness Slayer master Krystilia.
Kalphites are available from all non-Wilderness Slayer masters because they come in a wide variety of levels.
They can be found in the Kalphite Lair in the north-west Kharidian Desert and in the task-exclusive Kalphite Cave east of Shantay Pass.
Kalphites come in workers, soldiers, guardians, and the boss monster the Kalphite Queen.
With the exception of the Queen, all Kalphites use melee attacks.
Soldiers and guardians can induce poison starting at 4 and 6 Hitpoints damage respectively, and this poison bypasses protection prayers.
Protect from Melee and poison immunity completely negate damage from workers, soldiers, and guardians.
Normal Kalphite tasks should be done at the Kalphite Cave because it has five chambers with many Kalphites and faster completion times.
If Konar forces the task to the Kalphite Lair, soldiers should be cannoned for fast task progression.
Players who want a quick task should cannon workers.
Players looking for experience should cannon soldiers instead.
Guardians will generally never be optimal because they are sparse, larger, and have a worse cost/experience ratio than soldiers.
Killing the Kalphite Queen is not recommended unless the player is progressing the Elite Desert diary or has completed it and has 86 Agility.
Without the Hard Desert Diary, two ropes are likely needed for every Kalphite Queen trip.
The keris dagger from Contact! increases damage against all kalphites by 33% and has a 1/51 chance to deal a hit with tripled damage, but its low stats make it a poor regular-task choice.
The Keris partisan from Beneath Cursed Sands is stronger, more accurate, deals more damage, and has a crush option for Kalphite weakness.
The Keris partisan of breaching requires 80 Attack and adds an additional 33% accuracy against Kalphites, letting it outperform many expensive weapons for a fraction of the price.

Use the Kalphite Cave for normal tasks: cannon workers for the quickest completion or soldiers for better experience. Bring Protect from Melee, poison immunity, and a Keris partisan or Keris partisan of breaching when available.

kurask.name: Kurask
notes: Kurasks can be assigned as a Slayer task by medium and high level Slayer masters upon reaching 70 Slayer and 65 combat.

The Bones to Peaches method requires more attention and is unlocked from the Mage Training Arena.
King kurask is the superior version unlocked with Bigger and Badder.
King kurask has no special mechanics, but is significantly more accurate and has a max hit of 33.
When using Bones to Peaches, turn on Protect from Melee and use at least one Prayer potion if a King kurask spawns.
Kurasks are weakest to stab, ranged, and magic attacks.
Kurasks have the leafy attribute and can only be damaged with leaf-bladed weapons, broad-tipped ammunition, or Magic Dart.
Cannons and Thralls will not deal any damage to Kurasks.
Special attacks from Saradomin godsword, Ancient godsword, and Toxic blowpipe can still heal the player as if the attack rolled damage.
Special attacks from Ancient mace and Eldritch nightmare staff can restore prayer points based on rolled damage.

Kurasks frequently drop High Alchemy weapons and armour with Nature runes.
Players should bring an Herb sack because Kurasks always drop three herbs when they roll the herb drop table.
Kurasks also drop seeds, coins, noted white berries, noted big bones, coconuts, and papaya fruit.
Kurasks in the Iorwerth Dungeon additionally drop Crystal shards, and King Kurasks there always drop Crystal shards.
Kurasks have a small aggressive range of 2 centered on their south-west tile.

Use leaf-bladed battleaxe melee, broad ammunition ranged, or Magic Dart only. Protect from Melee is simplest; 75 Defence accounts can use Bones to Peaches for cheaper longer trips, but should pray if King kurask spawns.
