Mammoths roam the Wilderness south-east of Ferox Enclave.
Their high HP makes this an efficient Dwarf multicannon spot; a nearby altar gives unlimited Prayer and Ferox Enclave is a short resupply walk.
Easily safespotted behind the many trees and tree stumps thanks to their 3x3 size.
Wilderness area: beware player killers and avoid carrying excess supplies.

metal-dragons.name: Metal dragons
notes: Metal dragons can be assigned by high-level Slayer masters as a potential task.
Partial completion of Dragon Slayer I is required.
Bronze dragons are found in Brimhaven Dungeon and the Catacombs of Kourend and are the lowest level option.
Iron dragons are found in the same locations as bronze dragons, are more plentiful, and can also be found in the Isle of Souls Dungeon.
Steel dragons are found in Brimhaven Dungeon and the Catacombs of Kourend.
Mithril dragons are found in the Ancient Cavern, requiring the first part of Barbarian Firemaking.
Adamant dragons and rune dragons are found in Lithkren Vault and require Dragon Slayer II.
Of these dragons, only mithril dragons cannot be cannoned.
All metal dragons can use melee and long range dragonfire, which rolls differently from chromatic dragonfire.
Unlike chromatic dragons, metal dragons aren't affected by Protect from Magic against dragonfire.
An anti-dragon shield is mandatory if not using a super antifire potion.
Mithril, adamant and rune dragons can use both magic and ranged attacks.
Adamant and rune dragons have special ranged attacks that mimic ruby and onyx enchanted bolts respectively.
All metal dragons have the draconic attribute and are susceptible to dragon hunter lance, dragon hunter crossbow, and dragon hunter wand.
Metal dragons are weakest to stab and heavy ranged attacks, although higher level metal dragons resist heavy ranged more.
All metal dragons have a 50% vulnerability to earth spells.
For a fast task, kill bronze dragons in Brimhaven Dungeon's slayer-only area where five are in a small cannonable area.
iron dragons may be cannoned if seeking the draconic visage, as bronze dragons do not drop it.
For profit, kill rune dragons instead.
Other metal dragons are generally not recommended except for collection log purposes.
Metal dragons have an incredibly high weight as a Slayer task, so players should decide whether to block them based on the tasks they want.

For speed, cannon bronze dragons in Brimhaven Dungeon's task-only area. Cannon iron dragons if chasing draconic visage, use rune dragons for profit, and bring full dragonfire protection plus dragonbane, stab, heavy ranged, or earth spell setups.
Required protection or damage restriction: anti-dragon shield or super antifire potion

brimhaven-dungeon-metal-dragons-task-onl.name: Brimhaven Dungeon (task-only metal dragons)
notes: Task-only area with 5 bronze, 9 iron, and 9 steel dragons. Requires dungeon access payment and an axe from the north entrance; Elite Karamja Diary can toggle noted bar drops.
5 bronze, 9 iron, and 9 steel dragons.
An axe is needed if entering via the north entrance, requiring 10 Woodcutting.
875 coins entry each time, a one-time 1,000,000 coin fee, or one-off 5000 trading sticks alternate entry.
Fairy ring code CKR then north to the dungeon.
Elite Karamja Diary allows noted bar drops to be toggled through Pirate Jackie the Fruit.

brimhaven-dungeon-metal-dragons.name: Brimhaven Dungeon
notes: Standard Brimhaven metal dragon area with 3 bronze, 13 iron, and 4 steel dragons. Requires dungeon access payment and an axe from the north entrance; Elite Karamja Diary can toggle noted bar drops.
3 bronze, 13 iron, and 4 steel dragons.
An axe is needed if entering via the north entrance, requiring 10 Woodcutting.
875 coins entry each time, a one-time 1,000,000 coin fee, or one-off 5000 trading sticks alternate entry.
Fairy ring code CKR then north to the dungeon.
Elite Karamja Diary allows noted bar drops to be toggled through Pirate Jackie the Fruit.

catacombs-of-kourend-metal-dragons.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: Contains 5 bronze, 2 iron, and 2 steel dragons. These Catacombs metal dragons are stronger than their normal counterparts and can drop Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces.
5 bronze, 2 iron, and 2 steel dragons.
Monsters in the Catacombs of Kourend are stronger than their normal counterparts.
Drops Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces.
Fastest route is Xeric's talisman to Xeric's Heart or Kourend Castle Teleport after Client of Kourend.

isle-of-souls-dungeon-metal-dragons.name: Isle of Souls Dungeon
notes: Contains 3 iron dragons and supports cannoning.
3 iron dragons.
Cannonable single-combat option for Iron dragons.

ancient-cavern-metal-dragons.name: Ancient Cavern
notes: Upper level contains 7 mithril dragons. Requires the first part of Barbarian Firemaking with 35 Firemaking; teleport to Barbarian Outpost and run south for quick access.
7 mithril dragons.
The cavern can only be accessed after completing the first part of Barbarian Firemaking, requiring 35 Firemaking.
Teleport to the Barbarian Outpost and run south to quickly reach the dragons.

lithkren-vault-metal-dragons.name: Lithkren Vault
notes: Contains 5 adamant and 5 rune dragons. Only accessible after completion of Dragon Slayer II.
5 adamant and 5 rune dragons.
Only accessible after completion of Dragon Slayer II.

minotaurs.name: Minotaur
notes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 296 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Minotaurs is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
Assigned by Turael (10-20) and Spria (10-20) in this dataset; no Slayer level required (slayerLevel 1). Their combat-level threshold is around 7.
All defensive bonuses are -21, so any combat style is highly accurate against them; there is no elemental weakness (weakness.element honest null).

Free-to-play task on the first level (Vault of War) of the Stronghold of Security. Uses a tuned copy stronghold-of-security-minotaurs rather than the Ankou-specific base file (whose safespot/konarLockable/cannon flags do not apply).

Minotaurs are a free-to-play Turael/Spria task on the first level (Vault of War) of the Stronghold of Security beneath Barbarian Village. Their defensive bonuses are all -21, so any weapon is extremely accurate - bring whatever you train with and a Slayer helmet. Their max hit is only 2, so barely any food is needed; they are ideal early combat and Slayer training.

stronghold-of-security-minotaurs.name: Stronghold of Security (Minotaurs)
notes: Minotaurs in the Vault of War (first level) of the Stronghold of Security, entered via the ladder in Barbarian Village. Family-tuned copy of the stronghold-of-security base file, whose Ankou safespot/konarLockable/cannon flags do not apply to minotaurs. Multi, cannon and safespot status are not wiki-stated and left conservative (false).
Minotaurs spawn densely in the Vault of War (first level) of the Stronghold of Security.

Commonly safespotted for Ranged training: the central room south of the spiked chains, the room east of the floor start behind the spiked fences, and the large south-easternmost room behind the spiked fence.
The Stronghold of Security is not on the cannon-prohibited list, but cannon use here is not wiki-documented, so cannonable is left conservatively false.

mogres.name: Mogres
notes: Mogres require 32 Slayer, combat level 30, and completion of Skippy and the Mogres to be assigned by Mazchna.
slayerTargetId 297 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
A fishing explosive is used on the sand/mud patches at Mudskipper Point to lure each Mogre out; requiredItemId 6664 is Fishing explosive (wiki item infobox id); it is an inventory lure, not worn.
Mogre has 48 Hitpoints, max hit 8 (Crush), 6-tick attack speed, and Defence level 48 with all defensive bonuses 0.

Mogre has a 20% elemental weakness to earth spells; weakness.style is MELEE because all defensive bonuses are 0 and melee is the standard kill, with the minor earth weakness documented for a Magic alternative.
No task extension unlock exists for Mogres.

Complete Skippy and the Mogres, then travel to Mudskipper Point (south of Rimmington). Use a fishing explosive on the mud patches to lure a Mogre out of the sand, then kill it with melee. Mogres have no defensive bonuses, so any melee weapon works; the minor 20% earth weakness makes earth spells a viable Magic alternative. Bring food, as they hit up to 8.

mudskipper-point.name: Mudskipper Point
notes: Mudskipper Point is south of Rimmington on the south-western coast. Mogres hide in the sand and must be lured out with a fishing explosive used on the mud patches; Skippy and the Mogres must be complete. The Slayer task/Ogres table (pageid 298279) lists Mudskipper Point mogres as cannonable (3 spawns), and the Mogre page documents a halberd/cannon safespot.
Mogres hide in the sand at Mudskipper Point (south of Rimmington); use a fishing explosive on an Ominous Fishing Spot to lure one out.

Skippy and the Mogres unlocks fighting the lured Mogres; since Sailing, ocean Mogres can instead be killed with cannons from a boat, needing neither the miniquest nor fishing explosives (level 32 Slayer required either way).
All defensive bonuses are 0, so any melee weapon is effective; a minor 20% earth weakness exists for a Magic alternative.
Cannonable and safespottable at Mudskipper Point (fairy ring, the western STASH unit, or along the shoreline, including a halberd/cannon safespot); a Protect from Melee altar sits just north.

molanisks.name: Molanisks
notes: Only Vannaka assigns Molanisks in this dataset (40-50, weighting 7); verified against Vannaka's raw task table on 2026-07-03.
Chaeldar and Duradel formerly assigned Molanisks but no longer do (Duradel removed 10 September 2015; Chaeldar removed 8 May 2024).
Requires 39 Slayer, combat level 50, and completion of Death to the Dorgeshuun; the task infobox id 10997 is used as slayerTargetId.
A Slayer bell is required to lure each Molanisk off the cave wall before it can be attacked; requiredItemId 10952 is Slayer bell (wiki item infobox id).
Molanisk has 52 Hitpoints, max hit 5 (Crush), 4-tick attack speed, Defence level 50 (stab 45, slash 45, crush 35, magic 30, ranged 55).
60% earth elemental weakness (Summer Sweep Up: Combat, 25 June 2025); weakness.style is MELEE (crush is lowest melee defence) with element 'earth' recorded for a Magic alternative.
No task extension unlock exists for Molanisks.

Complete Death to the Dorgeshuun, then bring a Slayer bell, a light source and a rope to descend into the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon (near fairy ring AJQ). Ring the Slayer bell within 3 tiles of a wall-attached Molanisk to lure it off, then kill it with crush melee (they have the lowest defence against crush). They hit only up to 5, so a mid-level player in decent armour can kill several safely. The 60% earth weakness makes earth spells a strong Magic alternative, and certain rocks (notably south of the AJQ fairy ring) can be used to safespot.

dorgesh-kaan-south-dungeon.name: Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon
notes: Underground dungeon south of Dorgesh-Kaan, near fairy ring AJQ. Entry requires completion of Death to the Dorgeshuun and a rope to climb down; a light source is required. Home to Molanisks, which disguise on the cave walls and must be lured off with a Slayer bell. A Dwarf multicannon can be used and certain rocks (notably the large rock south of the AJQ fairy ring) provide safespots. Multi is not wiki-confirmed (conservative default).
Around 10 Molanisks spawn in the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon (near fairy ring AJQ).
Entry to the dungeon requires completion of Death to the Dorgeshuun and a rope to climb down; a light source is required.
Safespottable on certain rocks, notably the large rock down the path south of the AJQ fairy ring.
A spot south of the fairy ring has two spawns close together for faster kills.

monkeys.name: Monkeys
notes: Monkeys has no combat or Slayer level requirement and is assigned by Turael or Spria (Mazchna does not assign Monkeys).
slayerTargetId 298 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
Monkey: combat level 3, 6 HP, max hit 1 (crush), Defence 2 with no bonuses (npc 1038/2848).
Only wiki-confirmed npcIds (1038, 2848) are recorded; other Karamja/Ape Atoll monkey spawn ids are honest-UNKNOWN (not fabricated).
Monkeys are not undead, so the salve amulet does not apply. No task extension unlock exists for Monkeys.
The task table also counts Monkey Archers, Monkey Guards, Monkey Zombies, Maniacal monkeys, Tortured gorillas and Demonic gorillas; access to these alternatives is quest-gated.

Kill common monkeys (combat level 3) on Karamja with any weapon; with 6 Hitpoints and no defensive bonuses they die in one or two hits. Ape Atoll and Mos Le'Harmless monkeys also count. Demonic gorillas are a harder alternative with a dedicated strategy and quest requirements.

monkey-spawns.name: Monkey spawns
notes: Common monkeys (combat level 3) are scattered across Karamja (south-east, near Shilo Village, around Brimhaven and the volcano, east of Tai Bwo Wannai), Ape Atoll, Mos Le'Harmless and the Ardougne Zoo. Karamja spawns are the most convenient. Maniacal monkeys and the boss Kruk / M'amba do NOT count toward this task. The Slayer task/Monkeys table (pageid 298251) lists essentially every monkey spot as cannonable (single-combat).
Karamja holds numerous monkey clusters and is the most convenient place to complete the task.

Nearly every monkey spawn is cannonable per the wiki; the Karamja overworld clusters shown here are single-combat and not safespottable, while spots such as Marim, Temple of Marimbo and Ape Atoll Dungeon are multicombat and/or safespottable.

moss-giants.name: Moss giants
notes: Moss giants can be assigned by Krystilia only, as a Wilderness task (100-150 per assignment, weight 4); kills must occur in the Wilderness to count.
Krystilia's block cost for a task is 100 Slayer reward points.
Moss giants have 60 Hitpoints and Defence level 30, attack with crush, and carry a 50% Fire weakness.
The Wilderness moss giant spawns sit in the deep Wilderness; carry only what you can afford to lose as this is a PvP area.
The wiki does not document multicombat, cannon, or safespot suitability at the Wilderness spawn, so these flags are left conservatively false (honest UNKNOWN).
The slayerTargetId 266 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract, worklist §1); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.

Melee the moss giants with any decent weapon in the deep Wilderness; their 50% Fire weakness makes fire spells fastest, but melee is usually preferred to keep risk low in a PvP area. Bring only cheap, expendable gear.

moss-giants-wilderness.name: Deep Wilderness
notes: Moss giants spawn in the deep Wilderness (about 6 free-to-play spawns); only Wilderness kills count towards a Krystilia assignment. This is a PvP area, so bring only expendable gear. The Slayer task/Moss giants table (pageid 298114) lists the Wilderness canoe pond spot as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat, 6 spawns).
The Wilderness moss giant spawns (about 6, by the pond reachable using a canoe) are the only spawns that count towards a Krystilia assignment.
Single-combat spawn that is cannonable and has a safespot (single moss giant behind the northernmost tree), useful for low-level Wilderness Slayer; beware player killers.

mutated-zygomites.name: Mutated zygomites
notes: The wiki task page is titled Zygomites; Slayer masters refer to the assignment as Mutated zygomites.
Zygomites cannot be killed unless a fungicide spray is used to deliver the final blow.
requiredItemId 7421 is the fully-charged Fungicide spray 10 (wiki item infobox id); partially-used sprays use ids 7422-7430, so an owned check against 7421 can miss a part-used spray.
Regular Zygomites must be picked from Fungi before they can be attacked.
Zygomites mostly use magical melee headbutts and occasionally use stronger magical ranged spore attacks.
Dragonhide armour or Karil's armour is strongly recommended because high Magic defence reduces incoming damage.
Protect from Melee is recommended when praying against regular Zygomites because their melee attacks are more accurate.
Ancient Zygomites use magical melee and magical ranged attacks; their ranged attacks are stronger and more accurate, so Protect from Missiles can be considered for ancient-only trips.
Ancient Zygomites can be safespotted by trapping them and standing at least six tiles away because their ranged attack reaches five tiles.
Ancient Zygomites always drop Mort myre fungus, making a Reagent pouch useful on Ancient Zygomite trips.
Konar location locks matter: a Zanaris task requires regular Zygomites, while a Fossil Island task requires Ancient Zygomites because no regular variants are on Fossil Island.
'Shroom sprayer costs 110 Slayer points and automatically delivers the finishing blow if the player has Fungicide spray and Fungicide.

Bring fungicide spray and refills, wear dragonhide or Karil's for magic defence, use Protect from Melee for regular Zygomites, safespot where available, and use Ancient Zygomites with a Reagent pouch when location locks allow.

zanaris-furnace-zygomites.name: Zanaris east of the furnace
notes: Contains 5 level 74 and 86 Zygomites east of the Zanaris furnace. Requires Lost City access, 57 Slayer, and Fungicide spray to finish kills.
East of the furnace in Zanaris.
Contains five level 74 and 86 Zygomites.

zanaris-cosmic-altar-zygomites.name: Zanaris near the Cosmic Altar
notes: Contains 5 level 74 and 86 Zygomites near the Cosmic Altar. Can be safespotted by trapping them on a pillar and standing back near the mysterious ruins.
Near the Cosmic Altar in Zanaris.
Can be safespotted by trapping Zygomites on a pillar and standing near the mysterious ruins.

fossil-island-mushroom-forest-zygomites.name: Mushroom Forest
notes: Contains 27 Ancient Zygomites in the Mushroom Forest on Fossil Island. Valid for Zygomites tasks unless Konar locks the assignment to Zanaris.
Mushroom Forest on Fossil Island.
Contains twenty-seven Ancient Zygomites and is valid unless a Konar task locks the player to Zanaris.

stalker-den-zygomites.name: Stalker Den
notes: Contains 9 Ancient Zygomites in the Stalker Den under Custodia Pass. The area is multicombat, cannonable, and safespottable.
Stalker Den in Custodia Pass.
Contains nine Ancient Zygomites in multicombat.

nechryael.name: Nechryael
notes: Nechryael are a type of demon assigned at 80 Slayer and 85 combat.
They are an extremely good Slayer task because of frequent herbs, seeds, and alchable drops.
Nechryael attack with melee and periodically summon up to two death spawns.
death spawn attacks have a max hit of 2, use typeless melee, and Protect from Melee has no effect on them.
Death spawns can attack in single-combat areas even when the player is already in combat.
Bring food when using Melee or runes for blood spells when using Magic to manage death spawn chip damage.
Greater Nechryael are mechanically the same as regular Nechryael but have higher stats and a more lucrative drop table.
Both regular and Greater Nechryael share Nechryarch as their superior, although the common drop table follows whichever variant spawned it.
Nechryarch can summon a trio of chaotic death spawn, one each using melee, magic, and ranged.
Chaotic death spawn attacks hit much harder than normal death spawns, but can be blocked with prayer.
Nechryarch chaotic death spawns only appear if the Nechryarch can attack the player, so safespots or farcasting prevent the summon.
Fast tasks are encouraged in the Catacombs with fourteen Greater Nechryael split into two chambers of seven each.
A goading potion is ideal in the Catacombs because Nechryael are not aggressive and luring is needed for high experience rates.
If not using Magic on Greater Nechryael, the task page recommends melee in Iorwerth Dungeon because Catacombs melee is likely to be crashed and Iorwerth drops crystal shards.
For Krystilia assignments, use the Wilderness Slayer Cave, bring a goading potion and a one-click teleport, and treat it as a popular player killing hotspot.
Normal Nechryael give lower Slayer experience rates, but Ironman players may value their seed drops and faster malicious ashes for Prayer experience.
Charred Dungeon requires 60 Sailing, is far from most locations without a docked boat and greater teleport focus, and is discouraged because the spawns are split into small groups.

Burst or barrage Greater Nechryael in the Catacombs with goading potion support for fast tasks; use Emberlight or Arclight for melee Nechryael, Iorwerth Dungeon for non-magic Greater Nechryael, and Wilderness precautions for Krystilia tasks.

slayer-tower-top-floor-nechryael.name: Slayer Tower (top floor)
notes: Contains 11 Nechryael on the Slayer Tower top floor. The task-page comparison marks this area single-combat, not cannonable, and safespottable.
Slayer Tower top floor.
Contains 11 regular Nechryael.

slayer-tower-basement-nechryael.name: Slayer Tower (basement)
notes: Contains 12 Nechryael in the Slayer Tower basement. They can only be killed on a slayer task; the task-page comparison marks the area single-combat, not cannonable, and safespottable.
Slayer Tower basement.
Can only be killed on a slayer task.

catacombs-of-kourend-nechryael.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: Contains 14 Greater Nechryael in two chambers of seven each. Easily accessible with a portal attuned to Great Kourend or with Xeric's talisman; not cannonable and not safespottable on the task page.
Contains 14 Greater Nechryael in two chambers of seven each.
Easily accessible with a portal attuned to Great Kourend or with Xeric's talisman.

wilderness-slayer-cave-nechryael.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: Contains 8 Greater Nechryael in the Wilderness Slayer Cave task-only area. This is a dangerous multicombat area popular with player-killers; do not bring items that you are unwilling to lose.
Can only be killed on a slayer task.
Dangerous multicombat area, popular with player-killers. Do not bring items that you are unwilling to lose.

iorwerth-dungeon-nechryael.name: Iorwerth Dungeon
notes: Contains 16 Greater Nechryael. Quickly accessed with a teleport crystal, requires Song of the Elves, supports a dwarf multicannon, and Greater Nechryael killed here can drop crystal shards.
Quickly accessed with a teleport crystal.
Requires completion of Song of the Elves.
Greater Nechryael killed here can drop crystal shards.

charred-dungeon-nechryael.name: Charred Dungeon
notes: Contains 11 regular Nechryael. Requires 60 Sailing to access; the task page discourages this area because the Nechryael are divided into two low-density groups and the dungeon is far from most routes without a docked boat and greater teleport focus.
Requires level 60 Sailing to access.
Contains regular Nechryael split into two low-density groups, so it is discouraged for barraging.

ogres.name: Ogres
notes: Ogres are assigned only by Vannaka (40-90) at combat level 40; there is no Slayer level or quest requirement for the task itself, and no extended range.
Ogres are most commonly found in Kandarin.
Along with ogres, Ogress Warriors and Ogress Shamans, Mogres, Zogres, and Skogres all count towards the task. Jogres do NOT count.
Zogres and Skogres have a lower combat level but can inflict disease, so take caution; brutal arrows work best against them.

Individual variants carry their own access requirements: Mogres need 32 Slayer (and Skippy and the Mogres / Fishing explosives), Ogresses need The Corsair Curse progress or 10 Agility, and Zogres/Skogres need Zogre Flesh Eaters progress.
Players with 41 Magic can use ensouled ogre heads to cast Adept Reanimation and kill reanimated ogres.
The infobox id field is 'No', so this task has no SLAYER_TARGET id (slayerTargetId left null).

The best spot is the level 53 ogres west of Yanille, where you can safespot behind the stone wall and/or use a Dragon cannon. Ogres attack with crush, have low Defence, and are 20% weak to earth spells, so any combat style works. Zogres and Skogres at Jiggig require brutal arrows and can inflict disease.

chaos-druid-tower-dungeon.name: Chaos Druid Tower Dungeon
notes: Dungeon beneath the Chaos Druid Tower near Ardougne; requires 46 Thieving to open the door. Level 53 ogres here; fairly unpopulated, cannonable and safespottable.
Level 53 ogres; requires 46 Thieving. This location is fairly unpopulated.

clock-tower-dungeon.name: Clock Tower Dungeon
notes: Dungeon beneath the Clock Tower south of Ardougne. Small number of level 53 ogres; cannonable and safespottable.
Level 53 ogres.

combat-training-camp.name: Combat Training Camp
notes: North-west of West Ardougne. Requires completion of Biohazard to access. Home of the level 63 ogre variant; cannonable and safespottable.
Level 63 ogres. Requires completion of Biohazard.

corsair-cove-dungeon.name: Corsair Cove Dungeon
notes: Requires Dragon Slayer II. Corsair Cove Dungeon black dragons are close to a bank using a Mythical cape teleport. Blue dragon area contains 5 adults and 3 babies, is cannonable, and can be safespotted.
Mythical cape teleports to Corsair Cove (requires Dragon Slayer II).
Ogress Warriors and Ogress Shamans (level 82). The entrance is a commonly used safespot, so expect not to be able to use it. Ogress shamans offer a unique cosmetic drop.

feldip-hills.name: Feldip Hills
notes: Level 53 ogres roam the Feldip Hills south of Yanille. The ogres here are fairly spread out; cannonable and safespottable.
Level 53 ogres; fairly spread out.

gnome-maze.name: Gnome Maze
notes: Only a single level 53 ogre spawn; cannonable and safespottable but not an efficient task spot.
Single level 53 ogre spawn.

god-wars-dungeon.name: God Wars Dungeon
notes: Bloodveld safespotting requires Saradomin and Zamorak item protection; first-time access requires rope. God Wars Bloodveld are Zamorak followers and no superior Bloodveld can spawn here. God Wars Hellhounds are Zamorak followers, count for Zamorak kill count, are safespottable, and are discouraged because their spawns are far and sparse. Spiritual creatures require Death Plateau and either 60 Strength or 60 Agility to receive assignments; main Spiritual creature variants require god-affiliated item protection for tolerance, with Zamorak and usually Saradomin protection recommended. Cannon nuance: a cannon can physically be set up in the God Wars Dungeon but its inhabitants may destroy it (Dwarf multicannon pageid 13551); wiki task tables split on the verdict (ogres/vampyres Yes, aviansie/bloodveld/hellhounds No), so trust the per-task row here.
Rope is required on first entry via the Trollheim crevice.
Level 58 ogres. As this is a multicombat area, other monsters will attack you.
The wiki lists this spot as cannonable, but God Wars Dungeon inhabitants can destroy a placed cannon.

gu-tanoth.name: Gu'Tanoth
notes: Ogre city south-east of Yanille. Requires partial completion of Watchtower to enter. Level 53 ogres are secluded across several areas; cannonable and safespottable.
Level 53 ogres; requires partial completion of Watchtower. The ogres in this area are secluded in many areas.

jiggig.name: Jiggig
notes: Ogre burial ground west of Castle Wars; Zogres and Skogres spawn here (requires Zogre Flesh Eaters progress). Multicombat, not cannonable, but safespottable. Brutal arrows work best.
Zogres and Skogres (level 44). Brutal arrows work best against Zogres and Skogres.

jiggig-dungeon.name: Jiggig Dungeon
notes: Dungeon beneath Jiggig with the largest concentration of Zogres and Skogres (requires Zogre Flesh Eaters progress). Not cannonable, but safespottable. Brutal arrows work best.
Zogres and Skogres (level 44). Brutal arrows work best against Zogres and Skogres.

mudskipper-point.name: Mudskipper Point
notes: Mudskipper Point is south of Rimmington on the south-western coast. Mogres hide in the sand and must be lured out with a fishing explosive used on the mud patches; Skippy and the Mogres must be complete. The Slayer task/Ogres table (pageid 298279) lists Mudskipper Point mogres as cannonable (3 spawns), and the Mogre page documents a halberd/cannon safespot.
Mogres (level 60). Fishing explosives are required to engage in combat with Mogres.

underground-pass-dungeon.name: Underground Pass (dungeon)
notes: Requires completion of Plague City to access the Underground Pass. Only two level 53 ogre spawns; cannonable but not safespottable.
Level 53 ogres. Requires completion of Plague City.

west-of-yanille.name: West of Yanille
notes: Open area of level 53 ogres just west of Yanille; the recommended place to kill ogres for the task. Ogres can be safespotted behind the stone wall and a cannon can be used.
Level 53 ogres; the recommended place to kill ogres for the task. Can be safespotted behind the stone wall.

wilderness-god-wars-dungeon.name: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon
notes: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon is a multicombat Wilderness area with player killing risk. Aviansie drop noted adamantite bars regardless of Fremennik Diary completion. Bloodveld access is closer through the Trollheim Agility shortcut with 64 Agility; God Wars followers are aggressive without god item protection. Cannon nuance: a cannon can physically be set up but GWD inhabitants may destroy it (Dwarf multicannon pageid 13551); wiki task tables split on the verdict, so trust the per-task row here.
Single level 58 ogre. As this is a multicombat Wilderness area, other monsters and players will attack you.
The wiki lists this spot as cannonable, but God Wars Dungeon inhabitants can destroy a placed cannon.

witchaven-dungeon.name: Witchaven Dungeon

Hellhounds here are multicombat, safespottable, cannot be cannoned, and can reset aggression by running south and up the vine to the Giants' Den.
Xeric's Heart (Xeric's talisman) is beside the Catacombs entrance.
Level-140 Shades here are safespottable and give 115 Slayer XP.
A reasonable alternative to Loar Shades for players who prefer higher Slayer XP per kill.

stronghold-of-security.name: Stronghold of Security
notes: Ankou safespot is in the Sepulchre of Death south-west room, on the south side of the south-easternmost skeleton.
Amulet of glory to Edgeville, then run west to the Stronghold of Security under Barbarian Village.
Level-159 Shades here have drastically reduced combat XP (1 XP per 10 damage) and only 4.2 Slayer XP; not recommended.
Cannonable and safespottable per the task table; safespot using a skeleton on the eastern side of the northern part of the room.

shadow-warriors.name: Shadow warriors
notes: Shadow warriors require 60 combat and completion of Legends' Quest to be assigned; there is no Slayer level requirement.
slayerTargetId 249 is SYNTHETIC (WC-1..11 allocation contract: 240 + WC index); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
Shadow warriors are found only in the Legends' Guild Dungeon (19 spawns).
They are not undead despite their ghostly appearance, so the Salve amulet does not apply.
Crush is their weakest melee defence (+19); stab (+43) and ranged (+38) are their strongest defences.
They can be safespotted through the fence separating them from the pit scorpions, or behind the fungus near the cavern wall.
They attack with slash melee at scimitar speed with a max hit of 6 and are hidden on the minimap.
No task extension unlock exists for Shadow warriors.

Kill the 19 Legends' Guild Dungeon shadow warriors with a crush weapon against their weakest defence, or safespot through the fence by the pit scorpions with ranged or magic. Low max hit makes this a low-risk task.

legends-guild-dungeon.name: Legends' Guild Dungeon
notes: 19 Shadow warrior spawns in the Legends' Guild Dungeon; completion of Legends' Quest is required for assignment and guild access. Safespot through the fence separating them from the pit scorpions or behind the fungus near the cavern wall. Multicombat and cannon placement are not wiki-stated for this area, so conservative defaults are used.
19 spawns; the sole Shadow warrior location.
Safespot through the fence by the pit scorpions or behind the fungus near the cavern wall.

skeletal-wyverns.name: Skeletal wyverns
notes: Skeletal wyverns require 72 Slayer to harm and 70 combat to be assigned.
Chaeldar, Konar quo Maten, Nieve/Steve, and Duradel/Kuradal assign Skeletal wyverns only after Elemental Workshop I is complete.
Use an elemental shield, mind shield, dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or ancient wyvern shield to reduce icy breath damage.
The ancient wyvern shield also grants immunity to the freezing effect from icy breath.
Icy breath can freeze the player; armour does not affect its accuracy, and players can still eat or drink while frozen.
Skeletal Wyverns are magically animated remains, not undead, so the Salve amulet and its enchanted versions do not work.
They are draconic creatures, so dragonbane weapons such as the dragon hunter lance and dragon hunter crossbow work.
They are one of the few monsters vulnerable to both dragonbane weapons and dragonfire effects.
They have a 25% elemental weakness to fire spells.
Protect from Missiles is suggested when not safespotting because they deal frequent ranged damage.
Safespotted kills usually require waiting out the 10 minutes of aggression before trapping a wyvern at the cave entrance or an ice structure.
The dwarf multicannon can be used in the lower Asgarnian Ice Dungeon, but not in the upper task-only area.
Killing a Skeletal Wyvern is required for the Hard Falador Diary.
They drop draconic visage, not wyvern visage, and are the only monster that drops granite legs.

Use the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon main or task-only area with an anti-icy-breath shield. Melee with dragon hunter lance is the strongest direct method; Ranged or Magic safespotting is safer after the 10-minute aggression timer, with Fire Magic benefiting from the 25% elemental weakness.

asgarnian-ice-dungeon.name: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon
notes: Entrance is south of Port Sarim and north of Mudskipper Point. Skeletal Wyverns are at the end of the dungeon; fairy ring AIQ and the Agility shortcuts can speed the route.
Main Skeletal Wyvern area at the end of the lower cave.
Entrance is south of Port Sarim and north of Mudskipper Point; fairy ring AIQ is a nearby route.
The lower cave allows dwarf multicannon use.
Door and pillar safespots are available after the wyverns lose aggression.

asgarnian-ice-dungeon-task-only.name: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon task-only area
notes: Task-only Skeletal Wyvern area reached by icy steps near the exit to the wyvern area; Steve/Pieve control access depending on Monkey Madness II progress.
Task-only area accessible via icy steps near the exit to the wyvern area.
Controlled by Steve before Monkey Madness II and Pieve after Monkey Madness II.

Has a task-only safespot.

skeletons.name: Skeletons
notes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 271 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Skeletons is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
SHARED family: Krystilia (Wilderness, 65-100) plus Turael/Spria (15-30) and Mazchna (30-50) starter masters all assign skeletons.
Skeletons are undead, so the Salve amulet applies; they are weakest to crush melee (crush -5) and have a 35% earth spell weakness.
Krystilia's task counts only Wilderness skeleton kills (e.g. the northern Wilderness section of Edgeville Dungeon).
Vet'ion and Calvar'ion are boss alternatives; their summoned skeleton hellhounds also progress a Skeleton task. Use each boss's own encounter preparation.

Skeletons are undead, so wear a Salve amulet (or Salve amulet (ei)) and hit their crush weakness with a crush weapon; any melee clears them quickly given their low defence, and earth spells exploit the 35% earth weakness for Magic training. For Krystilia, kill Wilderness skeletons at the northern Wilderness section of Edgeville Dungeon with risk-appropriate gear and an escape teleport; starter masters can be finished safely in the Edgeville Dungeon or Varrock Sewers.

edgeville-dungeon-wilderness-skeletons.name: Edgeville Dungeon (Wilderness skeletons)
notes: Northern Wilderness section of Edgeville Dungeon: seven level 45 skeletons. This section permits player-versus-player combat; the southern skeleton rooms are outside the Wilderness.
Northern Wilderness section of Edgeville Dungeon: seven level 45 skeletons. This section permits player-versus-player combat; the southern skeleton rooms are outside the Wilderness.

notes: Non-Wilderness skeletons for Turael, Spria, and Mazchna tasks: the Edgeville Dungeon, Varrock Sewers, and Draynor/Wizards' Tower basements hold level 21/22 skeletons. The Slayer task/Skeletons table (pageid 298266) lists both Edgeville Dungeon and Varrock Sewers as cannonable.
Edgeville Dungeon and the Varrock Sewers hold skeletons for the starter masters.
Both areas are cannonable per the wiki; Edgeville Dungeon is single-way and safespottable, while the Varrock Sewers are multicombat.

smoke-devils.name: Smoke devils
notes: Smoke devils require 93 Slayer and 85 combat to be assigned.
They are assigned by Konar quo Maten, Nieve/Steve, and Duradel/Kuradal.
Smoke devils can only be fought while on an active Slayer task.
Smoke devils attack with magical ranged.
Players must wear a facemask or slayer helm when fighting Smoke devils; otherwise attacks deal rapid damage and drains stats.
The strategy page warns that misclicking the slayer helmet or a rune full helm drop can quickly lead to death.
When killing normal Smoke devils, barrage spells with a cannon are strongly encouraged because Smoke devils have high defence and the dungeon is large.
A cannon is strongly recommended to lure Smoke devils in the large dungeon.
Players with elite Combat Achievements rewards should have enough cannonballs for one rotation to lure all Smoke devils; others may need to reload once.
Normal Smoke devils are the quick task and imbued heart or eternal gem route.

The Nuclear smoke devil superior has a high chance of rolling the superior unique table, second only to the Colossal Hydra according to the task page, making normal Smoke devils useful for imbued heart and eternal gem hunting.
Killing the Thermonuclear smoke devil is slower but better profit, and is ideal for collection log or pet smoke devil goals.
For the boss, Magic is faster but more expensive while melee is lower cost and requires more attention.

Use Ice Barrage or Ice Burst with a dwarf multicannon in the Smoke Devil Dungeon main room. Wear a facemask or Slayer helmet, pray Protect from Missiles, place the cannon in the centre, and group smoke devils around the western skeletons. Kill Thermonuclear smoke devil instead when prioritising profit, collection log, or pet smoke devil.

smoke-devil-dungeon.name: Smoke Devil Dungeon
notes: task-only dungeon south of Castle Wars, also reachable by fairy ring BKP. The main Smoke devil room is multicombat, cannonable, and used for Ice Burst or Ice Barrage grouping; a cannon placed in the Thermonuclear smoke devil boss room is destroyed.
Only Smoke devils location and the area is task-only.
Contains 30 smoke devils in the main room and 6 in room with boss variant, plus 1 Thermonuclear smoke devil.
The main room is cannonable; if a cannon is placed in the boss room it will be destroyed.
The task page lists the dungeon as multicombat and not safespottable.

sourhogs.name: Sourhogs
notes: Sourhogs are assigned ONLY by Spria (Turael stopped assigning them in the May 2024 update); it is Spria's sole distinguishing task.
Requires the quest A Porcine of Interest to access Sourhog Cave; there is no combat or Slayer level requirement.
slayerTargetId 303 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
The Sourhog (level 37) has 40 Hitpoints, Defence level 25, a normal max hit of 6, and gives 40 Slayer XP.

Wear Reinforced goggles (requiredItemId 24942, wiki item infobox id) or a Slayer helmet after the quest: without eye protection the caustic saliva hits 20-30 and drains Attack and Defence by 90%. offence.maxHit pins this 30 worst-case survival number, not the 6 normal hit.
No elemental weakness; its Defence bonuses are +0 stab and +0 ranged (best) versus +30 slash and +30 magic, so a stab or ranged weapon is most accurate.
No task extension unlock exists for Sourhogs.

Start A Porcine of Interest to reach Sourhog Cave south of Draynor, and always wear Reinforced goggles (or a Slayer helmet after the quest) so the caustic saliva cannot hit 20-30 and drain your stats. Attack the Sourhog with a stab weapon such as a dragon dagger (its Defence is +0 to stab, +30 to slash); ranged is a solid alternative against its +0 ranged Defence.

sourhog-cave.name: Sourhog Cave (Draynor)

Sourhog Cave, south of Draynor Village, is only accessible after starting A Porcine of Interest.

spiritual-creatures.name: Spiritual creatures
notes: Spiritual creatures require Death Plateau, 80 combat, and either 60 Strength or 60 Agility before assignment.
Spiritual rangers require 63 Slayer, Spiritual warriors require 68 Slayer, and Spiritual mages require 83 Slayer.
Spiritual mages are the only Spiritual creatures that drop dragon boots.
Spiritual creatures are only found in the God Wars Dungeon and Wilderness God Wars Dungeon.
Each god's followers are aggressive unless the player wears a god-affiliated item aligned to that god; wearing the item makes them tolerant.
God item protection is effectively required because the dungeons are multicombat and contain many aggressive monsters.
In the main God Wars Dungeon, bring at least one Zamorak-affiliated item and usually one Saradomin-affiliated item.
Bandos and Armadyl spiritual creatures are rarely killed.
In the Ancient Prison, only a Zaros-affiliated item is required inside, but Saradomin and Zamorak items are recommended for the route to the entrance.
In the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon, bring one Armadyl or Bandos item depending on entrance, one Saradomin item, and one Zamorak item.
Armadyl spiritual creatures require 70 Ranged and a crossbow that can fire a mithril grapple, though they can be attacked with melee weapons unlike Aviansie.
Bandos spiritual creatures require 70 Strength and a hammer.
Zamorak spiritual creatures require 70 Hitpoints; entering Zamorak's Fortress drains all prayer points.
Zaros spiritual creatures require The Frozen Door miniquest and 70 Strength, Hitpoints, Ranged, and Agility.
Many players block Spiritual creatures because they are neither cannonable nor AFK'able, have low experience rates, and have poor drops compared to similar Slayer monsters.
Ironman players may unblock the task at 83 Slayer to obtain dragon boots.
The task page recommends Spiritual rangers - skip or block.
The task page recommends Spiritual warriors - kill in Zamorak's Fortress if killing them at all.
The task page recommends Spiritual mages - kill in Zamorak's Fortress or Ancient Prison.

Skip or block Spiritual rangers. If killing the task, use Zamorak's Fortress for Spiritual warriors or Zamorak's Fortress/Ancient Prison for Spiritual mages, wearing the relevant god items for tolerance. Ironman accounts may prefer Spiritual mages at 83 Slayer for dragon boots.

suqahs.name: Suqahs
notes: Suqah can be a good Slayer task due to the high amount of experience per hour gained with a dwarf multicannon.
Using a dwarf multicannon and toxic blowpipe or prayer potions can result in a loss of coins due to Suqah's lack of valuable drops.
If using the northern area on Lunar Isle, players should use Protect from Magic and high Melee defence.
Players wishing to avoid magic damage should fight the southern part of Lunar Isle because those Suqah attack with only melee.
Three melee-only Suqah are found on the south-west part of the island over the bridge by the city wall.
A cannon can be placed directly north-west of the dead tree in the south-west area to target melee-only Suqah while avoiding the single magic-using Suqah nearby.
A Seal of passage is required to use the Lunar Isle bank unless Dream Mentor or the Elite Fremennik Diary allows banker access.
A bonecrusher or bonecrusher necklace is useful because Suqah always drop big bones.

Use Ranged with a dwarf multicannon at North Lunar Isle for the fastest dense task, praying Protect from Magic and using the hill safespot. Use melee plus cannon on the southern or south-western Lunar Isle spawns when avoiding magic damage; Guthan's equipment can mitigate melee damage.

lunar-isle-north-suqah.name: North Lunar Isle
notes: Contains 16 Suqah north of Lunar Isle. This is the dense cannon and Ranged safespot area; northern Suqah use melee plus weak Ice Barrage and Water Wave, so Protect from Magic and high Melee defence are recommended.
Northern Lunar Isle contains 16 level 111 Suqah.
This is the preferred cannon location because the spawns are dense.
Use Protect from Magic here because northern Suqah attack with both melee and magic.
The task page shows a hill safespot for cannoning and ranging northern Suqah.

lunar-isle-south-east-suqah.name: South-east Lunar Isle
notes: Contains 4 Suqah in south-east Lunar Isle near the Astral Altar. These southern Suqah are sparse but avoid the northern magic attacks and can be cannoned and safespotted.
South-east Lunar Isle contains 4 level 111 Suqah.
The southern area is more sparse but avoids the northern magic attacks.
Three nearby Suqah in the south-west of the island only attack with melee.

lunar-isle-south-west-suqah.name: South-west Lunar Isle
notes: Contains 6 Suqah in the single-way south-west Lunar Isle area. A cannon placed directly north-west of the dead tree targets the melee-only Suqah while avoiding the nearby magic-using Suqah.
South-west Lunar Isle contains 6 level 111 Suqah in single-way combat.
This row is cannonable and safespottable but not multicombat.
A cannon placed directly north-west of the dead tree targets melee-only Suqah while avoiding the nearby magic-using Suqah.

terror-dogs.name: Terror dogs
notes: Terror dogs require Slayer 40 (unboostable), combat level 60, and completion of Haunted Mine (via the Lair of Tarn Razorlor miniquest, which first spawns them) to be assigned.
Only Vannaka assigns terror dogs, in amounts of 20-45 with a weighting of 6; there is no extended-amount unlock.
Terror dogs do NOT count toward a dogs Slayer task; they are their own separate task category (cat = Terror Dogs).

slayerTargetId is null because the Slayer_task/Terror dogs wiki page does not exist (missing); values are taken from the Terror dog monster page (pageid 16436, revid 15199331). The SLAYER_TARGET varp value is unverified and left for QA.

Two counting variants exist: level 100 (NPC id 6474, 82 HP, max hit 11, 82 Slayer XP, Defence 74) and level 110 (NPC id 6473, 87 HP, max hit 15, 87 Slayer XP, Defence 78); both use a 4-tick Crush attack with all defensive bonuses 0.

weakness.style is MELEE with no element because the monster has no listed elemental weakness and all defensive bonuses are 0; Ranged (e.g. a Venator bow) is also a popular method for higher-level players, and Magic/Ranged is used for safespotting.
The room at Tarn's Lair drains Prayer at 50 points per minute and blocks cannon placement; terror dogs are multi-combat and can be safespotted from Tarn's room once tolerant.
Both variants are the only monsters that drop the Granite helm; killing a terror dog is also a Medium Morytania Diary task.

Ensure Slayer 40 (unboostable), combat level 60, and completion of Haunted Mine, then teleport to Tarn's Lair with a slayer ring (the trek on foot is long and dangerous). Fight the terror dogs in the room where Tarn Razorlor was beaten. They hit hard and accurately with Crush but have all-zero defensive bonuses, so any strong melee or Ranged setup works well; high-level players often use a Venator bow. The room is multi-combat and drains Prayer at 50 points/minute, and a cannon cannot be used, so bring plenty of food and prayer potions. Wait for the dogs to become tolerant, or lure one onto the tile in front of the doorway to safespot from Tarn's room with Magic or Ranged.

tarns-lair.name: Tarn's Lair
notes: Tarn's Lair is south of the Haunted Mine in southern Morytania; the terror dog room is the chamber where Tarn Razorlor was fought during the Lair of Tarn Razorlor miniquest (Haunted Mine required). A slayer ring teleport is the fastest access; the trek on foot is long and dangerous (Skeleton mages, traps). The terror dog room is multi-combat, drains Prayer at 1 point per 2 ticks (50/minute), and cannot host a dwarf multicannon. Terror dogs can be safespotted from Tarn's room with Magic or Ranged once tolerant. Burst is left false as it is not wiki-confirmed here.
The only place terror dogs are found is the room at the end of Tarn's Lair where Tarn Razorlor was fought; teleporting there with a slayer ring is by far the fastest access.
The room is multi-combat, so several terror dogs can attack at once; a dwarf multicannon cannot be set up here.
The room drains Prayer at 1 point per 2 game ticks (50 points/minute, much faster than Barrows), so avoid relying on overhead prayers for long.
Terror dogs can be safespotted from Tarn's room with Magic or Ranged (lure a dog onto the tile directly in front of the doorway), and they become tolerant over time to reduce the danger.
Reaching the lair on foot without a slayer ring is long and dangerous (Skeleton mages, traps); bring high-healing food, prayer potions, and stamina/energy management.

trolls.name: Trolls
notes: Trolls can be assigned at 60 combat by Vannaka, Chaeldar, Konar, Nieve/Steve, and Duradel/Kuradal.
Trolls are mostly found in the Fremennik Province and north of Burthorpe.
Trolls fought in quests all count towards the Slayer task, with the exception of sea trolls.
Troll bosses can be fought again in the Nightmare Zone.
Players who have completed the Hard Morytania Diary may bring a bonecrusher for passive Prayer experience from big bones.
Players with 92 Magic and the Arceuus spellbook may use Sinister Offering instead.
There are two main practical types of trolls for the task: mountain trolls and ice trolls.
Thrower trolls and troll generals are scarce, far, and have nonexistent or poor drops.
Ice Path trolls are not worth killing because they are stronger than other trolls and have very poor drops for their level.
The task page advises killing island ice trolls instead because they are weaker, have a slightly better drop table, and appear in large quantities in an open multicombat area.
When killing island ice trolls, prayer and a Neitiznot shield are required to reduce damage from ice troll females.
Northern Jatizso is often preferable because guards frequently tank the trolls, reducing player damage taken.
Regardless of which troll is killed, a dwarf multicannon is highly recommended because trolls have low aggression range.
Ice troll runts north of Neitiznot are a quick non-cannon option because nearby guards deal considerable damage and distract the trolls.
If guards deal the finishing blow, Slayer experience is halved, but drops are received as long as the player dealt damage.
Fire spells are recommended against ice trolls because they have strong fire weakness.

Use a dwarf multicannon. For profit and speed, kill island ice trolls north of Jatizso/Neitiznot with melee, prayer, and a Neitiznot shield; for lower-risk accessibility, cannon mountain trolls with Protect from Melee. Fire magic is strong against ice trolls and can also quickly finish mountain trolls, but costs more.

enchanted-valley-river-troll.name: Enchanted Valley
notes: Fairy ring BKQ. Summon a River troll above your combat level by fishing with a small net; the task page strongly discourages this option because River trolls give severely reduced combat and Slayer experience.
Summon a River troll above your combat level if you start fishing.
The area is reached by fairy ring BKQ.
The task page strongly discourages this option because experience is severely reduced.

fremennik-isles-ice-trolls.name: Northern Jatizso and Neitiznot

Contains 15 female, 14 male, 4 grunt, and 19 runt ice trolls. Bring prayer and a Neitiznot shield to reduce damage from ice troll females; Jatizso bank is slightly closer than Neitiznot.
Contains 15 female, 14 male, 4 grunt, and 19 runt ice trolls.
Better drops than mountain trolls.
Ice troll females use ranged attacks.
A Neitiznot shield and prayer are required to reduce damage from ice troll females.
The bank on Jatizso is slightly closer to the troll area than Neitiznot.

keldagrim-entrance-trolls.name: Keldagrim entrance tunnel

Narrow passage makes cannon placement difficult.
Rocks at the sides of the passage can be used to safespot.
Location only contains level 69 melee trolls.

More open than the south-west Mount Quidamortem troll location, so luring multiple trolls is easier.

wyrms.name: Wyrms
notes: Wyrms require 62 Slayer and are draconic creatures, so dragonbane weapons work on them.
Boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots must be worn in Karuulm Slayer Dungeon unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary has been completed.
Attacking standard Wyrms outside of direct melee range causes them to only use Magic, so Protect from Magic negates all of their damage.
Standard Wyrms have flat armour value 1, but this is not a major concern due to their low stats.
Most Wyrms can be outranged by safespotting.
Wyrms have a 50% elemental weakness to earth spells.
Wyrmlings in Neypotzli are an alternative for players who do not want to kill normal Wyrms; they can be cannoned and free supplies can be made inside.
Wyrmlings cannot spawn the Shadow Wyrm and only drop Wyrmling bones.
Lava Strykewyrms require 60 Sailing, use Ranged rather than Magic at distance, and require Protect from Missiles when fought from range.
Lava Strykewyrms cannot be cannoned and use a different drop table from normal Wyrms.
The dragon metal sheet drop from Lava Strykewyrms is 4x more common on a Wyrm task.
Players killing Lava Strykewyrms long term benefit from a Charred Island bank chest at 70 Construction and a boat docked with a Greater teleport focus.
Lava Strykewyrms have a 50% elemental weakness to water spells.
Magma strykewyrm is the Lava Strykewyrm superior and can burrow to the player's location for 20+ damage if the player does not move.

Use the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon task-only area with Ranged or Magic safespotting and Protect from Magic for standard Wyrms, wearing heat-protection boots unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete. Melee with dragonbane weapons is also viable. Wyrmlings are a low-effort cannon alternative in Neypotzli, while Lava Strykewyrms are a 60 Sailing alternative with Protect from Missiles at range, water-spell weakness, dragon metal sheet value, and Magma strykewyrm superior spawns.

zombies.name: Zombies
notes: Zombies are a shared task assigned by Krystilia (Wilderness, 75-125, weight 3) and by the starter masters Turael (15-30, w7), Spria (15-30, w7) and Mazchna (30-50, w7).
Krystilia kills only count in the Wilderness (e.g. the Graveyard of Shadows wandering zombies); starter-master kills count on common zombies anywhere.
Zombies are undead, so the Salve amulet (and its variants) and Crumble Undead apply.
slayerTargetId 273 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract: 252 + worklist index); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
Zombies carry a 50% fire weakness; the level 24 zombie's lowest melee defence bonus is slash, so a slashing weapon with a Salve amulet is efficient.
No task extension unlock exists for Zombies.
Zombie pirates are a Wilderness alternative. Vorkath, Zogres and the zombie-category Skogre are non-Wilderness alternatives; their individual access and equipment requirements apply.

Kill zombies with a slashing melee weapon and a Salve amulet (they are undead). On a Krystilia task the kills must occur in the Wilderness - the Graveyard of Shadows wandering zombies are the canonical spot; bring risk gear.

Reach it by running north from Ferox Enclave or via the Carrallanger (Ancient Magicks) teleport. Single-combat but cannonable and safespottable per the Slayer task/Zombies location table (pageid 298268). This is a PvP zone; bring Wilderness-appropriate risk gear.
Wandering zombies (levels 18 and 24) roam the Graveyard of Shadows in Wilderness levels 18-21; these kills count towards a Krystilia Zombies task.
The Slayer_task/Zombies location table lists Graveyard of Shadows as 21 spawns, single-way, cannonable and safespottable; it is in the Wilderness close to the Ferox Enclave.
A Dwarf multicannon can be used here (standard Wilderness cannon rules apply).

notes: Upper level contains 7 mithril dragons. Requires the first part of Barbarian Firemaking with 35 Firemaking; teleport to Barbarian Outpost and run south for quick access.

ancient-cavern-waterfiends.name: Ancient Cavern - Waterfiends
notes: Contains 16 Waterfiends. Requires Ancient Cavern access through Barbarian Firemaking training; games necklace to Barbarian Assault is the quick route. Waterfiends can be safespotted across the river with Ranged or Magic, and the task page describes waiting out the 10 min aggression timer between the pillar safespot and whirlpool landing platform.

ancient-cavern.name: Ancient Cavern
notes: Beneath Baxtorian Falls in Kandarin (not Wilderness); whirlpool entry needs a rope and Barbarian Firemaking. A rock south of the lower-level entrance offers a safespot, though brutal green dragonfire may still reach some tiles.

ancient-guthixian-temple.name: Ancient Guthixian Temple
notes: Requires While Guthix Sleeps. Enter via a Guthixian temple teleport or by riding a light creature (sapphire lantern) down the Chasm of Tears. A cannon cannot be set up here and tormented demons are immune to cannon damage. Single-way combat zone with pseudo-multicombat rooms allowing up to 2-3 demons to engage at once.

apsul-hunting-ground.name: Apsul Hunting Ground
notes: Seven venators; several near the Aranei shrine. Requires The Blood Moon Rises. Drakan's medallion to Castle Drakan, then use the Vampyrium portal. A 73 Agility shortcut and pickaxe shorten the route; a bank chest can be built in Sangvesti at 70 Construction.

aquanite-cavern-sailing.name: Ynysdail Cavern
notes: Ynysdail Cavern beneath Ynysdail, north of Gwenith; the only Aquanite location (16 spawns). Mooring at Ynysdail requires 73 Sailing, and the first trip must be sailed with an adamant keel or better. Build the Ynysdail rowboat (50 Construction) to travel between Ynysdail and north of Gwenith afterwards; using it requires Song of the Elves.
Teleport crystal to Prifddinas (Song of the Elves), exit north and take the Ynysdail rowboat north of Gwenith once it is built; otherwise sail to Ynysdail with an adamant keel or better.

araxxor-lair.name: Araxyte Lair
notes: Boss encounter area; prepare a separate boss trip. Consult the linked strategy for encounter access and hazards.

araxyte-lair-morytania.name: Araxyte Lair (Morytania)
notes: Morytania Spider Cave. Contains normal Araxytes and the Araxxor boss; spider cave teleport reaches the cave entrance.

asgarnian-ice-dungeon-task-only.name: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon task-only area
notes: Task-only Skeletal Wyvern area reached by icy steps near the exit to the wyvern area; Steve/Pieve control access depending on Monkey Madness II progress.

asgarnian-ice-dungeon.name: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon
notes: Entrance is south of Port Sarim and north of Mudskipper Point. Skeletal Wyverns are at the end of the dungeon; fairy ring AIQ and the Agility shortcuts can speed the route.

axe-hut.name: Magic Axe Hut (Wilderness)
notes: 9 Magic axe spawns inside the Wilderness Axe Hut (west of the Bone Yard). The hut door requires 23 Thieving and a lockpick to open. Krystilia only counts Wilderness kills, so the Taverley Dungeon and Catacombs of Kourend spawns do not count. Multicombat, cannon and safespot are not wiki-stated for this spot; conservative defaults are used.

bandit-camp-wilderness-black-knights.name: Black Knights (Wilderness)
notes: Level 33 Wilderness Black Knights spawn south of the Bandit Camp (Lava Maze area, ~level 33) with a further cluster north-east of the Bone Yard. Family-tuned copy of bandit-camp-wilderness (CT-L rule 2): the black knights occupy a distinct adjacent spot. Multicombat, cannon placement and safespots are not wiki-stated, so conservative defaults are used. This is a PvP zone; bring Wilderness risk gear.

bandit-camp-wilderness.name: Bandit Camp (Wilderness)
notes: The Bandit Camp east of the Ruins in the Wilderness (around level 14-20) holds the level 22 and level 130 bandits assigned by Krystilia. The bandits are aggressive to all players, so approach with caution. This is a PvP zone; bring Wilderness-appropriate risk gear. The Slayer task/Bandits location table (pageid 298779) lists the Wilderness Bandit Camp as multi-combat and cannonable (not safespottable).

bandos-stronghold.name: Bandos' Stronghold
requirements: God Wars Dungeon Bandos killcount or valid entry bypass
notes: Boss encounter area; prepare a separate boss trip. Consult the linked strategy for encounter access and hazards.

barrows.name: Barrows
notes: Boss encounter area; prepare a separate boss trip. Consult the linked strategy for encounter access and hazards.

bat-spawns.name: Bat spawns (various)
notes: Bats (level 6) and Giant bats (level 27) are common at low-density spots across Kandarin and Morytania; Giant bats also spawn in Arceuus near the Dark Altar. There is no single canonical bat location, so multi, cannon and safespot are conservative defaults and not wiki-confirmed for one spot. Some spots border the Wilderness, but a non-Wilderness spot is the safe default. Cannon permission is MIXED across the Slayer task/Bats location table (pageid 268303): most surface spots allow it, but Haunted Woods, Underground Pass and Brine Rat Cavern do not; the aggregate flag stays false.

bears-area.name: Non-Wilderness bears
notes: Non-Wilderness bears for Turael, Spria, and Mazchna tasks: the Fremennik Province woods just outside Rellekka hold about 10 grizzly bears, with more in the Kebos Lowlands south of Mount Quidamortem; black bears cluster around the Mind Altar and Varrock south-east mine. Grizzly bear cubs are in Isafdar (partial Regicide required). The Slayer task/Bears location table (pageid 297754) lists these spots as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat).

bears-wilderness.name: Wilderness bears
notes: Grizzly bears spawn in the low-level Wilderness west of the Graveyard of Shadows (about 10 spawns) and near the Dark Warriors' Fortress, plus north-west of the Ferox Enclave. Required for Krystilia's Wilderness bears task; bring only risk-appropriate gear as PKers frequent the area. The Slayer task/Bears location table (pageid 297754) lists the Wilderness bear spots as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat).

bird-spawns.name: Bird spawns (various)
notes: Chickens and ducks cluster at low-level farms such as Lumbridge, Fred the Farmer's field, and Falador; other counted birds (seagulls, penguins, terrorbirds, vultures) are spread widely. Every spot in the Slayer task/Birds location table (pageid 259880) is single-combat, cannonable and safespottable.

braindeath-island.name: Braindeath Island
notes: 11 Fever spider spawns in the Braindeath Island brewery basement; Rum Deal must be started to access the island. Wear Slayer gloves or take 12.5% max-HP damage and become diseased when attacking. Many crate safespots (south-west corner noted). Cannon placement is not wiki-stated, so the conservative default is used.

brimhaven-dungeon-baby-red-dragons.name: Brimhaven Dungeon (baby red dragons)
notes: Contains 12 Baby red dragons. The task page marks them cannonable but not safespottable; adult red dragons and wild dogs can attack nearby.

brimhaven-dungeon-fire-giants.name: Brimhaven Dungeon
notes: Contains 8 Fire giants on the first floor and 5 on the ground floor. Requires a woodcutting axe and payment of 875 coins to Saniboch or a one-time 1,000,000 coin deposit. The task page marks this as inefficient for Konar because spawns are spread across floors.

brimhaven-dungeon-metal-dragons-task-onl.name: Brimhaven Dungeon (task-only metal dragons)
notes: Task-only area with 5 bronze, 9 iron, and 9 steel dragons. Requires dungeon access payment and an axe from the north entrance; Elite Karamja Diary can toggle noted bar drops.

brimhaven-dungeon-metal-dragons.name: Brimhaven Dungeon
notes: Standard Brimhaven metal dragon area with 3 bronze, 13 iron, and 4 steel dragons. Requires dungeon access payment and an axe from the north entrance; Elite Karamja Diary can toggle noted bar drops.

brimhaven-dungeon-red-dragons.name: Brimhaven Dungeon (adult red dragons)
notes: Contains 16 Red dragons. Requires at least 30 Agility for the red dragon route; completing Karamja Elite Diary causes red dragonhides to be noted, and there is a safespot next to the pipe agility shortcut to the black demons.

brimhaven-dungeon.name: Brimhaven Dungeon
notes: Black demon safespot near the agility pipe allows cannon coverage on 2-3 of the 4 demons.

brine-rat-cavern.name: Brine Rat Cavern
notes: Enter by digging with a spade south of the windswept tree east of Olaf Hradson (accessible during and after Olaf's Quest); fairy ring DKS is nearby. Contains 7 Brine rats in a single combat zone; a dwarf multicannon may be used, and two safespots exist (the black bones to the south-east and the north-west corner).

buccaneers-laboratory-hellhounds.name: Buccaneers' Laboratory
notes: Hellhounds here require 76 Sailing to access the island. The Rowboat can be used to travel to Buccaneers' Haven from Pirates' Cove; the area has 5 spawns and supports multicombat cannoning.

buccaneers-laboratory.name: Buccaneers' Laboratory
notes: Requires 76 Sailing. Mutated bloodvelds are multicombat, cannonable, safespottable, and become much easier to access after building the rowboat from Pirates' Cove and the bank chest. Hellhounds here are multicombat and cannonable, with 5 spawns reached by rowboat from Pirates' Cove.

burgh-de-rott-vampyres.name: Burgh de Rott
notes: Requires completion of In Aid of the Myreque. Contains Feral Vampyres west of Burgh de Rott and Vampyre Juvinates east of the town.

callistos-den.name: Callisto's Den
requirements: Medium Wilderness Diary completed or Callisto boss assignment
notes: Wilderness boss lair. Requires the medium Wilderness Diary or the matching Callisto boss Slayer assignment; an ordinary creature assignment does not waive the diary. Entry costs 50,000 coins, repayable after the applicable PvP death. Check the linked strategy for travel and risk.

canifis-ghoul-area.name: Canifis ghoul area
notes: Ghouls roam the area west of Canifis, north of Mort Myre Swamp, by the River Salve. Priest in Peril is required to cross into Morytania. Multi, cannon and safespot status are not wiki-stated and left conservative (false).

canifis.name: Canifis
notes: Werewolves wander Canifis village as level 24 humans until attacked, then transform into level 88 werewolves. Priest in Peril is required to cross the River Salve into Morytania. Canifis is a single-combat area, but a Dwarf multicannon can be set up in the village centre (40 Agility enables the Canifis Rooftop Course cannon method). Safespots exist over the central STASH unit and inside the pub (behind the bar / across the tables, where 4 werewolves reside).

catacombs-of-kourend-brutal-red-dragons.name: Catacombs of Kourend (brutal red dragons)
notes: Contains 3 Brutal red dragons. They use melee, magic, and long-range dragonfire, can drop draconic visage, and are a slow task option compared to normal or baby red dragons.

catacombs-of-kourend-fire-giants.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: Recommended in most cases because it is multicombat, relatively AFK, and gives access to the Catacombs drop table. Contains level 104 and 109 Fire giants that can drop Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces; prioritise level 109s for maximum XP.

catacombs-of-kourend-metal-dragons.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: Contains 5 bronze, 2 iron, and 2 steel dragons. These Catacombs metal dragons are stronger than their normal counterparts and can drop Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces.

catacombs-of-kourend-nechryael.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: Contains 14 Greater Nechryael in two chambers of seven each. Easily accessible with a portal attuned to Great Kourend or with Xeric's talisman; not cannonable and not safespottable on the task page.

catacombs-of-kourend.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: Black demons here can be safespotted and give access to Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces, but their higher Defence makes them an inefficient Black demons task option. Mutated bloodvelds appear in three groups, can be safespotted, and use the Catacombs drop table including ancient shards and dark totem pieces. Brutal blue dragons here are safespottable, cannot be cannoned, and can drop ancient shards and Dark totem parts. Hellhounds here are multicombat, safespottable, cannot be cannoned, and can reset aggression by running south and up the vine to the Giants' Den.
Xeric's Heart (Xeric's talisman) is beside the Catacombs entrance.

cerberus-lair.name: Cerberus' Lair
notes: Cerberus boss lair beneath Taverley Dungeon. Requires 91 Slayer to fight normally, or 86 Slayer with a wild pie boost; use Cerberus/Strategies for boss-specific mechanics.

chaos-druid-tower-dungeon.name: Chaos Druid Tower Dungeon
notes: Dungeon beneath the Chaos Druid Tower near Ardougne; requires 46 Thieving to open the door. Level 53 ogres here; fairly unpopulated, cannonable and safespottable.

chaos-druid-wilderness.name: Edgeville Dungeon (Wilderness)
notes: 11 Chaos druid spawns in the Wilderness section of Edgeville Dungeon, reached past the wilderness lever/ditch. Krystilia only counts Wilderness kills, so the non-Wilderness Chaos Druid Tower, Taverley Dungeon and Yanille Agility Dungeon spawns do not count. Multicombat, cannon and safespot are not wiki-stated for this spot; conservative defaults are used.

chaos-elemental-rogues-castle.name: Rogues' Castle
notes: Boss encounter area; prepare a separate boss trip. Consult the linked strategy for encounter access and hazards.

chaos-fanatic-lava-maze.name: Chaos Fanatic
notes: Boss encounter area; prepare a separate boss trip. Consult the linked strategy for encounter access and hazards.

chaos-temple-wilderness.name: Chaos Temple (Wilderness)
notes: The Chaos Temple in the low-level Wilderness (around level 11-13), north of the Goblin Village / west of the Dark Warriors' Fortress. Zombie pirates spawn here and count towards the Krystilia Pirates task; they are undead and weak to fire. Lower PKer risk than the Pirates' Hideout. Cannon and safespot are not wiki-documented here, so these are set conservatively to false.

charred-dungeon-fire-giants.name: Charred Dungeon
notes: Requires 60 Sailing to access. The Fire giant page notes Charred Dungeon is the only Fire giant location where cannonable spawns are also in multicombat.

charred-dungeon-hellhounds.name: Charred Dungeon
notes: Hellhounds here require 60 Sailing to access. Contains 5 spawns, supports multicombat cannoning, and is discouraged due to the low spawn count.

charred-dungeon-lava-strykewyrms.name: Charred Dungeon - Lava Strykewyrms
notes: Contains 12 Lava Strykewyrms in the Charred Dungeon beneath Charred Island. Requires 60 Sailing and deploying a rope to enter. The wider Charred Dungeon is multicombat and cannonable, but the Lava Strykewyrm sections are single-way and cannot be cannoned; safespotting requires a 9 or 10 tile attack range.

charred-dungeon-lesser-demons.name: Charred Dungeon
notes: Charred Dungeon holds 6 Lesser demons; multicombat and cannonable but the wiki marks the demons not safespottable. Requires 60 Sailing to access.

charred-dungeon-nechryael.name: Charred Dungeon
notes: Contains 11 regular Nechryael. Requires 60 Sailing to access; the task page discourages this area because the Nechryael are divided into two low-density groups and the dungeon is far from most routes without a docked boat and greater teleport focus.

charred-dungeon-red-dragons.name: Charred Dungeon (red dragons)
notes: Contains 4 adult Red dragons. Requires 60 Sailing to access; Black dragons and Baby black dragons are also in the same large room.

charred-dungeon.name: Charred Dungeon
notes: Chasm of Fire / Charred Dungeon black demon and black dragon location requiring 60 Sailing to access; Red dragons are in the same large room as black dragons. Hellhounds here are multicombat and cannonable but discouraged because there are only 5 spawns.
Xeric's talisman into the Kebos Lowlands for the Chasm of Fire.

chasm-of-fire-bottom.name: Chasm of Fire (Bottom level)
notes: Bottom level Black demon area with stalagmite safespots and another safespot near the Voice of Yama; Yama contracts are available after A Kingdom Divided and signing with Yama.
Xeric's talisman into the Kebos Lowlands for the Chasm of Fire.

chasm-of-fire-middle.name: Chasm of Fire (middle floor)
notes: Middle floor of the Chasm of Fire holds 9 Lesser demons; single-combat, cannonable and safespottable, with four demons in a concentrated area. Demons here can drop contracts after speaking to Yama.

clock-tower-dungeon.name: Clock Tower Dungeon
notes: Dungeon beneath the Clock Tower south of Ardougne. Small number of level 53 ogres; cannonable and safespottable.

colossal-wyrm-remains.name: East of the Colossal Wyrm Remains
notes: Varlamore savannah east of the Colossal Wyrm Remains; several safespots and free of Karamja poison hazards, so no antipoison is needed. A quetzal landing site at Colossal Wyrm Remains gives a quick shortcut to an Auburnvale bank and a prayer altar at The Teomat; nearest fairy ring is AJP.

evidence.title: East of the Colossal Wyrm Remains

combat-training-camp.name: Combat Training Camp
notes: North-west of West Ardougne. Requires completion of Biohazard to access. Home of the level 63 ogre variant; cannonable and safespottable.

corsair-cove-dungeon-baby-red-dragons.name: Corsair Cove Dungeon (baby red dragons)
notes: Contains 2 Baby red dragons in Corsair Cove Dungeon / Myths' Guild basement. Requires Dragon Slayer II and is near the bank-adjacent adult red dragon group.

corsair-cove-dungeon-red-dragons.name: Corsair Cove Dungeon (adult red dragons)
notes: Contains 3 adult Red dragons in Corsair Cove Dungeon / Myths' Guild basement. Requires Dragon Slayer II and is very close to a bank.

corsair-cove-dungeon.name: Corsair Cove Dungeon
notes: Requires Dragon Slayer II. Corsair Cove Dungeon black dragons are close to a bank using a Mythical cape teleport. Blue dragon area contains 5 adults and 3 babies, is cannonable, and can be safespotted.
Mythical cape teleports to Corsair Cove (requires Dragon Slayer II).

cow-field.name: Cow fields (Lumbridge/Falador)
notes: Cows are densest in the Lumbridge cow field (east of Lumbridge Castle) and the Falador farm; the Crafting Guild also has cows. There is no single canonical cow location for a slayer task, so multi, cannon and safespot are conservative defaults and not wiki-confirmed for one spot.

crandor-and-karamja-dungeon.name: Crandor and Karamja Dungeon
notes: Crandor and Karamja Dungeon holds 11 Lesser demons; single-combat, cannonable and safespottable, with six demons noted in the southern Crandor area.

crandor.name: Crandor
notes: Crandor surface holds 2 Lesser demons; single-combat, cannonable and safespottable. Access requires progress in Dragon Slayer I.

crash-site-cavern.name: Crash Site Cavern
notes: Requires completion of Monkey Madness II. Contains Demonic gorillas, which can be killed instead of Black demons for eligible non-Krystilia and non-Konar assignments.

crypt-of-tonali.name: Crypt of Tonali
notes: Earthen Nagua appear in the multicombat eastern sun chamber only after completion of The Final Dawn; a cannon cannot be set up here. Safespots are not documented on the wiki (conservative default). Moonlight moths can be caught nearby to restore prayer.

dagannoth-kings-lair.name: Waterbirth Island Dungeon
notes: Boss encounter area; prepare a separate boss trip. Consult the linked strategy for encounter access and hazards.

dark-altar-elves.name: Dark Altar
notes: Use Adept Reanimation on ensouled elf heads at the Dark Altar if the head was banked, traded, put on the Grand Exchange, price-checked, teleported away from, or otherwise cannot be reanimated near where it dropped.

dark-altar.name: Dark Altar
notes: ensouled bloodveld heads must be reanimated at the Dark Altar if Expert Reanimation is not cast soon after pickup, or if the player trades the head or teleports away.

dark-warriors-fortress.name: Dark Warriors' Fortress
notes: The Dark Warriors' Fortress sits in the low-level Wilderness north-west of Edgeville; level 8 Dark warriors roam its corridors. Multicombat, cannon placement and safespots are not definitively wiki-stated, so conservative defaults are used. This is a PvP zone; bring risk-appropriate gear.

darkmeyer.name: Darkmeyer
notes: Requires starting Sins of the Father for Darkmeyer access. The west Arboretum area has Vyrewatch Sentinels near an altar, bank, Drakan's medallion teleport, and the Hallowed Sepulchre lobby bank chest.

death-plateau-trolls.name: Death Plateau
notes: Contains 15 mountain trolls plus nearby named and thrower trolls. Protect from Missiles is highly recommended while running through the canyon; Burthorpe teleports via games necklace or combat bracelet are fast, and shooting through rock troll buildings makes safespotting easier.

deep-wilderness-dungeon-fire-giants.name: Deep Wilderness Dungeon
notes: The only Fire giant location for Krystilia assignments. Located around level 53 Wilderness near the Mage Arena, with high player-killer risk. Cannon tiles are available along the western lava pool, and a safespot is in the south-eastern tunnel near the Monk of Zamorak. Wilderness Medium Diary unlocks a 46 Agility shortcut between fire and hill giants.

deepfin-mine.name: Deepfin Mine
notes: Aberrant spectres can be safespotted from the eastern side near the standing torch. A bank chest can be built in a Deepfin Mine hotspot, and quick access uses an 84 Agility shortcut.

demonic-ruins.name: Demonic Ruins
notes: Deep Wilderness Greater demon location near the Annakarl teleport destination. Prayer points regenerate there, but the area is multicombat and high PK risk.
Annakarl teleport (Ancient Magicks) lands beside the Demonic Ruins in the deep Wilderness.

dog-spawns.name: Dog spawns
notes: Dogs count guard dogs, jackals and wild dogs. Guard dogs are in McGrubor's Wood (10 spawns), Hosidius (6 spawns), Kourend Castle, Handelmort Mansion and Brimhaven (Heroes' Quest). Jackals roam the Kharidian Desert near Pollnivneach, Nardah, Sophanem and the Ancient Pyramid (largest cluster, 13 spawns, south of the Ancient Pyramid via fairy ring DLQ). Wild dogs are in Brimhaven Dungeon on Karamja (12 spawns). The Slayer task/Dogs location table (pageid 298041) lists every dog spot as cannonable and safespottable; only the Hosidius marketplace is multi-combat.

dorgesh-kaan-south-dungeon.name: Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon
notes: Underground dungeon south of Dorgesh-Kaan, near fairy ring AJQ. Entry requires completion of Death to the Dorgeshuun and a rope to climb down; a light source is required. Home to Molanisks, which disguise on the cave walls and must be lured off with a Slayer bell. A Dwarf multicannon can be used and certain rocks (notably the large rock south of the AJQ fairy ring) provide safespots. Multi is not wiki-confirmed (conservative default).
