dragon-nest.name: Dragon Nest
notes: Blue dragon area contains 5 adults and 2 babies, is close to the bank in Tal Teklan, supports a cannon, can be safespotted, and has a shortcut available with level 40 Agility.

dwarven-mine.name: Dwarven Mine
notes: Dwarves count both dwarves and Black Guards. Dwarves swarm the free-to-play Dwarven Mine (36 spawns, beneath Ice Mountain / Falador), Ice Mountain surface (14 spawns), the Mining Guild surface (3 spawns) and Lovakengj (21 spawns, members). Black Guards (level 25) are on Ice Mountain (4 spawns); the level 48 Black Guard form is in Keldagrim (6 spawns). Multi, cannon and safespot availability are not wiki-confirmed for these spots (conservative defaults).

earth-warriors-wilderness.name: Earth warriors (Edgeville Dungeon)
notes: The Earth warriors occupy the north-eastern chamber of the Edgeville Dungeon (Wilderness levels 7-10), reached by crossing the monkey bars which require 15 Agility. Single-combat area; a cannon can be used and a safespot exists in the bottom-right corner or top of the first chamber. This is a PvP zone; bring risk-appropriate gear.

eastern-gryphon-dungeon.name: Eastern gryphon dungeon
notes: Task-only Eastern Gryphons dungeon on the Great Conch. Contains 18 gryphons; the south-west part is multicombat and cannonable, while the rest is single-way combat.

edgeville-dungeon-wilderness-skeletons.name: Edgeville Dungeon (Wilderness skeletons)
notes: Northern Wilderness section of Edgeville Dungeon: seven level 45 skeletons. This section permits player-versus-player combat; the southern skeleton rooms are outside the Wilderness.

edgeville-dungeon-wilderness.name: Edgeville Dungeon (Wilderness)
notes: level 5 Wilderness Black demon area. Easier to escape from than Wilderness Slayer Cave but still carries player killing risk.

enchanted-valley-river-troll.name: Enchanted Valley
notes: Fairy ring BKQ. Summon a River troll above your combat level by fishing with a small net; the task page strongly discourages this option because River trolls give severely reduced combat and Slayer experience.

ent-wilderness.name: Chaos Temple ents (Wilderness)
notes: 10 Wilderness ent spawns near the Chaos Temple: 4 to the east and 6 to the north. Krystilia only counts Wilderness kills, so the level 86 Woodcutting Guild ent does not count. Bring a hatchet to chop the defeated trunks for noted logs. Ents are not cannon-immune and the open Wilderness area is not cannon-prohibited (Ent pageid 31267); they can be safespotted 1-3 tiles from a tree.

entrana-dungeon.name: Entrana Dungeon
notes: Greater demon location under Entrana. Weapons and armour cannot be taken through Entrana (bring cannon parts and unarmed/allowed gear only), but the dungeon itself allows cannon placement: the Slayer task/Greater demons table (pageid 298108) lists Entrana Dungeon as cannonable - the multicannon prohibited-list Entrana entry covers the island surface.

evil-chickens-lair.name: Evil Chicken's Lair
notes: Requires partial completion of Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Sir Amik Varze and sacrificing a raw chicken at the Chicken Shrine in Zanaris. A rope is needed for the baby black dragon area.

feldip-hills.name: Feldip Hills
notes: Level 53 ogres roam the Feldip Hills south of Yanille. The ogres here are fairly spread out; cannonable and safespottable.

forgotten-cemetery.name: The Forgotten Cemetery
notes: Wilderness Ankou location straddling level 30 Wilderness. Safespot behind the south-west coffin on the square between the bone spawns; bring a one-click teleport such as a Royal seed pod.

forthos-dungeon-baby-red-dragons.name: Forthos Dungeon (baby red dragons)
notes: Contains 5 Baby red dragons in Forthos Dungeon. The task page marks them not cannonable and not safespottable.

forthos-dungeon-red-dragons.name: Forthos Dungeon (adult red dragons)
notes: Contains 6 adult Red dragons. There is a safespot next to the fire and stalagmite near the strange floor agility shortcut; after unlocking the Sacred Bone Burner, bones can be sacrificed there for bonus XP, and the nearby altar can sustain Prayer.

forthos-dungeon.name: Forthos Dungeon
notes: Beneath Forthos Ruin in Hosidius, Great Kourend (not Wilderness). Red dragons in the Scorched Grotto can be safespotted from the shortcut in the north-east corner for ranged and magic.

forthos-sarachnis.name: Forthos Dungeon
notes: Boss encounter area; prepare a separate boss trip. Consult the linked strategy for encounter access and hazards.

fossil-island-mushroom-forest-zygomites.name: Mushroom Forest
notes: Contains 27 Ancient Zygomites in the Mushroom Forest on Fossil Island. Valid for Zygomites tasks unless Konar locks the assignment to Zanaris.

fremennik-isles-ice-trolls.name: Northern Jatizso and Neitiznot
notes: Requires The Fremennik Trials to reach Jatizso/Neitiznot via Mord Gunnars; The Fremennik Isles does not need completion to start access. Contains 15 female, 14 male, 4 grunt, and 19 runt ice trolls. Bring prayer and a Neitiznot shield to reduce damage from ice troll females; Jatizso bank is slightly closer than Neitiznot.

fremennik-slayer-dungeon-cave-crawlers.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (Cave crawlers)
notes: Cave crawler section of the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, entered from Rellekka. No special protective item is needed for cave crawlers, but they are poisonous, so bring antipoison. Cannon usability here is not wiki-confirmed (conservative default: off).

fremennik-slayer-dungeon-cockatrice.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (Cockatrice)
notes: Cockatrice section of the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, entered from Rellekka (7 spawns). A mirror shield or V's shield must be equipped to avoid the petrifying gaze. Cannon usability here is not wiki-confirmed (conservative default: off).

fremennik-slayer-dungeon-kurasks.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
notes: Contains 14 Kurasks: 5 in the main dungeon and 9 in a task-only section. Very large area compared to other dungeons; Kurasks are immune to cannon and thrall damage.

fremennik-slayer-dungeon-pyrefiends.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (Pyrefiends)
notes: Pyrefiend section of the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, entered from Rellekka (13 spawns). No smoke protection is needed here, unlike the Smoke Dungeon. Cannon usability here is not wiki-confirmed (conservative default: off).

fremennik-slayer-dungeon-rockslugs.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (rockslugs)
notes: Rockslugs (7 spawns) in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, reached from Rellekka. A light source is required. Family-tuned copy of the fremennik-slayer-dungeon base file, whose basilisk-specific flags (safeSpot/konarLockable) do not apply to rockslugs. Multi, cannon and safespot status are not wiki-stated and left conservative (false).

fremennik-slayer-dungeon-turoths.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
notes: Contains 22 Turoths, the only place they are found. Single combat with safespots; Turoths can only be damaged by leaf-bladed weapons, broad ammunition, or Magic Dart.

fremennik-slayer-dungeon.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
notes: Contains standard Basilisks. A mirror shield or V's shield is required to avoid basilisk gaze damage and stat drain.
Slayer ring teleports to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (Rellekka).

frozen-waste-plateau.name: Frozen Waste Plateau
notes: Frozen Waste Plateau in the western Wilderness (around level 50). Ice giants (9 spawns) and ice warriors also spawn here. Bring low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport. The Slayer task/Ice giants table (pageid 566858) lists the Frozen Waste Plateau as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat).

ghorrock-dungeon.name: Ghorrock Dungeon
notes: Boss encounter area; prepare a separate boss trip. Consult the linked strategy for encounter access and hazards.

ghost-spawns.name: Ghost spawns (various)
notes: Level-19 Ghosts are common at low-level spots such as the Draynor Manor basement, the Wilderness graveyards, and the Haunted Woods; higher-level Ghosts (levels 25 and 76/77) appear in the Sepulchre of Death within the Stronghold of Security. Some ghost spawns are inside the Wilderness, but a non-Wilderness spot (e.g. Draynor Manor basement) is the safe default. Multi, cannon and safespot availability vary by spot and are not wiki-confirmed for a single canonical location (conservative defaults).

giants-den-fire-giants.name: Giants' Den
notes: Second alternative after Catacombs of Kourend. Contains level 104 and 109 Fire giants, allows a dwarf multicannon, and shares the Catacombs drop table including Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces.

gnome-maze.name: Gnome Maze
notes: Only a single level 53 ogre spawn; cannonable and safespottable but not an efficient task spot.

goblin-spawns.name: Goblin spawns (various)
notes: Goblins are very common along the Lumbridge-to-Goblin-Village road, at Goblin Village north of Falador, and near Draynor. There is no single canonical goblin location for a slayer task, so multi, cannon and safespot are conservative defaults and not wiki-confirmed for one spot.

god-wars-dungeon-ancient-prison.name: God Wars Dungeon - Ancient Prison
notes: Zaros Spiritual creatures in the Ancient Prison require The Frozen Door miniquest. Inside the Ancient Prison only Zaros-affiliated protection is required, but Saradomin and Zamorak items are recommended for the route to the entrance. Zaros variants are significantly stronger than the other gods' Spiritual creatures.

god-wars-dungeon-armadyl.name: God Wars Dungeon (Armadyl)
requirements: God Wars Dungeon Armadyl killcount or valid entry bypass
notes: Requires Death Plateau and God Wars Dungeon access. Armadyl-aligned protection is required to make Aviansie tolerant; Kree'arra access also needs 70 Ranged, a crossbow, and a mith grapple.

god-wars-dungeon-vampyres.name: God Wars Dungeon
notes: Contains spread-out Feral Vampyres that are Zamorak followers. Wear a Zamorak item to avoid their faction aggression.

god-wars-dungeon.name: God Wars Dungeon
notes: Bloodveld safespotting requires Saradomin and Zamorak item protection; first-time access requires rope. God Wars Bloodveld are Zamorak followers and no superior Bloodveld can spawn here. God Wars Hellhounds are Zamorak followers, count for Zamorak kill count, are safespottable, and are discouraged because their spawns are far and sparse. Spiritual creatures require Death Plateau and either 60 Strength or 60 Agility to receive assignments; main Spiritual creature variants require god-affiliated item protection for tolerance, with Zamorak and usually Saradomin protection recommended. Cannon nuance: a cannon can physically be set up in the God Wars Dungeon but its inhabitants may destroy it (Dwarf multicannon pageid 13551); wiki task tables split on the verdict (ogres/vampyres Yes, aviansie/bloodveld/hellhounds No), so trust the per-task row here.
Rope is required on first entry via the Trollheim crevice.

graveyard-of-shadows-green-dragons.name: Graveyard of Shadows (green dragons)
notes: Five green dragon spawns north of the Graveyard of Shadows in the low-level Wilderness (around levels 18-21). Cannon placement verified for the Graveyard of Shadows area (Slayer task/Zombies table, pageid 298268; green dragon row itself is unmarked on the wiki).

graveyard-of-shadows-skeletons.name: Graveyard of Shadows (skeletons)
notes: Skeletons at the Graveyard of Shadows in the low-level Wilderness (levels 18-21) for Krystilia's task. Family-tuned copy of the zombies-owned graveyard-of-shadows base file (CT-L shared #3). Bring only risk-appropriate gear as PKers frequent the area. The Slayer task/Skeletons table (pageid 298266) lists the Wilderness skeletons as multi-combat and cannonable (not safespottable).

graveyard-of-shadows.name: Graveyard of Shadows
notes: The Graveyard of Shadows sits in Wilderness levels 18-21 on the site of the former Zarosian fortress of Carrallanger; wandering zombies (levels 18 and 24) roam it. Reach it by running north from Ferox Enclave or via the Carrallanger (Ancient Magicks) teleport. Single-combat but cannonable and safespottable per the Slayer task/Zombies location table (pageid 298268). This is a PvP zone; bring Wilderness-appropriate risk gear.

green-dragons-wilderness.name: Wilderness green dragon spawns
notes: Other Wilderness green dragon clusters: south of the Lava Maze (5 spawns), west of the Dark Warriors' Fortress (3 spawns), and the Boneyard. The Slayer task/Green dragons table (pageid 270386) lists these Wilderness spots as cannonable.

grimstone-dungeon-task-only.name: Grimstone Dungeon task-only cavern
notes: Task-only Frost dragon cavern west of the main Grimstone Dungeon area. Requires a Frost dragon Slayer task; off-task attacks are blocked with the strange coldness permission message. Requires 87 Sailing access to Grimstone and can be safespotted.

grimstone-dungeon.name: Grimstone Dungeon
notes: Frost dragon area on Grimstone, requiring 87 Sailing to access. After visiting Grimstone once, fairy ring DLP is the fastest return route. Contains the main Frost dragon area with 20 listed spawns; frost dragons are immune to dwarf multicannon damage and can be safespotted.

gu-tanoth.name: Gu'Tanoth
notes: Ogre city south-east of Yanille. Requires partial completion of Watchtower to enter. Level 53 ogres are secluded across several areas; cannonable and safespottable.

haunted-woods.name: Haunted Woods
notes: Requires Priest in Peril. Fairy ring ALQ is in the middle of the woods; nearby leeches can drain stats and do not appear on the minimap.
Fairy ring ALQ is in the Haunted Woods (needs a Dramen or Lunar staff).

heroes-guild-basement.name: Heroes' Guild basement
notes: Requires Heroes' Quest. Contains one adult Blue dragon, supports a cannon, and can be safespotted.

hill-giants-area.name: Edgeville Dungeon
notes: Free-to-play; enter the Edgeville Dungeon via the trapdoor in the house south of Edgeville bank or the Wilderness ditch entrance. 12 hill giant spawns, the most convenient non-Wilderness spot for Mazchna's assignment. The Slayer task/Hill giants table (pageid 298054) lists Edgeville Dungeon as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat).

hill-giants-wilderness.name: Deep Wilderness Dungeon
notes: Wilderness hill giants for Krystilia: the Deep Wilderness Dungeon holds 6 spawns (~level 50 Wilderness), with further F2P Wilderness spawns at the Boneyard Hunter area and the Lava Maze. Kills count for Krystilia only in the Wilderness. The Slayer task/Hill giants table (pageid 298054) lists the Deep Wilderness Dungeon as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat).

hobgoblin-area.name: Hobgoblin area
notes: Hobgoblins in the Edgeville Dungeon (non-Wilderness section) and on the peninsula west of the Crafting Guild. Not the Wilderness hobgoblin spawns. The Slayer task/Hobgoblins table (pageid 298252) lists Edgeville Dungeon and the Crafting Guild peninsula as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat).

hunters-end.name: Hunter's End
requirements: Hard Wilderness Diary completed or Callisto boss assignment
notes: Wilderness boss lair. Requires the hard Wilderness Diary or the matching Callisto boss Slayer assignment; an ordinary creature assignment does not waive the diary. Entry costs 50,000 coins, repayable after the applicable PvP death. Check the linked strategy for travel and risk.

ice-mountain.name: Ice Mountain
notes: Icefiends on top of Ice Mountain, north-west of Falador and west of Edgeville. They can be safespotted behind the rocks. Multi and cannon are not wiki-stated and left conservative (false).

ice-warriors-area.name: Non-Wilderness ice warriors
notes: Non-Wilderness ice warriors for Mazchna's starter task: the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon (south of Port Sarim) and White Wolf Mountain, plus God Wars Dungeon routes. Multicombat, cannon, and safespot status are not documented on the wiki and are left conservative (false).

inferno.name: Inferno
notes: Used when the Slayer master offers TzKal-Zuk instead of regular TzHaar after at least one prior off-task Zuk kill. Combat achievement rewards can increase the task to two or three Zuk kills.

iorwerth-camp.name: Iorwerth Camp
notes: Requires Regicide access. Contains 6 Iorwerth Archers and 6 Iorwerth Warriors; warriors can be safespotted using stools or spear-walls if the player stays at least two tiles away from their crystal halberds. Cannon use is allowed but awkward because tents, barrels, and crates impede placement.

iorwerth-dungeon-dark-beasts.name: Iorwerth Dungeon
notes: Requires Song of the Elves. Contains 10 Dark beasts, is single-combat, supports a dwarf multicannon, is not safespottable for the task page, and Dark beasts killed here can drop crystal shards.

iorwerth-dungeon-kurasks.name: Iorwerth Dungeon
notes: Requires Song of the Elves. Contains 14 Kurasks with crystal shard drops; King kurasks here always drop crystal shards. A cannon can be set up, but Kurasks are immune to cannon damage.

iorwerth-dungeon-nechryael.name: Iorwerth Dungeon
notes: Contains 16 Greater Nechryael. Quickly accessed with a teleport crystal, requires Song of the Elves, supports a dwarf multicannon, and Greater Nechryael killed here can drop crystal shards.

iorwerth-dungeon-prifddinas.name: Iorwerth Dungeon
notes: Requires Song of the Elves. Contains 13 Iorwerth Warriors, supports a dwarf multicannon, and can be safespotted by using the spaces around fabric panels on the west side of the room.

iorwerth-dungeon-waterfiends.name: Iorwerth Dungeon - Waterfiends
notes: Contains 20 Waterfiends. Requires Song of the Elves and is quickly reached with a teleport crystal. A dwarf multicannon can be used here, and Waterfiends can drop crystal shards in this dungeon.

iorwerth-dungeon.name: Iorwerth Dungeon
notes: Requires Song of the Elves. The mutated bloodveld area is close to the entrance, split into two six-spawn sections, supports a dwarf multicannon, and has safespots.

isle-of-souls-dungeon-fire-giants.name: Isle of Souls Dungeon
notes: A cannon can AoE Fire giants by placing it in the middle and running to the safespot at the hall entrance. Stamina potions are recommended.

isle-of-souls-dungeon-metal-dragons.name: Isle of Souls Dungeon
notes: Contains 3 iron dragons and supports cannoning.

isle-of-souls-dungeon.name: Isle of Souls Dungeon
notes: Blue dragons here include 4 adults and 3 babies. A cannon can be placed, making this an acceptable Konar Blue dragons location even though the room mixes adults and babies.

jiggig-dungeon.name: Jiggig Dungeon
notes: Dungeon beneath Jiggig with the largest concentration of Zogres and Skogres (requires Zogre Flesh Eaters progress). Not cannonable, but safespottable. Brutal arrows work best.

jiggig.name: Jiggig
notes: Ogre burial ground west of Castle Wars; Zogres and Skogres spawn here (requires Zogre Flesh Eaters progress). Multicombat, not cannonable, but safespottable. Brutal arrows work best.

jormungand-s-prison-dagannoth.name: Jormungand's Prison
notes: Requires The Fremennik Exiles. The Dagannoth section is multicombat, cannonable, safespottable, and contains melee-only Dagannoth for straightforward Protect from Melee tasks.

jormungand-s-prison.name: Jormungand's Prison
notes: Requires The Fremennik Exiles for Basilisk Knight access. Contains standard Basilisks, Basilisk Knights, and The Jormungand quest fight; a mirror shield or V's shield is required.

kalphite-cave.name: Kalphite Cave
notes: Slayer task-exclusive Kalphite area east of Shantay Pass with 18 Workers, 20 Soldiers, and 5 Guardians across five open chambers. Recommended for normal Kalphite tasks.

kalphite-lair.name: Kalphite Lair
notes: Contains 13 Workers, 7 Soldiers, 4 Guardians, and 1 Queen. A rope is required to access the lair unless the Hard Desert Diary has made the entrance permanent; a second rope is needed for the Queen's lair.

kalphite-queen-lair.name: Kalphite Lair
notes: Boss encounter area; prepare a separate boss trip. Consult the linked strategy for encounter access and hazards.

karuulm-slayer-dungeon-drakes.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon
notes: Drakes are on the middle level of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon. Wear boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete. Use the task-only area for better cannon coverage in the smaller room.

requiredItems.name: Karuulm heat protection
requiredItems.waiverRequirement: Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary reward claimed

karuulm-slayer-dungeon-fire-giants.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon
notes: Set up a cannon in the middle of the room and stand in the entrance hallway for a safespot, allowing rapid cannon fire in a single-combat area. Stamina potions are recommended for reloads. Requires boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete.

requiredItems.name: Karuulm heat protection
requiredItems.waiverRequirement: Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary reward claimed

karuulm-slayer-dungeon-greater-demons.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon - Greater demons
notes: Greater demon area with a safespot between two stone chests on the northern side. Stone boots or equivalent heat protection are required unless the relevant diary protection applies.

requiredItems.name: Karuulm heat protection
requiredItems.waiverRequirement: Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary reward claimed

karuulm-slayer-dungeon-hellhounds.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon
notes: Hellhounds here require boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots unless the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete. Contains 12 Hellhounds, supports a cannon, and has a safespot near the Hellhound section entrance.

requiredItems.name: Karuulm heat protection
requiredItems.waiverRequirement: Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary reward claimed

karuulm-slayer-dungeon-hydras.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon
notes: The task-only hydra area holds 17 hydras and is single-combat but cannonable. Boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots are required against the floor heat unless the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete.

requiredItems.name: Karuulm heat protection
requiredItems.waiverRequirement: Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary reward claimed

karuulm-slayer-dungeon-wyrms.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon - Wyrms
notes: Contains 16 Wyrms on the lower level, including seven in the task-only area south of the main group. Wear boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete. Wyrms can be safespotted with Ranged in the task-only area and cannot be cannoned.

requiredItems.name: Karuulm heat protection
requiredItems.waiverRequirement: Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary reward claimed

karuulm-slayer-dungeon.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon
notes: Beneath Mount Karuulm in the Kebos Lowlands (not Wilderness). Boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots are needed to cross the heated floor, or complete the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary to ignore it. No safespot is documented for its wyrms, drakes, and hydras.

requiredItems.name: Karuulm heat protection
requiredItems.waiverRequirement: Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary reward claimed

kebos-lowlands.name: Kebos Lowlands
notes: Open region south-west of Great Kourend (not Wilderness). The Slayer task/Lizardmen table (pageid 297852) lists the Kebos Swamp spawns as single-combat and NOT cannonable.

keldagrim-entrance-trolls.name: Keldagrim entrance tunnel
notes: Contains 7 level 69 mountain trolls. Narrow passage makes cannon placement difficult, but rocks at the sides of the passage can be used to safespot.

kharidian-desert-lizards.name: Kharidian Desert (Desert Lizards)
notes: Desert Lizards roam the Kharidian Desert (south of the Shantay Pass and around Pollnivneach). The Desert Heat mechanic drains Hitpoints, so carry waterskins or desert-resistant gear. Each lizard must be finished with an ice cooler below 5 Hitpoints. The Slayer task/Lizards table (pageid 298269) lists the Kharidian Desert as cannonable and safespottable, though kills must be finished with an ice cooler so a cannon is counterproductive.

killerwatt-plane.name: Killerwatt Plane
notes: A pocket dimension reached through the telescope in the upstairs study of Draynor Manor; Ernest the Chicken must be complete to use the telescope. Insulated boots roughly halve the Killerwatt's damage (their Ranged max hit is 15 without them). Multi, cannon and safespot availability are not wiki-confirmed for the plane, so conservative defaults are used.

king-black-dragon-lair-lesser-demons.name: King Black Dragon Lair
notes: 4 Lesser demons around the King Black Dragon arena; multicombat, and the wiki marks the lesser demon row cannonable and safespottable. Accessed through a lever in the Wilderness, but the arena itself is NOT part of the Wilderness.

king-black-dragon-lair.name: King Black Dragon Lair
notes: The boss chamber is outside PvP Wilderness, but the normal route crosses Wilderness and can expose carried equipment to other players.

kingstown.name: Kingstown
notes: One Lesser demon in Kingstown; single-combat, cannonable and safespottable.

kourend-castle.name: Kourend Castle
notes: One caged Lesser demon in Kourend Castle; single-combat, NOT cannonable, safespotted through the cage so ranged, magic, or a halberd is required. A prayer altar and bank are nearby.

kraken-boss-cove.name: Kraken Cove
notes: Boss encounter area; prepare a separate boss trip. Consult the linked strategy for encounter access and hazards.

kraken-cove-waterfiends.name: Kraken Cove - Waterfiends
notes: Contains 15 task-only Waterfiends. Fairy ring AKQ is the quick route. The task-page row marks this area as not cannonable and not safespottable.

kraken-cove.name: Kraken Cove
notes: Requires 87 Slayer and 50 Magic for Cave kraken tasks. Fairy ring AKQ is the fastest route, with Piscatoris teleport or Western banner as alternatives. Contains regular Cave kraken whirlpools and the Kraken boss whirlpool; Fishing explosives can instantly release the Kraken boss but not regular Cave krakens.

kurask-lair.name: Kurask Lair
notes: Contains 8 tightly clumped Kurasks. Requires 58 Sailing to dock on Laguna Aurorae for the first time; after speaking to the island spirit tree, docking is no longer required and the tree is closer to the lair.

lava-dragon-isle.name: Lava Dragon Isle
notes: Lava Dragon Isle in the deep Wilderness (around levels 36-42), reached across the lava in the north-east Wilderness. A well-known player-killing hotspot; multi and cannon status are not wiki-stated, so treated conservatively as false. Bring only low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport.

lava-maze-dungeon.name: Lava Maze Dungeon
notes: Wilderness Black dragon location. Access is significantly troublesome without 82 Agility and otherwise requires traversing the Lava Maze with a knife to cut webs; poison protection is useful due to poison spiders.
Burning amulet teleports to the Lava Maze in the Wilderness.

lava-maze.name: Lava Maze
notes: Surface Lava Maze in level 40-45 Wilderness holds 2 Lesser demons; single-combat, cannonable and safespottable. A slash weapon or knife is needed to cut through the webs. High PK risk - do not bring items you are unwilling to lose.

legends-guild-dungeon.name: Legends' Guild Dungeon
notes: 19 Shadow warrior spawns in the Legends' Guild Dungeon; completion of Legends' Quest is required for assignment and guild access. Safespot through the fence separating them from the pit scorpions or behind the fungus near the cavern wall. Multicombat and cannon placement are not wiki-stated for this area, so conservative defaults are used.

lighthouse-basement.name: Lighthouse Basement
notes: Requires Horror from the Deep. Multicombat Dagannoth area near fairy ring ALP; strong AFK and dwarf cannon option, often busy because it can provide very fast Slayer experience.

lithkren-vault-metal-dragons.name: Lithkren Vault
notes: Contains 5 adamant and 5 rune dragons. Only accessible after completion of Dragon Slayer II.

lizardman-canyon.name: Lizardman Canyon
notes: In the Kebos Lowlands (not Wilderness). The wiki marks this lizardman spawn as not safespottable; it is a multicombat, cannonable area.

lizardman-caves.name: Lizardman Caves
notes: Eight shamans in a single-combat cave network. Only the northern entrance is usable. Captain Cleive prevents combat without a Lizardmen Slayer assignment. Cannons cannot be set up. Fairy ring BLS is south of the entrance; Xeric's Lookout and the Graveyard of Heroes are other routes.

lizardman-settlement.name: Lizardman Settlement
notes: In the Kebos Lowlands (not Wilderness). The Slayer task/Lizardmen table (pageid 297852) lists the Settlement as single-combat and NOT cannonable.

lizardman-temple.name: Lizardman Temple
notes: Six shamans, two per chamber, below Molch. Enter through a one-way lizard dwelling and leave through the south-west strange hole or teleport. Cannons cannot be placed. Repeated barrier crossings cause escalating10/20 damage after3/6 crossings; each crossing adds a minute to recovery. No Slayer assignment is required.

lletya-upstairs.name: Lletya (upstairs)
notes: Requires enough Mourning's End Part I progress to access Lletya. Contains 1 upstairs Elf Archer; the task page marks this upstairs spawn as cannonable but not safespottable.

lletya.name: Lletya
notes: Requires enough Mourning's End Part I progress to access Lletya. Contains 1 Elf Archer and 2 Elf Warriors downstairs; use the bench near the entrance, village poles, or the wall closest to Arianwyn to safespot warriors, with a nearby bank and upstairs prayer altar.

lumbridge-swamp-caves.name: Lumbridge Swamp Caves
notes: Caves beneath Lumbridge Swamp, entered by tying a rope to the hole east of the swamp; a light source is required and open flames are extinguished by the swamp gas. Home to cave bugs, cave slime, cave crawlers, rockslugs and wall beasts. A Dwarf multicannon can be used here. A spiny helmet is needed to safely attack wall beasts. Multi and safespot availability are not wiki-confirmed (conservative defaults).
Tie a rope to the swamp hole to descend; bring a light source.

lunar-isle-north-suqah.name: North Lunar Isle
notes: Contains 16 Suqah north of Lunar Isle. This is the dense cannon and Ranged safespot area; northern Suqah use melee plus weak Ice Barrage and Water Wave, so Protect from Magic and high Melee defence are recommended.

lunar-isle-south-east-suqah.name: South-east Lunar Isle
notes: Contains 4 Suqah in south-east Lunar Isle near the Astral Altar. These southern Suqah are sparse but avoid the northern magic attacks and can be cannoned and safespotted.

lunar-isle-south-west-suqah.name: South-west Lunar Isle
notes: Contains 6 Suqah in the single-way south-west Lunar Isle area. A cannon placed directly north-west of the dead tree targets the melee-only Suqah while avoiding the nearby magic-using Suqah.

lunar-isle.name: Lunar Isle
notes: Lunar Isle, reachable after at least starting Lunar Diplomacy (not Wilderness). Suqahs can be safespotted on the bridge or by a tree; the hybrid variant does not cast out of melee range.

mammoth-wilderness.name: Wilderness (south-east of Ferox Enclave)
notes: Mammoths roam the Wilderness south-east of Ferox Enclave. Bring low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport. The Mammoth wiki page (pageid 30180) calls this an efficient dwarf multicannon spot; their 3x3 size makes them easy to safespot (single-combat).

meiyerditch-laboratories.name: Meiyerditch Laboratories
notes: Requires partial completion of Sins of the Father after killing the quest mutated bloodveld. The area has four regular Bloodvelds and seven Mutated Bloodvelds, is multicombat and cannonable, but is somewhat hard to reach.

meiyerditch.name: Meiyerditch
notes: Requires starting Darkness of Hallowvale. Contains Vampyre Juvinates and many Vyrewatch across the city.

miscellania-and-etceteria-dungeon.name: Miscellania and Etceteria Dungeon
notes: The dungeon beneath Miscellania and Etceteria, entered during and after Royal Trouble. It houses the Sea snake hatchling and Sea snake young Slayer monsters. The area is single combat but a dwarf multicannon may be used; the blue eggs halfway through the tunnel serve as a safespot. Sea snakes are poisonous, so an antipoison is recommended.

mogre-camp.name: Mogre Camp
notes: The Mogre Camp holds level 21/23 Crabs and requires partial completion of Recipe for Disaster (Freeing Pirate Pete) to access. Conservative multi, cannon and safespot defaults are used as they are not wiki-confirmed here.

molch.name: Molch
notes: Konar assignment area covering Molch and the Lizardman Temple beneath it. Use the dedicated Temple chamber location for shamans; its one-way entrances, single-combat rooms and non-cannon rules are recorded separately. Parent-area capability flags are conservative; this record is used to match the exact assignment area.

mole-hole.name: Mole Hole
notes: A lit light source is needed in the Mole Hole. A Falador shield 3 or 4 helps locate the mole after it burrows.

monkey-spawns.name: Monkey spawns
notes: Common monkeys (combat level 3) are scattered across Karamja (south-east, near Shilo Village, around Brimhaven and the volcano, east of Tai Bwo Wannai), Ape Atoll, Mos Le'Harmless and the Ardougne Zoo. Karamja spawns are the most convenient. Maniacal monkeys and the boss Kruk / M'amba do NOT count toward this task. The Slayer task/Monkeys table (pageid 298251) lists essentially every monkey spot as cannonable (single-combat).

mor-ul-rek-inner-tzhaar-ket.name: Mor Ul Rek inner TzHaar-Ket
notes: Show a fire cape once to enter the inner area. The level 221 TzHaar-Ket around TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges can be grouped with darts, knives, goading potion, or Dinh's bulwark special for burst and barrage methods.

mor-ul-rek-tzhaar-city.name: Mor Ul Rek (TzHaar City)
notes: Unlocked as a task by purchasing Hot Stuff for 100 slayer points. Use Karamja volcano or TzHaar teleports to reach the city; Ket and melee-using Xil can be safespotted through vents.

mortton.name: Mort'ton
notes: Mort'ton in Morytania is home to the Loar Shades, the fastest Shades to kill for the task; Priest in Peril is required for access. Shades are undead, so a salve amulet (e) applies. Multi, cannon and safespot are not wiki-confirmed here, so conservative defaults are used.

mos-le-harmless-cave.name: Mos Le'Harmless Cave
notes: Requires Cabin Fever to access Mos Le'Harmless. Contains 70 Cave horrors, supports a dwarf multicannon, and has many safespots using mushrooms, stalagmites, boulders, the swamp, and entrance obstacles. A light source is required unless the Fire of eternal light is lit.

mos-le-harmless.name: Mos Le'Harmless
notes: Requires Cabin Fever to reach the island. About 50 Jungle horror spawns roam the surface, densest in the camp north of the cave exit; walls, plants, and trees provide safespots. Multicombat and cannon-placement status of the surface are unverified on the wiki, so both default to false. Jungle horrors are not cannon-immune and the island surface is not a prohibited area, so a cannon can be used (single-combat).

moss-giants-wilderness.name: Deep Wilderness
notes: Moss giants spawn in the deep Wilderness (about 6 free-to-play spawns); only Wilderness kills count towards a Krystilia assignment. This is a PvP area, so bring only expendable gear. The Slayer task/Moss giants table (pageid 298114) lists the Wilderness canoe pond spot as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat, 6 spawns).

mount-quidamortem-north-east-trolls.name: South of Mount Quidamortem north-east
notes: Contains 7 mountain trolls. More open than the south-west Mount Quidamortem troll location, making multi-troll luring easier; rocks can be used to safespot and the area is closer to a bank than most mountain troll spots.

mount-quidamortem-south-west-trolls.name: South of Mount Quidamortem south-west
notes: Contains 7 mountain trolls. The task page notes the high number of obstacles makes safespotting easier.

mourner-headquarters-elves.name: Mourner Headquarters
notes: Only the 4 level 108 Mourners downstairs count for Elves tasks. Requires Mourning's End Part I access and Mourner gear unless Mourning's End Part II is complete for the nearby Slayer ring Dark beast teleport; unavailable after Song of the Elves.

mourner-tunnels-iorwerth-dungeon.name: Mourner Tunnels / Iorwerth Dungeon
notes: Reached via the Mourner Tunnels or, after Song of the Elves, directly from Prifddinas' Iorwerth district (not Wilderness). No safespot is documented for its dark beasts and elves on the Iorwerth Dungeon wiki page.

mourner-tunnels.name: Mourner Tunnels
notes: Requires starting Mourning's End Part II. Contains 19 Dark beasts, is single-combat, supports a dwarf multicannon, and is easily accessed with a Slayer ring after completing Mourning's End Part II.

mudskipper-point.name: Mudskipper Point
notes: Mudskipper Point is south of Rimmington on the south-western coast. Mogres hide in the sand and must be lured out with a fishing explosive used on the mud patches; Skippy and the Mogres must be complete. The Slayer task/Ogres table (pageid 298279) lists Mudskipper Point mogres as cannonable (3 spawns), and the Mogre page documents a halberd/cannon safespot.

mynydd.name: Mynydd
notes: Requires Song of the Elves. Black dragon spawn is very far from a bank and only has one spawn.

neypotzli-sulphur-nagua.name: Neypotzli
notes: 14 Sulphur Nagua; requires Perilous Moons. Supplies can be made freely inside - moonlight potions act as super combat, divine super defence, and prayer restoration - and the area is safespottable.

neypotzli-wyrmlings.name: Neypotzli - Wyrmlings
notes: Contains 6 Wyrmlings in the Earthbound Cavern after partial Perilous Moons progress. The close cluster supports a cannon and a nearby safespot; players can make cooked bream, cooked moss lizards, and moonlight potions inside, but Wyrmlings only drop Wyrmling bones.

ogre-enclave-watchtower.name: Ogre Enclave
notes: Requires Watchtower. Blue dragons are far apart, can be cannoned and safespotted, and banking can use Ring of dueling to Castle Wars then run east to Gu'Tanoth; cannon also targets nearby spiders and skeletons.
Ring of dueling to Castle Wars, then run to the Watchtower ogre enclave.

pirates-hideout.name: Pirates' Hideout
notes: In the deep Wilderness (level 54), north-east of the Deserted Keep. A lockpick and 39 Thieving are required to pick the door lock and enter. Single-way combat building with aggressive pirates. Deep-Wilderness PKer risk; the wiki does not document a cannon spot or safespot here, so these are set conservatively to false.

poison-waste-dungeon-terrorbird-lower.name: Poison Waste Dungeon - terrorbird lower level
notes: Requires The Path of Glouphrie, a crystal chime, and earmuffs or Slayer helmet for safer terrorbird damage. Lower-level terrorbirds are multicombat and cannonable.

evidence.title: Poison Waste Dungeon - terrorbird lower level

poison-waste-dungeon-terrorbird-main.name: Poison Waste Dungeon - terrorbird main level
notes: Requires The Path of Glouphrie, a crystal chime, and earmuffs or Slayer helmet for safer terrorbird damage. Task-page safespotting is conditional on door, corner, or waste-pit pathing.

evidence.title: Poison Waste Dungeon - terrorbird main level

poison-waste-dungeon-tortoise-lower.name: Poison Waste Dungeon - tortoise lower level
notes: Requires The Path of Glouphrie and a crystal chime. Lower-level Warped Tortoises are multicombat, cannonable, and safespottable.

evidence.title: Poison Waste Dungeon - tortoise lower level

poison-waste-dungeon-tortoise-main.name: Poison Waste Dungeon - tortoise main level
notes: Requires The Path of Glouphrie and a crystal chime. Main-level Warped Tortoises are multicombat, cannonable, and safespottable.

evidence.title: Poison Waste Dungeon - tortoise main level

prifddinas-east-gate.name: Prifddinas East Gate
notes: Requires Song of the Elves. Contains 2 Prifddinas guards, is close to a bank, and has a south guard safespot by attacking outside wander radius and pushing it against the gate.

prifddinas-market-place.name: Prifddinas market place
notes: Requires Song of the Elves. Contains 3 Prifddinas guards and can be safespotted by shooting over Glenda.

prifddinas-north-gate.name: Prifddinas North Gate
notes: Requires Song of the Elves. Contains 2 Prifddinas guards and is close to a bank, altar, and Spirit tree; guards can be safespotted by luring near Iwan and attacking from outside wander radius.

prifddinas-south-gate.name: Prifddinas South Gate
notes: Requires Song of the Elves. Contains 2 Prifddinas guards at the South Gate; both are safespottable by attacking from outside their wander radius and pushing them against the gate.

prifddinas-west-gate.name: Prifddinas West Gate
notes: Requires Song of the Elves. Contains 2 Prifddinas guards, is close to a house portal, and has a north guard safespot by attacking from outside wander radius and pushing it against the gate.

rat-spawns.name: Rat spawns
notes: Rats and giant rats are among the most common monsters in Gielinor. Rats appear in cities, sewers and dungeons (Lumbridge, Draynor, Varrock, Stronghold of Security). Giant rats swarm the Lumbridge Swamp (27 spawns), Varrock Sewers, Edgeville Dungeon and the Stronghold of Security. These are the ordinary rats/giant rats: brine rats are a SEPARATE Slayer family (Brine Rat Cavern) and do NOT count here. Multi, cannon and safespot availability are not wiki-confirmed (conservative defaults).

revenant-caves.name: Revenant Caves
notes: The Revenant Caves sit in the Wilderness (levels 17-40), entered from the Wilderness or via the Ferox Enclave shortcut. The caves are singles-plus combat, so a dwarf multicannon cannot be placed and player killers can attack you while you fight a revenant. Safe-spotting is not wiki-documented and treated conservatively as false. Bring only low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport.

river-elid.name: River Elid (south of Pollnivneach)
notes: Crocodiles are found in the Kharidian Desert south of Pollnivneach on either side of the River Elid, with further spawns near the Ruins of Unkah, near the Ruins of Ullek, and (after Icthlarin's Little Helper) just north of Sophanem. Bring waterskins to survive the desert heat. Safespots exist: a cactus west of the magic carpet at Nardah covers two water spawns, and the wall east of the Ruins of Unkah covers others; the water-bound crocodiles can be ranged/maged from one tile back from the shore. Multi and cannon are not wiki-confirmed here, so conservative defaults are used.

rock-crabs-rellekka.name: Rock Crabs (North of Rellekka)
notes: Rock Crabs are found on the coast directly north of Rellekka, with very plentiful spawn points; other spawns exist at Waterbirth Island, west of Mount Quidamortem, in the Waterbirth Island Dungeon, and in the Brine Rat Cavern. They appear as inactive 'rocks' until a player stands adjacent, then become aggressive; aggression must be reset by leaving and returning after 10 minutes.

rogues-castle.name: Rogues' Castle (Wilderness)
notes: Rogue spawns across the floors of Rogues' Castle in the deep north-east Wilderness (~level 50+). Krystilia only counts Wilderness kills. The Chaos Elemental roams the courtyard and can attack through walls. Multicombat, cannon and safespot are not wiki-stated for this spot; conservative defaults are used. Deep-Wilderness PKer risk is high.

royal-titans-arena.name: Royal Titans
notes: Royal Titans encounter in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon. No quest, skill or item is required to access the encounter; prepare for both Branda and Eldric using the shared strategy. Solo and duo approaches are supported. The fight is outside the Wilderness and bosses are immune to cannons.

ruins-of-tapoyauik-frost-nagua.name: Ruins of Tapoyauik
notes: 11 Frost Nagua (wiki: not safespottable, unlike the blue-dragon area of the base file). Supplies cannot be made here, but moonlight moths can be caught inside to restore prayer; the Amoxliatl boss is a task alternative.

ruins-of-tapoyauik-jellies.name: Ruins of Tapoyauik
notes: Requires The Heart of Darkness. Contains 10 Chilled Jellies in a single-combat area; they can be safespotted by standing behind the smaller icicles. Chilled Jellies are 50% susceptible to fire spells.

ruins-of-tapoyauik.name: Ruins of Tapoyauik
notes: Requires The Heart of Darkness. Contains 7 adult Blue dragons, 7 baby Blue dragons, and 5 Brutal blue dragons; charged Pendant of ates gives very fast access, and nearby moonlight moths can provide prayer.

sand-crabs-crabclaw-isle.name: Sand Crabs (Crabclaw Isle / Hosidius coast)
notes: Sand Crabs have very plentiful spawn points across many areas: Crabclaw Isle, the Crabclaw Caves, the southern Hosidius coast, east of the Hosidius vinery, the Isle of Souls, the Avium Savannah, and Outer Fortis. They appear as inactive 'sandy rocks' until a player stands adjacent; aggression is reset by leaving and returning after the 10-minute tolerance timer.

scorpion-pit-cave.name: Scorpion Pit
notes: Boss encounter area; prepare a separate boss trip. Consult the linked strategy for encounter access and hazards.

scorpions-area.name: Non-Wilderness scorpions
notes: Non-Wilderness scorpions for Turael, Spria, and Mazchna tasks: the Al Kharid mine, the Dwarven Mine, and Karamja hold level 14 scorpions, while King scorpions (level 32) are in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon and Keldagrim scorpion mine. The Slayer task/Scorpions table (pageid 297991) lists the Al Kharid Mine as cannonable and safespottable; the Dwarven Mine alternative bans cannons (prohibited area).

scorpions-wilderness.name: Wilderness scorpions
notes: Wilderness scorpion spawns (near the Bandit Camp and south-east Wilderness) for Krystilia's task. Bring only risk-appropriate gear as PKers frequent the area. The Slayer task/Scorpions table (pageid 297991) lists the Scorpion Pit as multi-combat, cannonable and safespottable; a cannon finishes the task in under a minute.

scurrius-lair.name: Varrock Sewers - Scurrius lair
notes: Enter Varrock Sewers through the manhole east of Varrock Palace and continue east to the broken bars. The free private instance contains the weaker solo form; the public arena contains the stronger group form. Group Ironmen can share an instance. Exit through the sewage water; re-entry has an approximately 15-second delay. Cannons and fires are prohibited. The Wiki includes Blood Barrage as a magic alternative in this multicombat area; this is not a safespot. Graves appear beside Historian Aldo outside the lair.

shellbane-gryphon-cave.name: Shellbane Gryphon Cave
notes: Task-only boss cave in the centre of the Great Conch leading to the solo instanced Shellbane Gryphon encounter.

silk-chasm.name: Silk Chasm
requirements: Medium Wilderness Diary completed or Venenatis boss assignment
notes: Wilderness boss lair. Requires the medium Wilderness Diary or the matching Venenatis boss Slayer assignment; an ordinary creature assignment does not waive the diary. Entry costs 50,000 coins, repayable after the applicable PvP death. Check the linked strategy for travel and risk.

sisterhood-sanctuary.name: Sisterhood Sanctuary
notes: Sisterhood Sanctuary under Slepe holds 9 Lesser demons; single-combat, cannonable and safespottable. Requires Sins of the Father progress for full access.

skeletal-tomb.name: Skeletal Tomb
requirements: Hard Wilderness Diary completed or Vet'ion boss assignment
notes: Wilderness boss lair. Requires the hard Wilderness Diary or the matching Vet'ion boss Slayer assignment; an ordinary creature assignment does not waive the diary. Entry costs 50,000 coins, repayable after the applicable PvP death. Check the linked strategy for travel and risk.

skeletons-area.name: Non-Wilderness skeletons
notes: Non-Wilderness skeletons for Turael, Spria, and Mazchna tasks: the Edgeville Dungeon, Varrock Sewers, and Draynor/Wizards' Tower basements hold level 21/22 skeletons. The Slayer task/Skeletons table (pageid 298266) lists both Edgeville Dungeon and Varrock Sewers as cannonable.

skotizos-lair.name: Catacombs of Kourend
requirements: Dark totem available for each entry
notes: Boss encounter area; prepare a separate boss trip. Consult the linked strategy for encounter access and hazards.

slayer-tower-basement-nechryael.name: Slayer Tower (basement)
notes: Contains 12 Nechryael in the Slayer Tower basement. They can only be killed on a slayer task; the task-page comparison marks the area single-combat, not cannonable, and safespottable.

slayer-tower-basement.name: Slayer Tower Basement
notes: Task-only basement. Gargoyles can only be killed here while on a Slayer task and Raulyn stops off-task attacks; the Gargoyles task page lists 12 spawns and safespot support. Safespotting requires the Teleport anchoring scroll permanent unlock for Abyssal demons. Bloodveld access is task-only, can be reached from the tower with a Slayer ring route, and may be less busy.
Fairy ring CKS by the Slayer Tower, then descend to the basement (needs a Dramen or Lunar staff).

slayer-tower-roof.name: Slayer Tower roof
requirements: Brittle key used to unlock the Slayer Tower roof
notes: Grotesque Guardians boss arena on the Slayer Tower roof. Requires a brittle key drop from regular Gargoyles to unlock; contains Dawn and Dusk, counts as one task kill unless Double Trouble makes the boss count as two.

slayer-tower-top-floor-nechryael.name: Slayer Tower (top floor)
notes: Contains 11 Nechryael on the Slayer Tower top floor. The task-page comparison marks this area single-combat, not cannonable, and safespottable.

slayer-tower-top-floor.name: Slayer Tower (top floor)
notes: Gargoyles on the top floor of the Slayer Tower. The Gargoyles task page lists 8 spawns, no multicombat, no cannon, and a bookcase safespot; reaching the top floor may require passing banshees and aberrant spectres.

slayer-tower.name: Slayer Tower
notes: Bloodvelds on the first floor can be safespotted and receive additional Slayer experience from completed Morytania Diary tiers; other Slayer Tower tasks may have different floor-specific mechanics.
Fairy ring CKS is beside the Slayer Tower (needs a Dramen or Lunar staff).

slepe.name: Slepe
notes: Recommended after A Taste of Hope for Drakan's medallion travel. Ten aggressive level 105 Vyrewatch are north of Crombwick Manor near an Altar of Zamorak prayer route.

smoke-devil-dungeon.name: Smoke Devil Dungeon
notes: task-only dungeon south of Castle Wars, also reachable by fairy ring BKP. The main Smoke devil room is multicombat, cannonable, and used for Ice Burst or Ice Barrage grouping; a cannon placed in the Thermonuclear smoke devil boss room is destroyed.

smoke-dungeon-dust-devils.name: Smoke Dungeon
notes: Requires partial Desert Treasure I access and face protection from smoke effects and Dust devils. The task-only western multicombat area is guarded by Dusty Aliv and is good for bursting or barraging, but cannot use a dwarf multicannon; the remaining single-way rooms can be cannoned. Wearing a Slayer helmet here for a Dust devil kill is required for the Hard Desert Diary.

smoke-dungeon-fire-giants.name: Smoke Dungeon
notes: Requires wearing a Facemask, Slayer helmet, or Gas mask to avoid smoke damage. The northern wall of the entrance can safespot only the north-west Fire giant. The task page notes Konar does not assign this location and it is not recommended because too few giants are scattered around.

smoke-dungeon.name: Smoke Dungeon
notes: Beneath the Kharidian Desert via the smoky well near Pollnivneach (not Wilderness). A facemask or Slayer helmet is needed for the smoke; dust devils here can be safespotted.

sophanem-dungeon-cavern.name: Sophanem Dungeon (cavern)
notes: Requires Contact! (partial completion). The cavern level holds 27 Locust riders and 18 Scarab mages; multicombat and cannonable. Watch the floor trap at the entrance and bring a lantern and tinderbox.

sophanem-dungeon-maze.name: Sophanem Dungeon (maze)
notes: Requires Contact! (partial completion). The maze level holds 2 Locust riders and 10 Scarab mages; multicombat but no cannon. The two scarab mages on the north-west side suit prayer flicking against their slow 15-tick attacks.

sourhog-cave.name: Sourhog Cave (Draynor)
notes: Sourhog Cave is south of Draynor Village and is only accessible after starting the quest A Porcine of Interest. Multi, cannon and safespot are conservative defaults and not wiki-confirmed for this cave.

spiders-area.name: Common spider spawns
notes: Common spiders spawn across free-to-play areas of Gielinor; these kills count towards a Turael or Spria Spiders task. Multicombat, cannon placement and safespots are not wiki-stated, so conservative defaults are used.

spiders-wilderness.name: Wilderness spider spawns
notes: Common spiders spawn at several Wilderness spots (e.g. near the Ruins); these kills count towards a Krystilia Spiders task. Multicombat, cannon placement and safespots are not wiki-stated, so conservative defaults are used. This is a PvP zone; bring Wilderness-appropriate risk gear.

spiritual-mages-ancient-prison.name: God Wars Dungeon - Ancient Prison Spiritual mages
notes: Ancient Prison (Zaros) Spiritual mages; requires The Frozen Door miniquest. Multicombat and safespottable but not cannonable. Zaros variants are significantly stronger than the other gods' Spiritual creatures.

evidence.title: God Wars Dungeon - Ancient Prison Spiritual mages

spiritual-mages-god-wars-dungeon.name: God Wars Dungeon - Spiritual mages
notes: Main God Wars Dungeon Spiritual mages; multicombat and safespottable but not cannonable. Requires Death Plateau and 60 Strength or 60 Agility for assignment, plus god-affiliated protection items (Zamorak and usually Saradomin) for follower tolerance.

spiritual-mages-wilderness-god-wars-dung.name: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon - Spiritual mages
notes: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon Spiritual mages in level 28-32 Wilderness; do not bring items you are unwilling to lose. Multicombat and safespottable but not cannonable.

evidence.title: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon - Spiritual mages

spiritual-rangers-ancient-prison.name: God Wars Dungeon - Ancient Prison Spiritual rangers
notes: Ancient Prison (Zaros) Spiritual rangers; requires The Frozen Door miniquest. Multicombat and safespottable but not cannonable. Zaros variants are significantly stronger than the other gods' Spiritual creatures.

evidence.title: God Wars Dungeon - Ancient Prison Spiritual rangers

spiritual-rangers-god-wars-dungeon.name: God Wars Dungeon - Spiritual rangers
notes: Main God Wars Dungeon Spiritual rangers; multicombat and safespottable but not cannonable. Requires Death Plateau and 60 Strength or 60 Agility for assignment, plus god-affiliated protection items (Zamorak and usually Saradomin) for follower tolerance.

spiritual-rangers-wilderness-god-wars-du.name: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon - Spiritual rangers
notes: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon Spiritual rangers in level 28-32 Wilderness; do not bring items you are unwilling to lose. Multicombat and safespottable but not cannonable.

evidence.title: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon - Spiritual rangers

spiritual-warriors-ancient-prison.name: God Wars Dungeon - Ancient Prison Spiritual warriors
notes: Ancient Prison (Zaros) Spiritual warriors; requires The Frozen Door miniquest. Multicombat and safespottable but not cannonable. Zaros variants are significantly stronger than the other gods' Spiritual creatures.

evidence.title: God Wars Dungeon - Ancient Prison Spiritual warriors

spiritual-warriors-god-wars-dungeon.name: God Wars Dungeon - Spiritual warriors
notes: Main God Wars Dungeon Spiritual warriors; multicombat and safespottable but not cannonable. Requires Death Plateau and 60 Strength or 60 Agility for assignment, plus god-affiliated protection items (Zamorak and usually Saradomin) for follower tolerance.

spiritual-warriors-wilderness-god-wars-d.name: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon - Spiritual warriors
notes: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon Spiritual warriors in level 28-32 Wilderness; do not bring items you are unwilling to lose. Multicombat and safespottable but not cannonable.

evidence.title: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon - Spiritual warriors

stalker-den-custodian-stalkers.name: Stalker Den
notes: Requires completion of Shadows of Custodia for full access. Custodian stalkers occupy multicombat cannonable zones in the south-west and single-combat caverns in the south-east and north; a safespot is documented for Elder custodian stalkers in a western single-combat area, so these flags describe supported zones rather than every tile.

stalker-den-zygomites.name: Stalker Den
notes: Contains 9 Ancient Zygomites in the Stalker Den under Custodia Pass. The area is multicombat, cannonable, and safespottable.

stronghold-of-security-catablepon.name: Stronghold of Security (Catablepon)
notes: Catablepon in the Stronghold of Security, entered via the ladder in Barbarian Village. The wiki cites the Pit of Pestilence area; the exact sub-level is left for QA to live-verify. Family-tuned copy of the stronghold-of-security base file, whose Ankou safespot/konarLockable flags do not apply to catablepon. Multi, cannon and safespot status are not wiki-stated and left conservative (false).

stronghold-of-security-flesh-crawlers.name: Stronghold of Security (Flesh Crawlers)
notes: Flesh Crawlers on the Catacomb of Famine (2nd level) of the Stronghold of Security, entered via the ladder in Barbarian Village. Family-tuned copy of the stronghold-of-security base file, whose Ankou safespot/konarLockable flags do not apply to flesh crawlers. Multi, cannon and safespot status are not wiki-stated and left conservative (false).

stronghold-of-security-minotaurs.name: Stronghold of Security (Minotaurs)
notes: Minotaurs in the Vault of War (first level) of the Stronghold of Security, entered via the ladder in Barbarian Village. Family-tuned copy of the stronghold-of-security base file, whose Ankou safespot/konarLockable/cannon flags do not apply to minotaurs. Multi, cannon and safespot status are not wiki-stated and left conservative (false).

stronghold-of-security.name: Stronghold of Security
notes: Ankou safespot is in the Sepulchre of Death south-west room, on the south side of the south-easternmost skeleton.
Amulet of glory to Edgeville, then run west to the Stronghold of Security under Barbarian Village.

stronghold-slayer-cave-fire-giants.name: Stronghold Slayer Cave
notes: Requires a Slayer task. Contains 12 Fire giants arranged as groups of 3 separated by safespots.

stronghold-slayer-cave.name: Stronghold Slayer Cave
notes: Bloodvelds here are close to Nieve, support a dwarf multicannon, and can be safespotted. Use a Slayer ring, Spirit tree to Tree Gnome Stronghold, or necklace of passage to Outpost. Hellhounds here are the primary non-Wilderness task option, with 13 spawns across four rooms of three or four Hellhounds, cannon support, and safespots.
Slayer ring teleports directly to the Stronghold Slayer Cave.

tai-bwo-wannai.name: North-east of Tai Bwo Wannai
notes: Karamja jungle north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai (fairy ring DKP); reached via Tai Bwo Wannai teleport scroll or the Brimhaven boat. Two safespots exist and a dwarf multicannon can be used, but the bug lantern must stay equipped for the cannon to damage swarms. Bring antipoison for nearby aggressive, poisonous creatures; Tai Bwo Wannai Trio unlocks the Tribal Statue prayer recharge.

tarns-lair.name: Tarn's Lair
notes: Tarn's Lair is south of the Haunted Mine in southern Morytania; the terror dog room is the chamber where Tarn Razorlor was fought during the Lair of Tarn Razorlor miniquest (Haunted Mine required). A slayer ring teleport is the fastest access; the trek on foot is long and dangerous (Skeleton mages, traps). The terror dog room is multi-combat, drains Prayer at 1 point per 2 ticks (50/minute), and cannot host a dwarf multicannon. Terror dogs can be safespotted from Tarn's room with Magic or Ranged once tolerant. Burst is left false as it is not wiki-confirmed here.

taverley-dungeon-upper.name: Taverley Dungeon (upper level)
notes: Black dragons in this upper level can only be killed while on a Slayer task. Includes 12 adult dragons and 5 baby dragons; the baby black dragon task-only area can be AFKed quickly. Blue dragons here are task-only adults and require level 70 Agility for a shortcut or a dusty key.
Falador teleport, then run west to the Taverley Dungeon.

taverley-dungeon.name: Taverley Dungeon
notes: Black demon area has safespots by the south-west stalagmites and in a north-east crevice; requires Dusty Key or 70 Agility. Also contains lower-level Black dragon spawns and task-only baby black dragon access. Blue dragon area contains 9 adult Blue dragons and 12 baby Blue dragons, supports a cannon, and is the fast baby-blue-dragon task option; ring of dueling plus Enlightened Journey can speed banking. Hellhounds here have 13 spawns, support a cannon, can be safespotted on rocks and columns, and 80 Agility is highly recommended.
Falador teleport, then run west to the Taverley Dungeon.

temple-of-ikov.name: Temple of Ikov
notes: Temple of Ikov holds 3 Lesser demons; multicombat, cannonable and safespottable. Requires a shiny key and partial Temple of Ikov to reach.

thermonuclear-smoke-devil-lair.name: Smoke Devil Dungeon
notes: Boss encounter area; prepare a separate boss trip. Consult the linked strategy for encounter access and hazards.

tower-of-voices-ground-floor.name: Tower of Voices ground floor
notes: Requires Song of the Elves. Contains 4 Prifddinas guards, one at each entrance to the Tower of Voices.

tower-of-voices-upper-floor.name: Tower of Voices upper floor
notes: Requires Song of the Elves. Contains 8 Prifddinas guards on the upper walkways between the towers, but the task page notes great distances between each.

troll-stronghold-outside-trolls.name: Troll Stronghold outside
notes: Contains 8 outside mountain trolls. A dwarf multicannon and Bonecrusher necklace allow effectively zero Prayer potion usage while using Protect from Melee.

trollheim-death-plateau.name: Trollheim / Death Plateau
notes: Around Trollheim and Death Plateau north of Burthorpe (not Wilderness); reached after Death Plateau or via Trollheim Teleport. No troll safespot is documented; use Protect from Missiles near the level 68 thrower trolls.

tzhaar-fight-cave.name: TzHaar Fight Cave
notes: Used when the Slayer master offers TzTok-Jad instead of regular TzHaar. Leaving or dying ends the run, so treat it as a separate boss trip.

underground-pass-dungeon.name: Underground Pass (dungeon)
notes: Requires completion of Plague City to access the Underground Pass. Only two level 53 ogre spawns; cannonable but not safespottable.

ungael-vorkath.name: Ungael
notes: Boss encounter area; prepare a separate boss trip. Consult the linked strategy for encounter access and hazards.

ungael.name: Ungael
notes: Vorkath is fought once during Dragon Slayer II and after the quest on Ungael. Use the dedicated Vorkath strategy for boss mechanics.

uzer-mastaba.name: Uzer Mastaba
notes: Requires The Curse of Arrav (partial completion) for access. The lower level holds 19 Small scarabs; aggressive at any combat level but max hit 1, and they have no drops.

various-boss-locations.name: Various boss locations
notes: Placeholder for the Boss meta-task; each boss has its own arena, access requirements, and safespot behaviour.

various-wilderness-boss-locations.name: Various Wilderness boss locations
notes: Placeholder for Krystilia's Wilderness boss meta-task; every eligible boss lairs in the Wilderness (Callisto/Artio, Vet'ion/Calvar'ion, Venenatis/Spindel, Scorpia, Chaos Fanatic, Crazy Archaeologist, King Black Dragon, Chaos Elemental, Revenant Maledictus), each with its own arena and PK risk.

vetion-hellhound-spawns.name: Wilderness near Vet'ion
notes: Vet'ion and Calvar'ion summon Skeleton Hellhounds and Greater Skeleton Hellhounds that can progress a Hellhound task. This Wilderness boss area is a common player killing hotspot and the spawns have no drops other than the looting bag.

vetions-rest.name: Vet'ion's Rest
requirements: Medium Wilderness Diary completed or Vet'ion boss assignment
notes: Wilderness boss lair. Requires the medium Wilderness Diary or the matching Vet'ion boss Slayer assignment; an ordinary creature assignment does not waive the diary. Entry costs 50,000 coins, repayable after the applicable PvP death. Check the linked strategy for travel and risk.

virer-hunting-ground.name: Virer Hunting Ground
notes: Twelve venators; one cannot be reached with melee. Requires The Blood Moon Rises. Drakan's medallion to Castle Drakan, then use the Vampyrium portal. A 73 Agility shortcut and pickaxe shorten the route; a bank chest can be built in Sangvesti at 70 Construction.

viyeldi-caves.name: Viyeldi caves
notes: Viyeldi caves hold 3 Lesser demons; multicombat, cannonable and safespottable. Requires Legends' Quest area access (lockpick and quest progression).

waterbirth-island-dungeon.name: Waterbirth Island Dungeon
notes: The Waterbirth Island Dungeon holds the level 137 Giant Rock Crab (kill only for drops such as rock-shell armour and medium clue scrolls, as it has very high Defence) as well as ordinary Rock Crabs. Reaching the island uses the Rellekka boat or fairy ring; deeper Dagannoth areas need extra preparation.

waterbirth-island.name: Waterbirth Island
notes: Waterbirth Island Dungeon contains stronger Dagannoth, Dagannoth spawn eggs, and the Dagannoth Kings. Deeper areas require preparation such as a pet rock or Humphrey dumphrey plus a ranged weapon, rune thrownaxe, another player, or the 85 Agility shortcut.

waterfall-dungeon-fire-giants.name: Waterfall Dungeon
notes: Requires completion of Waterfall Quest and a Rope. A safespot exists next to the single door in the western room, and a cannon can AoE Fire giants by placing it in the middle and running to safespots.

web-chasm.name: Web Chasm
requirements: Hard Wilderness Diary completed or Venenatis boss assignment
notes: Wilderness boss lair. Requires the hard Wilderness Diary or the matching Venenatis boss Slayer assignment; an ordinary creature assignment does not waive the diary. Entry costs 50,000 coins, repayable after the applicable PvP death. Check the linked strategy for travel and risk.

west-of-yanille.name: West of Yanille
notes: Open area of level 53 ogres just west of Yanille; the recommended place to kill ogres for the task. Ogres can be safespotted behind the stone wall and a cannon can be used.

western-gryphon-dungeon.name: Western gryphon dungeon
notes: Western Gryphons dungeon on the Great Conch. Contains 18 gryphons, has a southern room that is multicombat and cannonable, and has a west cave safespot that avoids all attacks.

white-wolf-mountain.name: White Wolf Mountain
notes: White Wolf Mountain lies between Taverley and Catherby (gnome glider or the mountain path). It holds a dense pack of wolves, white wolves and big wolves. Multi-combat, cannonable and safespottable per the Slayer task/Wolves location table (pageid 298281).

wilderness-ankou-area.name: Wilderness (Ankou area)
notes: Ankou spawns in the Wilderness (The Forgotten Cemetery around level 30, and the Wilderness Slayer Cave); no Wilderness Ankou safespot is documented and player-killer risk applies, so carry only what you can lose.

wilderness-god-wars-dungeon-spiritual-cr.name: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon
notes: Spiritual creatures in the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon are in level 28-32 Wilderness; do not bring items you are unwilling to lose. The task page marks Spiritual rangers, warriors, and mages here as safespottable and cannon-immune. Bring one Armadyl or Bandos item depending on entrance, one Saradomin item, and one Zamorak item for follower tolerance.

wilderness-god-wars-dungeon-vampyres.name: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon
notes: Requires either 60 Strength or 60 Agility. Most of the dungeon is below level 30 Wilderness; bring an emergency teleport and a Zamorak item if avoiding Feral Vampyre aggression.

wilderness-god-wars-dungeon.name: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon
notes: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon is a multicombat Wilderness area with player killing risk. Aviansie drop noted adamantite bars regardless of Fremennik Diary completion. Bloodveld access is closer through the Trollheim Agility shortcut with 64 Agility; God Wars followers are aggressive without god item protection. Cannon nuance: a cannon can physically be set up but GWD inhabitants may destroy it (Dwarf multicannon pageid 13551); wiki task tables split on the verdict, so trust the per-task row here.

wilderness-resource-area-hellhounds.name: Wilderness near Resource Area
notes: Level 49-55 Wilderness Hellhound area near the Resource Area. Contains 6 Hellhounds, supports a cannon and safespots, but has high Wilderness player killing danger; the Edgeville lever provides bank access.

wilderness-slayer-cave-dust-devils.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: Dust devils are in the north-east Wilderness Slayer Cave area around level 25-28 Wilderness. The multicombat room can be cannoned, burst, barraged, and safespotted, but carries player-killer risk; do not bring items you are unwilling to lose.

wilderness-slayer-cave-hellhounds.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: Level 18-22 Wilderness Hellhound area is multicombat, cannonable, safespottable, and fast with Wilderness weapons. The cave is a popular player killing hotspot; do not risk items you are unwilling to lose.

wilderness-slayer-cave-ice-giants.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave (ice giants)
notes: The higher-level ice giant variant (combat level 67) spawns in the Wilderness Slayer Cave (around levels 18-22). Multicombat, cannonable, and burstable. The cave is a popular player-killing hotspot; stand as far south as practical to stay near one-click teleport range and do not risk items you are unwilling to lose.

wilderness-slayer-cave-jellies.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: Contains 9 Jellies. Multicombat and cannonable; safespottable per the task page. Popular player killing hotspot - keep a one-click teleport such as a royal seed pod ready and do not risk items you are unwilling to lose.

wilderness-slayer-cave-lesser-demons.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: Below level 30 Wilderness; 7 Lesser demons with boosted 110-HP stats and enhanced drops. Multicombat and cannonable, and the wiki marks the lesser demon spots safespottable. Popular player killing hotspot - do not risk items you are unwilling to lose.

wilderness-slayer-cave-nechryael.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: Contains 8 Greater Nechryael in the Wilderness Slayer Cave task-only area. This is a dangerous multicombat area popular with player-killers; do not bring items that you are unwilling to lose.

wilderness-slayer-cave.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: Level 18-22 Wilderness Hellhound area is multicombat, cannonable, safespottable, and fast with Wilderness weapons. The cave is a popular player killing hotspot; stand as far south as practical to stay near one-click teleport range, and do not risk items you are unwilling to lose.
Ring of dueling to Ferox Enclave, then run north into the cave.

witchaven-dungeon.name: Witchaven Dungeon
notes: Hellhounds here have 8 spawns, support a cannon, and have a safespot near the entrance of the Hellhound area. A short puzzle is required to access the Hellhounds area for the first time, and the dungeon is far from convenient banking.

wizards-tower.name: Wizards' Tower
notes: One caged Lesser demon on the top floor of the Wizards' Tower; single-combat, cannonable, and trivially safespotted through the cage with ranged or magic.

wyvern-cave-fossil-island-task-only.name: Task-only Wyvern Cave (Fossil Island)
notes: Task-only Fossil Island Wyvern Cave trapdoor inside the Mushroom Forest. Requires a Fossil Island Wyverns slayer task; Weve stops players attacking here without the task. Contains 4 Spitting, 4 Taloned, 4 Long-tailed, and 3 Ancient Wyverns, with a Fossil Storage box by the entrance.

wyvern-cave-fossil-island.name: Wyvern Cave (Fossil Island)
notes: Regular Fossil Island Wyvern Cave entrance east of Museum Camp. Contains 4 Spitting, 4 Taloned, 4 Long-tailed, and 2 Ancient Wyverns; no multicombat, cannon, or safespot support. A Fossil Storage box is by the entrance.

zamorak-fortress.name: Zamorak's Fortress
requirements: God Wars Dungeon Zamorak killcount or valid entry bypass
notes: Boss encounter area; prepare a separate boss trip. Consult the linked strategy for encounter access and hazards.

zanaris-cosmic-altar-zygomites.name: Zanaris near the Cosmic Altar
notes: Contains 5 level 74 and 86 Zygomites near the Cosmic Altar. Can be safespotted by trapping them on a pillar and standing back near the mysterious ruins.

zanaris-furnace-zygomites.name: Zanaris east of the furnace
notes: Contains 5 level 74 and 86 Zygomites east of the Zanaris furnace. Requires Lost City access, 57 Slayer, and Fungicide spray to finish kills.

zanaris-otherworldly-beings.name: Zanaris (south of the bank, flower pond)
notes: Six Otherworldly beings (level 64) roam south of the bank in Zanaris, by the flower pond. Requires Lost City for access (fairy ring / Lost City route). Can be safespotted across or by corner-trapping on the pond corners, though they wander a lot; five of the six have a wander radius that permits safespotting from right next to the pond.

evidence.title: Zanaris (south of the bank, flower pond)

zombies-area.name: Common zombie spawns
notes: Common zombies spawn across free-to-play areas of Gielinor; these kills count towards a Turael, Spria or Mazchna Zombies task. Multicombat, cannon placement and safespots are not wiki-stated, so conservative defaults are used.

zulrahs-shrine.name: Zulrah's Shrine
notes: Boss encounter area; prepare a separate boss trip. Consult the linked strategy for encounter access and hazards.

abyssal-demons-general.name: General strategy
abyssal-demons-general.summary: Prioritize Catacombs or Wilderness multicombat methods for high Slayer experience, use Protect from Melee, read Teleport anchoring scroll if possible, and extend the task because Abyssal demons are a strong Slayer experience assignment.
guidance: 85 Slayer and 85 combat are required to receive Abyssal demon assignments.
Access requires Priest in Peril or Fairytale II - Cure a Queen for abyss access.
Teleport anchoring scroll is highly recommended before the first task because it prevents Abyssal demons from teleporting the player.
Bigger and Badder enables Greater abyssal demon superior spawns.
Augment my abbies extends assignments to 200-250 Abyssal demons.
Wilderness Slayer Cave kills require accepting Wilderness PK risk.
Abyssal demons use accurate melee stab attacks with a max hit of 8.
Protect from Melee neutralizes normal Abyssal demon and Greater abyssal demon damage.
Abyssal demons frequently teleport around the combat area and can teleport the player up to 20 tiles away unless Teleport anchoring scroll has been read.
If the player does not have the anchoring scroll, Auto Retaliate helps continue attacking after teleport movement.
Greater abyssal demons have a max hit of 27 and always land a hit after teleporting if that hit is not prayed against.
Abyssal demons are demons, so Arclight, Emberlight, Scorching bow, and Demonbane spells apply their relevant demonbane bonuses.
Because Abyssal demons are 1x1 and low magic defence, area-of-effect Ancient Magicks are preferred for high experience in multicombat areas.
Smoke Barrage and Smoke Burst are favored over ice spells because frozen teleported demons will not move back until unfrozen.
Blood spells are much more expensive than Smoke spells and are not recommended for the main task damage loop.
Abyssal Sire can be killed on task as a profitable boss alternative, but it gives significantly lower Slayer experience than regular Abyssal demons.

choosing between Catacombs, Wilderness, Slayer Tower, and Konar-locked single-combat tasks

Use Wilderness Slayer Cave only when comfortable with PK risk; it is the only cannonable Abyssal demon location.
Use Slayer Tower or Abyssal Area mostly for Konar or single-combat requirements.
Keep Protect from Melee active against normal and superior Abyssal demons.
Read Teleport anchoring scroll before starting serious Abyssal demon tasks to remove player teleports.
If anchoring is unavailable, enable Auto Retaliate so the player resumes attacking after being teleported.
Extend tasks with Augment my abbies to get 200-250 kills.
Use Soul bearer for ensouled abyssal heads and Herb sack for frequent herb drops.
Consider Abyssal Sire only when profit is preferred over Slayer experience.
Abyssal whip is a 1/512 drop; Abyssal dagger is much rarer.
Catacombs kills can add Dark totem value, and Greater abyssal demons in the Catacombs always drop a Dark totem piece.

Key item or prerequisite: Teleport anchoring scroll
Key item or prerequisite: Soul bearer
risks: Without Teleport anchoring scroll, player teleports interrupt attacks and can break stacks.
Greater abyssal demons hit hard if Protect from Melee is not active after their teleport.
Wilderness Slayer Cave adds player-killer risk.

amoxliatl-scythe.name: Scythe melee
amoxliatl-scythe.summary: Melee preparation for the repeatable Amoxliatl encounter, exploiting low crush defence and negative flat armour while retaining melee damage for unstable ice.
guidance: The Heart of Darkness is required for repeatable encounters.
Recommended combat levels are 60 Attack/Strength/Defence/Hitpoints;37 Prayer enables Protect from Magic.
Amoxliatl has negative 2 flat armour and low crush defence.
Fire spells have a 30% weakness bonus, but unstable ice can only be damaged with melee.
Protect from Magic covers the initial magical hit but not the typeless ice-spike damage or lingering icy pools.
Leave the targeted tile during ordinary attacks; pools deal 6-10 damage per tick and reduce safe floor space.
Destroy unstable ice with melee before 15 ticks elapse. Surviving blocks create 3 x3 pools and heal Amoxliatl 16-25 each.
Attacks on unstable ice deal a guaranteed maximum hit and have a 1 tick attack delay; food eaten after destroying a block does not impose the usual attack delay.
Icicle Crash disables active prayers before its attack; Protect from Magic negates that attack when reactivated.
The first special is random; later specials alternate after 2-4 ordinary attacks unless the narrow approach prevents Unstable Ice.
Leave the chamber between kills for optional moonlight-moth prayer restoration.
