aquanite-general.name: General strategy
aquanite-general.summary: Use Protect from Magic, sever the Aquanite lure with slash, then kill with high-damage melee, usually stab-focused after the defence reduction; ranged is the alternative.
guidance: 78 Slayer is required to kill Aquanites.
73 Sailing is required to moor at Ynysdail; the first trip needs a boat with an adamant keel or better.
The Lured In Slayer reward unlock is required before Nieve or Duradel can assign Aquanites; Mortimer assigns them without it.

50 Construction plus hammer, saw, 10 swamp paste, and 8 camphor planks are required to construct the Ynysdail rowboat for later travel (the Slayer task page states 70; the Rowboat amenity recipe states 50).
Using the rowboat between Ynysdail and north of Gwenith requires Song of the Elves.
Aquanites attack with Magic and have high accuracy.
Protect from Magic is highly recommended against normal Aquanites.
The cavern is single-way combat.
A Dwarf multicannon cannot be placed because the ground is too damp.
Aquanites can be safespotted with a 9 or 10 tile attack range.
A slash attack severs the Aquanite lure and reduces stab Defence by 50, from 60 to 10.
Damage is not required to sever the lure, but the attack option must be set to slash.
A fast 4-tick slash weapon such as a scimitar or Abyssal whip is recommended for severing; a two-style weapon such as the Ghrazi rapier can swap between slash and stab instead.
Voidwaker special attack does not sever the lure because it is Magic-based, but regular Voidwaker slash attacks can sever it.
Burning claws and Arkan blade burn damage should only be applied after the lure is severed, otherwise the burn is nulled when the lure is cut.

Elder aquanites spawn at 1/200 on task after Bigger and Badder (1/150 with the elite Combat Achievements); their special disables protection prayers and hits up to 50 if Protect from Magic has been active for some time.
baseline Aquanite tasks
Enter Ynysdail Cavern and keep Protect from Magic active against normal Aquanites.
Open by landing any slash attack to sever the Aquanite lure.

araxxor-standard-attacks.name: Standard attacks and defence reduction
araxxor-standard-attacks.summary: Melee positioning lowers incoming standard damage; defence reduction has a limited floor.
guidance: 92 Slayer, completion of Priest in Peril and an active araxyte or spider assignment are required.
The Wiki recommends 85 Attack, Strength and Hitpoints, 70 Defence and Prayer; these recommendations are not entry requirements.
Sins of the Father is an optional Hallowed Sepulchre travel route requirement, not an encounter requirement.
Araxxor favours crush melee; ranged is an alternative with expensive equipment. The listed fire weakness does not make ordinary magic competitive against his magic defence.
Venom protection, spawn handling and the enrage phase are separate preparation requirements; Protect from Melee alone does not prevent special-attack damage.
Araxxor has 135 Defence with +15 crush defence. Defence may be reduced by at most 45 levels; one successful elder maul special reaches this cap, while dragon warhammer reduces 40.
Melee can hit 38, reduced to 5 through protection. Outside melee range the ranged attack can hit 34, reduced to 18, and drains 9% Defence; magic can hit 21 and drains 9% Prayer.
The ranged or magic choice considers the player defence rolls when the attack begins. Plan the main position and prayers before the attack rather than expecting a late equipment swap to change it.

The repeating colour sequences are green-white-red, white-red-green or red-green-white. The southeast colour determines the special attack sequence for that kill.

Destroying a full-health egg skips that spawn; damage to an egg carries into the hatch. More than 58 damage to an egg can make its hatch immediately despawn, advancing the next scheduled hatch after six attacks.

Hatched araxytes take guaranteed maximum hits from Noxious halberd, crush when crush is the highest attack bonus, or heavy ranged when ranged is the highest. Unhatched eggs do not receive this guarantee.

araxxor-white-mirrorback.name: White mirrorbacks and recoil
araxxor-white-mirrorback.summary: Remove mirrorbacks safely before continuing boss damage.
guidance: 92 Slayer, completion of Priest in Peril and an active araxyte or spider assignment are required.
The Wiki recommends 85 Attack, Strength and Hitpoints, 70 Defence and Prayer; these recommendations are not entry requirements.

Araxxor favours crush melee; ranged is an alternative with expensive equipment. The listed fire weakness does not make ordinary magic competitive against his magic defence.

A mirrorback redirects 20% of damage dealt to Araxxor and reflects half of that redirected damage, effectively 10%, to the player.
Direct adjacent melee attacks against mirrorbacks recoil half the hit. Use ranged, magic, or a halberd with a one-tile gap to avoid the direct melee recoil.

Noxious halberd is the preferred switch. Hunters' sunlight crossbow with antler bolts, Karil's crossbow with bolt racks, heavy ballista with javelins, or rune crossbow with broad bolts are source-listed ranged alternatives.
Vengeance is an optional Lunar alternative to exploit recoil, with its own spellbook and rune requirements; the Wiki generally favours Arceuus utility instead.

araxxor-enrage.name: Enrage below 255 Hitpoints
araxxor-enrage.summary: The final quarter changes attack speed and adds an acid cleave.
guidance: 92 Slayer, completion of Priest in Peril and an active araxyte or spider assignment are required.
The Wiki recommends 85 Attack, Strength and Hitpoints, 70 Defence and Prayer; these recommendations are not entry requirements.
Sins of the Father is an optional Hallowed Sepulchre travel route requirement, not an encounter requirement.
Araxxor favours crush melee; ranged is an alternative with expensive equipment. The listed fire weakness does not make ordinary magic competitive against his magic defence.
Venom protection, spawn handling and the enrage phase are separate preparation requirements; Protect from Melee alone does not prevent special-attack damage.
At less than 255 Hitpoints, Araxxor gains 35 Defence, 28 Magic and 31 Ranged while retaining prior defence reductions; the attack cycle accelerates from six to four ticks.
The cleave covers a 1-by-3 strip two tiles long and leaves acid. Protection reduces its damage by roughly two thirds; remaining outside melee distance can trigger an alternate attack.
A two-tile sideways move or a one-tile retreat followed by a delayed move can avoid the strip. Stepping under Araxxor can bait 8-12 self-damage when performed correctly.
Five-tick weapons need a different cadence: three attacks over four cleaves, omitting a step-under when necessary to avoid losing an attack.

Aranea boots can negate a cleave once per twenty ticks but do not negate acid. Leaving green araxytes alive and using ranged protection is an advanced alternative only when cleaves are consistently avoided.

basilisks-general.name: General strategy
basilisks-general.summary: Always wear a mirror shield or V's shield, then choose ordinary basilisks for simple task progress or Basilisk Knights for jaw profit after The Fremennik Exiles.
guidance: 40 Slayer
40 combat
20 Defence
Mirror shield or V's shield for all Basilisk variants
Basilocked unlock for Konar, Nieve, and Duradel assignments
The Fremennik Exiles for Basilisk Knight access
Bigger and Badder for Monstrous basilisk and Basilisk Sentinel superior spawns
Without a mirror shield or V's shield, basilisk gaze deals immense damage and massively drains player stats.
Ordinary basilisks use an extremely inaccurate melee attack with a max hit of 5.
Basilisk Knights use melee and magic, both with a max hit of 20.
Basilisk Knights match the player's attack speed with a maximum frequency of four ticks.
At distance, Basilisk Knights use magic while attempting to move into melee range.
Protection prayers can block either Basilisk Knight melee or magic attacks, but not both at once.
Basilisk Sentinel can launch a slow projectile that stones the player if not dodged.
Cannons cannot be placed anywhere with any kind of basilisk.

branda-the-fire-queen-solo-wave-sustain.name: Solo melee, ranged and Wave sustain
branda-the-fire-queen-solo-wave-sustain.summary: A supply-focused setup uses a complete magic switch and a shortbow ranged switch to clear minions reliably.
guidance: There are no quest or skill requirements to enter the Royal Titans arena.
The Wiki recommends about 70 combat skills, 43 Prayer and 75 Magic. Wave-spell presets explicitly require 75 Magic and the standard spellbook for reliable 40-damage elemental hits.
Branda counts as a fire giant and Eldric as an ice giant. Slayer assignment bonuses apply only to the matching Titan; neither boss requires a task.
The two Titans each have 600 Hitpoints and 100 Defence. Their slight crush weakness does not justify replacing a stronger weapon with a weaker crush weapon.
Ranged accuracy is multiplied by six when Titans are outside melee reach and during elemental blast, including its charge and a few ticks afterwards; prioritise melee while it is available.
The preset uses melee as its primary style and lists required ranged and magic switches explicitly. Static phase guidance does not produce live tile or prayer prompts.
Start with melee while the Titans are adjacent, then switch weapon, ammunition, body, legs and cape for the ranged portion.

Use the full listed magic switch for opposing-element Wave spells on elementals. Twinflame automatically changes fire/water and provides those elemental runes; the supplied air and blood runes cover 500 total Wave casts.
Water spells clear Branda's fire walls and fire elementals; fire spells clear Eldric's ice walls and ice elementals. Return to melee when the boss is reachable.
Before taking a Titan below 210 Hitpoints, manage both health bars so the other is also low. Follow the phase-two blast reference.
The seven magic switch pieces total +93 magic attack before the remaining head, boots, ammunition and ring. The fixed head and Aranea boots keep this above the required +70 threshold.
This authored budget switch uses the Wiki's suggested magic-accuracy approach; individual item bonuses were checked against their current raw infoboxes.
Preparation prayer reference: Protect from Melee during stomps; appropriate offensive prayers for the chosen style

branda-the-fire-queen-duo-resetting.name: High-level duo with restoration between kills
branda-the-fire-queen-duo-resetting.summary: A high-end duo can omit elemental clearing and restore health, Prayer and special attack between kills.
requirements: Royal Titans restoration route prepared: ornate rejuvenation pool or elite Desert diary statuette
guidance: There are no quest or skill requirements to enter the Royal Titans arena.
The Wiki recommends about 70 combat skills, 43 Prayer and 75 Magic. Wave-spell presets explicitly require 75 Magic and the standard spellbook for reliable 40-damage elemental hits.
Branda counts as a fire giant and Eldric as an ice giant. Slayer assignment bonuses apply only to the matching Titan; neither boss requires a task.
The two Titans each have 600 Hitpoints and 100 Defence. Their slight crush weakness does not justify replacing a stronger weapon with a weaker crush weapon.
Ranged accuracy is multiplied by six when Titans are outside melee reach and during elemental blast, including its charge and a few ticks afterwards; prioritise melee while it is available.
The preset uses melee as its primary style and lists required ranged and magic switches explicitly. Static phase guidance does not produce live tile or prayer prompts.
Use high-end melee with a full ranged switch for distant phases. Both players need sufficient damage to keep time exposed to elementals short.
This route deliberately accepts elemental and wall damage and restores between kills using an ornate rejuvenation pool or the elite Desert diary statuette.
Use Giantsoul amulet to return quickly. Standard-spell clearing remains the alternative when damage output is insufficient.
Arceuus thralls and dragon claws are optional speed extensions with their own spellbook, quest, rune and equipment requirements. They are not silently assumed by this baseline.
risks: Omitting elemental-clearing magic is appropriate only for short high-damage duo kills; longer fights accumulate avoidable damage.

branda-the-fire-queen-walls-and-elementa.name: Walls, opposing elements and accuracy
branda-the-fire-queen-walls-and-elementa.summary: Barriers and minions have distinct accuracy and spell rules.
guidance: There are no quest or skill requirements to enter the Royal Titans arena.
The Wiki recommends about 70 combat skills, 43 Prayer and 75 Magic. Wave-spell presets explicitly require 75 Magic and the standard spellbook for reliable 40-damage elemental hits.
Branda counts as a fire giant and Eldric as an ice giant. Slayer assignment bonuses apply only to the matching Titan; neither boss requires a task.

The preset uses melee as its primary style and lists required ranged and magic switches explicitly. Static phase guidance does not produce live tile or prayer prompts.
Walls form after four ticks. Standing on a forming tile takes up to 12 damage and prevents that obstacle from appearing.

Water Blast or stronger and ice spells extinguish fire; Fire Blast or stronger melts ice. A successful targeted removal also clears the two adjacent obstacles and does not incur an attack delay, regardless of magic attack bonus.
Each Titan summons three elementals. They melee and eventually explode for 8-10 damage in a 3-by-3 area. Opposing fire/water spells deal area damage and receive their doubled elemental weakness.
At +70 magic attack, or +39 with full void mage, elemental hits are guaranteed maximum damage. Each elemental killed reduces the current attack delay by one tick.
Luring an elemental onto an emerging wall of the opposing element can kill it, but random wall placement makes this unreliable as the main plan.

branda-the-fire-queen-phase-one.name: Phase one: melee and ranged windows
branda-the-fire-queen-phase-one.summary: The opening and each retreat offer different weapon windows.
guidance: There are no quest or skill requirements to enter the Royal Titans arena.

The opening allows one or two melee hits before the Titans move away. A four-tick weapon can hit each Titan once; a halberd can obtain two hits on one.
Use ranged during their retreat; after roughly twenty seconds they return to melee and use stomps covering the nearest three rows for up to 26.
Elementals begin after one Titan has taken 100 damage. Deal with the accumulating waves when using the standard-spell plan.
Solo players can stagger the return to melee by staying far from a Titan so it walks farther. This can leave one Titan reachable while the other retreats.
Taking either Titan to 210 Hitpoints or below transitions both into phase two; aim to lower both before triggering it.

branda-the-fire-queen-phase-two.name: Phase two: elemental blasts
branda-the-fire-queen-phase-two.summary: The final phase expands stomp coverage and limits safe blast positioning.
guidance: There are no quest or skill requirements to enter the Royal Titans arena.

Both Titans enter the platform at the transition and can knock players for 15-30 damage. Stomps cover the full arena during this phase.
An elemental blast strikes the arena three times with one safe tile. Stomps are generally synchronised until one Titan falls below 100 Hitpoints.
Leaving one Titan healthy makes the finish harder: its stomp can hit 10 through prayer and the blast safe tile is on the farthest row.
Between blast strikes there is one safe tick for a melee hit only when the safe tile is two tiles from that Titan; a halberd can reach from three. Otherwise use ranged.
Subduing a Titan during the blast charge removes that Titan's covered area for that cast. This is a static timing reference rather than a live prompt.

Budget and mid-game sustain use melee, ranged and accurate magic gear, prayer restoration, combat boosts, Wave runes and an emergency teleport.
Twinflame supplies infinite fire and water runes, leaving air and blood for Wave spells; other staves require the missing elemental runes.
Late-game standard-spell setups can carry Noxious halberd for the central blast reach option. Full ranged and magic switches leave fewer food slots.

The resetting duo route uses Giantsoul and a return teleport to an ornate pool or the elite Desert diary statuette. Thralls are an optional Arceuus extension, not compatible with a simultaneously selected standard spellbook.

cave-horrors-general.name: General strategy
cave-horrors-general.summary: Choose ranged safespots or cannon support for low-damage kills, prayer melee for simple melee kills, or witchwood melee when conserving prayer potions.
guidance: 58 Slayer
85 combat to receive the assignment
Cabin Fever to access Mos Le'Harmless Cave
Witchwood icon for melee-distance kills when not using Protect from Melee
Light source unless the Fire of eternal light is lit
Horrorific unlock for 200-250 extended assignments
Bigger and Badder for Cave abomination superior spawns
Cave horrors use magic-based melee. Protect from Melee negates their normal damage, while high magic defence helps when not praying.
If the player is not wearing a witchwood icon at melee distance, Cave horrors use a special attack that always deals 10% of the player's base Hitpoints level, rounded down.
Protect from Melee completely mitigates the special attack, and safespots prevent Cave horrors from reaching the player.
Cave horrors have low Hitpoints and are spread apart, so fast ranged weapons are generally preferred.
The cave is single-combat, cannonable, and safespottable.
A cannon safespot near 3785,9460 can make cannon-targeted Cave horrors get stuck on the wall.
Cave horrors have a 30% elemental weakness to fire spells.
Common drops make Herb sack, Seed box, Log basket or Plank sack, Reagent pouch, Bonecrusher, and Soul bearer useful trip-extenders.

Use prayer melee with a better amulet when prioritising simple melee kills.
Use high magic-defence armour and witchwood icon if fighting without Protect from Melee.

Cave horrors are often farmed for black mask drops.
Killing a Cave horror is part of the hard Morytania Diary.

Preparation prayer reference: Eagle Eye or better when ranged safespotting if prayer potions are available

Key item or prerequisite: Bones to Peaches runes or tablets

crabs-task-methods-melee.name: Ordinary melee task
crabs-task-methods-melee.summary: Crabs need only Slayer level 1, so any master (Mazchna, Vannaka, or Chaeldar) can assign them. For fast, no-requirement kills, use Sand Crabs (Crabclaw Isle, the Hosidius coast, or the Isle of Souls) or Rock Crabs north of Rellekka; Ammonite Crabs on Fossil Island (after Bone Voyage) give the most XP of the low-level crabs. Crabs appear as 'rocks' and emerge when you stand next to them, so reset their aggression by stepping a few tiles away and returning whenever they stop attacking. Kill the low-defence crabs with any melee weapon (a crush weapon or high-crush-defence armour helps if you take damage). Use Ranged on Swamp Crabs (negative ranged defence), fire spells on Frost Crabs (100% fire weakness), and only fight King Sand Crabs or Giant Rock Crabs if you want their specific drops, as they have much higher Defence and Hitpoints.
guidance: Crabs require only Slayer level 1 with no combat or quest requirement to be assigned by Mazchna, Vannaka, or Chaeldar.

Assignment data verified 2026-07-03 against the raw wikitext of Slayer task/Crabs (pageid 574430): Mazchna 30-50, Vannaka 40-90, Chaeldar 70-130, each weighting 8; no extended amounts (task extensions are N/A for all three masters).
slayerTargetId 154 is the 'id' field from the Slayer task/Crabs infobox.

Counting variants: Rock Crab, Sand Crab, Ammonite Crab, Frost Crab, Swamp Crab, King Sand Crab, Giant Rock Crab, and the Mogre Camp Crab. The Gemstone Crab and hermit crabs do NOT count toward the task.

All crabs use the Crush attack style and are low-damage; most need no special gear. Crabs appear as inactive 'rocks' and emerge when a player stands adjacent, becoming aggressive until the 10-minute tolerance timer expires, after which aggression is reset by leaving and returning.

Most crabs have a small earth-spell elemental weakness and negligible melee defence, so melee is the standard kill. Exceptions: Swamp Crabs resist melee/magic but have -55 ranged defence (use Ranged); Frost Crabs have a 100% fire-spell weakness; Giant Rock Crabs have very high melee/ranged defence and are best hit with earth spells.

King Sand Crabs and Giant Rock Crabs have much higher combat stats and are only advisable to kill on task when seeking their specific drops (e.g. rock-shell armour, Ancient shards, Dark totem pieces, medium clue scrolls).
No task extension unlock or related Slayer shop unlock exists for Crabs.
defaultVariantId is sand-crab: Sand Crabs are the most popular crab for the task, have no quest requirement, plentiful spawns across many locations, and negligible defence.

Assignment data verified 2026-07-03 against the raw wikitext of Slayer task/Crabs (pageid 574430): Mazchna 30-50, Vannaka 40-90, Chaeldar 70-130, each weighting 8; no extended amounts (task extensions are N/A for all three masters).
slayerTargetId 154 is the 'id' field from the Slayer task/Crabs infobox.

Counting variants: Rock Crab, Sand Crab, Ammonite Crab, Frost Crab, Swamp Crab, King Sand Crab, Giant Rock Crab, and the Mogre Camp Crab. The Gemstone Crab and hermit crabs do NOT count toward the task.

All crabs use the Crush attack style and are low-damage; most need no special gear. Crabs appear as inactive 'rocks' and emerge when a player stands adjacent, becoming aggressive until the 10-minute tolerance timer expires, after which aggression is reset by leaving and returning.

Most crabs have a small earth-spell elemental weakness and negligible melee defence, so melee is the standard kill. Exceptions: Swamp Crabs resist melee/magic but have -55 ranged defence (use Ranged); Frost Crabs have a 100% fire-spell weakness; Giant Rock Crabs have very high melee/ranged defence and are best hit with earth spells.

King Sand Crabs and Giant Rock Crabs have much higher combat stats and are only advisable to kill on task when seeking their specific drops (e.g. rock-shell armour, Ancient shards, Dark totem pieces, medium clue scrolls).
No task extension unlock or related Slayer shop unlock exists for Crabs.

The most popular modern crab for training and Slayer tasks; reset aggression by stepping away and returning.

crocodiles-task-methods-melee.name: Ordinary melee task
crocodiles-task-methods-melee.summary: Accept the task from Vannaka (combat level 50) and travel to the River Elid south of Pollnivneach. Earth spells hit nearly every cast thanks to the 40% earth weakness, and crocodiles can also be killed quickly with melee since their defence in every melee style is low. Because many crocodiles are water-bound, ranging or maging them from one tile back from the shore is safe and efficient; safespots west of Nardah and east of the Ruins of Unkah remove almost all incoming damage. Bring waterskins (and optionally desert clothing) for the heat, and recharge Prayer at the Nardah or Sophanem altars.

custodian-stalker-ranged-multicombat.name: Ranged multicombat
custodian-stalker-ranged-multicombat.summary: Use the Stalker Den's south-west multicombat cannonable area with Ranged gear, a Dwarf multicannon, and ricochet or area damage.
guidance: 54 Slayer and completion of Shadows of Custodia are required to be assigned Custodian stalkers.
67 Slayer is required to kill Mature custodian stalkers.
76 Slayer is required to kill Elder custodian stalkers; only elders can spawn Ancient Custodian superiors.
Bigger and Badder enables Ancient Custodian superior spawns.
Un-restraining Order extends assignments to 200-250.
Custodian stalkers are aggressive and primarily attack with melee.
At 20% hitpoints, custodian stalkers stomp and douse the player in spores; the special can cause a bleed effect for 9 damage over 15 ticks.
Protect from Melee prevents most damage; Protect from Magic can block the special, but switching prayers while fighting multiple stalkers may be unwise.
High magic defence such as dragonhide armour reduces the chance of taking damage from the special attack.

dagannoth-kings-solo-solo-three-kings.name: Solo rotation with twisted bow

guidance: Usable melee, ranged and magic weapons
Prepare either the 85 Agility shortcut or pet rock and rune thrownaxe route.
Prime attacks with powerful magic and is weak to ranged.
Supreme attacks with ranged and is weak to melee.
Rex attacks with melee and is vulnerable to magic and edge safespots.
Spinolyps can poison and drain Prayer.
Enter with protection against Prime's magic and establish a rotation without engaging all three kings together.
Supreme is the melee target; Prime is the ranged target; Rex is the magic target.
Choose the initial king based on which other kings are aggressive, then work through the rotation during respawn downtime.
Rex can be trapped at the island edge; high ranged defence and antipoison reduce Spinolyp pressure.
Carry the full set if using Guthan's to heal on Spinolyps between spawns.

dagannoth-lighthouse-cannon-afk.name: Lighthouse cannon AFK
dagannoth-lighthouse-cannon-afk.summary: Use melee with a dwarf cannon in the Lighthouse basement for fast, low-effort Slayer experience.
guidance: 75 combat to receive the task
Horror from the Deep to be assigned and access the Lighthouse basement
The Fremennik Exiles for Jormungand's Prison
Waterbirth Island preparation for Waterbirth tasks or Dagannoth Kings
Optional Expert Reanimation access through the Arceuus spellbook and ensouled dagannoth heads
Standard Dagannoth are weak for their combat level and have a 35% elemental weakness to earth spells.
The Lighthouse basement, Jormungand's Prison, and Waterbirth Island Dungeon are multicombat and allow cannon use.
Catacombs of Kourend Dagannoth cannot be cannoned, but can be killed with prayer AFK or difficult safespots.
Dagannoth at Jormungand's Prison and the Catacombs only use melee attacks.
Waterbirth Island Dagannoth are stronger than other task variants and include level 88 ranged and level 90 melee forms.
Dagannoth spawn can hatch from eggs while nearby Dagannoth remain aggressive.
Dagannoth Kings count on a normal Dagannoth assignment and are often killed for profit with Slayer helmet bonuses.
Ensouled dagannoth heads can be used for Expert Reanimation, trading Slayer speed for Prayer experience.
Fast task completions
Players wanting AFK time without relying heavily on prayer
Enter the Lighthouse basement after Horror from the Deep.
Set up the dwarf cannon in the multicombat Dagannoth area.
Fight with melee and let the cannon accelerate kills.
Use protection prayers, Bones to Peaches, Guthan's, or Saradomin godsword special attacks to extend trips.
If needed, sell noted food to Jossik and buy it back unnoted for a small cost.
The task page calls this one of the fastest Slayer experience options for Dagannoth.
Key item or prerequisite: dwarf cannon
Key item or prerequisite: melee gear
Key item or prerequisite: food or sustain gear
risks: The Lighthouse is often busy with other cannon users.
Some Lighthouse level 74 Dagannoth attack with Ranged.

guidance: Monkey Madness II
At least two usable combat styles.
Gorillas use melee, ranged and magic attacks, each capable of hitting 30.
Their boulder attack deals one third of current health if it lands; it does not count as one of the three missed attacks.
After three attacks dealing no damage, with the third protected correctly, the gorilla changes attack style.
Its protection prayer changes after at least four damaging hits and a combined 70 damage; the previous attack style then becomes immune.

Reduce the number of armour switches because protection changes occur frequently.

drakes-mechanics-and-dragonfire.name: Mechanics and dragonfire
drakes-mechanics-and-dragonfire.summary: Block normal ranged attacks with Protect from Missiles and handle volcanic breath by protection or movement.
guidance: 84 Slayer to damage Drakes or receive the task
90 combat to receive the task
Access to Mount Karuulm
Boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete
Recommended high combat stats: 80+ melee stats, 75+ Ranged, or 85+ Magic depending on style
Recommended prayers: Piety for melee, Deadeye/Rigour for ranged, Mystic Vigour/Augury for magic
Bigger and Badder unlock for Guardian Drake superior spawns
Drakes use ranged, ranged melee, and volcanic breath dragonfire.
Protect from Missiles fully blocks normal ranged attacks.
Drakes do not require dragonfire protection to be killed, but dragonfire protection reduces or negates volcanic breath.
After seven auto-attacks, Drakes launch volcanic breath at the player's current tile.
Volcanic breath deals four quick hits for 6-8 damage each if the player is struck without protection.
Move one tile away when the projectile is launched to completely avoid volcanic breath.
Dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or anti-dragon shield plus antifire negates volcanic breath damage.
Super antifire or extended super antifire also negates volcanic breath and allows defender or blowpipe setups.
Protect from Missiles plus dragonfire protection can make distant kills no-damage.
Drakes are draconic and weak to dragonbane weapons.
Drakes take 50% more damage from water spells.
Guardian Drake has the same volcanic breath when out of melee distance and a melee-distance stun special that hits through prayer.
All combat styles
Low-damage and low-supply trips
Keep Protect from Missiles active to fully block normal ranged attacks.
Count or watch for volcanic breath after seven auto-attacks.
When volcanic breath is launched, move one tile away from the targeted tile to completely avoid it.
Use one layer of dragonfire protection to reduce the special attack.
Use shield or ward protection plus antifire, or super antifire, to negate volcanic breath damage.
Attack from at least one tile away with Protect from Missiles and dragonfire protection for no-damage kills.
Preparation prayer reference: Protect from Missiles
Key item or prerequisite: Protect from Missiles
risks: Two-handed weapons, defenders, and blowpipe setups require either movement or super antifire to avoid all volcanic breath damage.
Without protection or movement, volcanic breath hits four times.

Players with Bigger and Badder enabled

Volcanic breath deals four quick hits for 6-8 damage each if the player is struck without protection.
Move one tile away when the projectile is launched to completely avoid volcanic breath.
Dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or anti-dragon shield plus antifire negates volcanic breath damage.
Super antifire or extended super antifire also negates volcanic breath and allows defender or blowpipe setups.
Protect from Missiles plus dragonfire protection can make distant kills no-damage.
Drakes are draconic and weak to dragonbane weapons.
Drakes take 50% more damage from water spells.
Guardian Drake has the same volcanic breath when out of melee distance and a melee-distance stun special that hits through prayer.

flight-kilisa-solo-defensive-ranged.name: Solo defensive ranged encounter
flight-kilisa-solo-defensive-ranged.summary: A defensive crossbow setup handles the complete Armadyl encounter and its melee bodyguard.
guidance: The Armadyl encampment requires 70 Ranged, a crossbow and mith grapple, and the applicable killcount or a valid entry bypass.
Death Plateau and Troll Stronghold progress through Dad are one approach; Ghommal's hilt provides an alternative Trollheim route.
An aviansie task is optional; Kree'arra and all three bodyguards count towards it.
Kree'arra and the bodyguards form one encounter. Ranged protection is central while Kree'arra is alive because his ranged hit reaches 69.
Kree'arra's magic attack rolls against ranged defence. His ranged and magic attacks damage all players, so teams have no single designated tank.
Flight Kilisa uses melee up to 15, Wingman Skree magic up to 16, and Flockleader Geerin ranged up to 25.
Keep Kree'arra targeted between attacks and retain ranged protection while he is alive. Untargeted Kree'arra can approach for melee.
Use a corner to prevent knockback, and step under the boss between attacks where the chosen weapon cadence permits.
After Kree'arra dies, kill Wingman Skree with the main ranged weapon or an optional blowpipe, then finish or heal from Kilisa and Geerin.
The Wiki calls this equipment grid Ranged Tank; it describes defensive equipment, not a designated tank role in a group.
Preparation prayer reference: Protect from Missiles while Kree'arra is alive

flight-kilisa-solo-chinchompas.name: Solo chinchompa overlap encounter
flight-kilisa-solo-chinchompas.summary: Chinchompas target the low-defence bodyguard and deal area damage to overlapping Kree'arra.
guidance: The Armadyl encampment requires 70 Ranged, a crossbow and mith grapple, and the applicable killcount or a valid entry bypass.

Flight Kilisa uses melee up to 15, Wingman Skree magic up to 16, and Flockleader Geerin ranged up to 25.
Start in the southwest corner and align Kilisa with Kree'arra's southwest anchor tile.
Throw red or black chinchompas at Kilisa while maintaining Kree'arra as the off-tick target between throws to prevent his melee approach.
Kilisa commonly dies first. Switch to the carried rune crossbow and diamond bolts until the targets overlap again.
When Kree'arra respawns, Geerin can become the alternate overlap target; this is less forgiving and may reduce subsequent blood-spell healing.

flight-kilisa-bodyguard-role.name: Flight Kilisa: melee pressure and overlap target
flight-kilisa-bodyguard-role.summary: Kilisa is the main bodyguard threat to ranged and magic setups.
guidance: The Armadyl encampment requires 70 Ranged, a crossbow and mith grapple, and the applicable killcount or a valid entry bypass.
Death Plateau and Troll Stronghold progress through Dad are one approach; Ghommal's hilt provides an alternative Trollheim route.
An aviansie task is optional; Kree'arra and all three bodyguards count towards it.
Kree'arra and the bodyguards form one encounter. Ranged protection is central while Kree'arra is alive because his ranged hit reaches 69.
Kree'arra's magic attack rolls against ranged defence. His ranged and magic attacks damage all players, so teams have no single designated tank.
Flight Kilisa uses melee up to 15, Wingman Skree magic up to 16, and Flockleader Geerin ranged up to 25.
Her melee attack reaches 15 and is not blocked by ranged protection. Keep that protection for Kree'arra rather than treating Kilisa as an isolated monster.
In solo chinchompa kills, align her with Kree'arra so the low-defence target supplies area damage to the boss.
In teams she changes targets, so spreading out can reduce time she spends attacking. Freezing is an optional Ancient Magicks technique with its own casting requirements.
After the boss dies, stacking Kilisa with Geerin allows blood-spell healing; killing her too early removes that healing target.

flight-kilisa-entry-and-killcount.name: Armadyl entry and assignment cost
flight-kilisa-entry-and-killcount.summary: Plan both the dungeon approach and the Armadyl entry check.

Flight Kilisa uses melee up to 15, Wingman Skree magic up to 16, and Flockleader Geerin ranged up to 25.
Use Death Plateau and Troll Stronghold progress through Dad, or the Ghommal's hilt route to Trollheim.

flight-kilisa-boss-targeting-and-protect.name: Encounter targeting and protection
flight-kilisa-boss-targeting-and-protect.summary: Kree'arra governs the safe setup while any bodyguard is alive.
guidance: The Armadyl encampment requires 70 Ranged, a crossbow and mith grapple, and the applicable killcount or a valid entry bypass.
Death Plateau and Troll Stronghold progress through Dad are one approach; Ghommal's hilt provides an alternative Trollheim route.

Kree'arra and the bodyguards form one encounter. Ranged protection is central while Kree'arra is alive because his ranged hit reaches 69.
Kree'arra's magic attack rolls against ranged defence. His ranged and magic attacks damage all players, so teams have no single designated tank.
Flight Kilisa uses melee up to 15, Wingman Skree magic up to 16, and Flockleader Geerin ranged up to 25.
Kree'arra ranged attacks hit up to 69 and magic up to 21; the magic accuracy roll checks ranged defence.
Both attacks affect all players and can knock them back unless positioned in a corner. A group therefore has no designated tank.
When not targeted, Kree'arra approaches for a melee attack up to 26. Off-tick retargeting is essential for the chinchompa method.
Team players normally bring their strongest ranged weapon; additional player damage makes chinchompas unnecessary.

flight-kilisa-ancient-healing-and-freezi.name: Ancient Magicks sustain and freezing
flight-kilisa-ancient-healing-and-freezi.summary: Blood and ice spells are optional extensions with explicit spell preparation.
guidance: The Armadyl encampment requires 70 Ranged, a crossbow and mith grapple, and the applicable killcount or a valid entry bypass.
Death Plateau and Troll Stronghold progress through Dad are one approach; Ghommal's hilt provides an alternative Trollheim route.
An aviansie task is optional; Kree'arra and all three bodyguards count towards it.
Kree'arra and the bodyguards form one encounter. Ranged protection is central while Kree'arra is alive because his ranged hit reaches 69.
Kree'arra's magic attack rolls against ranged defence. His ranged and magic attacks damage all players, so teams have no single designated tank.
Flight Kilisa uses melee up to 15, Wingman Skree magic up to 16, and Flockleader Geerin ranged up to 25.
After the boss dies, Blood Barrage can heal from stacked Kilisa and Geerin. Blood Blitz is the single-target alternative when Kilisa is dead or nearly dead.

Blood Barrage needs 92 Magic and 4 blood, 4 death and 1 soul rune per cast. Blood Blitz needs 80 Magic and 4 blood plus 2 death runes per cast. Both require Desert Treasure I and Ancient Magicks selected.
Ice Barrage requires 94 Magic with 6 water, 4 death and 2 blood runes per cast and can freeze Kilisa while stacking her with Geerin.

Carry an Ancient-autocasting staff such as a blood ancient sceptre, Kodai wand or eldritch Nightmare staff, plus suitable magic gear. Eldritch specials can restore Prayer; Lightbearer shortens the special-energy recovery wait.
The horn setup can instead use Arceuus Death Charge for special energy; that is a different spellbook preparation and cannot be assumed alongside Ancient Magicks.
risks: A ranged or melee preset does not silently include the level, runes or spellbook for these optional extensions.

flight-kilisa-supplies-and-banking.name: Supplies, drops and trip length
flight-kilisa-supplies-and-banking.summary: Use food drops and bones to extend a prepared trip.
guidance: The Armadyl encampment requires 70 Ranged, a crossbow and mith grapple, and the applicable killcount or a valid entry bypass.
Death Plateau and Troll Stronghold progress through Dad are one approach; Ghommal's hilt provides an alternative Trollheim route.
An aviansie task is optional; Kree'arra and all three bodyguards count towards it.
Kree'arra and the bodyguards form one encounter. Ranged protection is central while Kree'arra is alive because his ranged hit reaches 69.
Kree'arra's magic attack rolls against ranged defence. His ranged and magic attacks damage all players, so teams have no single designated tank.
Flight Kilisa uses melee up to 15, Wingman Skree magic up to 16, and Flockleader Geerin ranged up to 25.
The boss and three bodyguards each drop bones. Four Bones to Peaches conversions yield 32 healing; a tablet is the portable option without relying on the spell unlock.
Bodyguards may drop two manta rays for 44 healing or three mushroom potatoes for 60; floor juggling can preserve them when inventory is full.
Shadow trips commonly use three to five brews and five to seven restores; ranged tank trips use twelve to sixteen brews and six to eight restores. Adjust the plan for optional Ancient healing.
Bow and chinchompa trips reserve space for a direct weapon, crossbow/grapple, optional Ancient gear, ammunition, boosts and teleport. Re-check loaded darts, scales, staff charges and crystal charges.
Soulflame teams may switch to Lightbearer after a kill and use restoration or healing supplies while special energy returns.

flockleader-geerin-solo-shadow.name: Solo Tumeken's shadow encounter
flockleader-geerin-solo-shadow.summary: Shadow with near-max magic armour is the Wiki's strongest conventional direct method; downgrades materially reduce its benefit.
guidance: The Armadyl encampment requires 70 Ranged, a crossbow and mith grapple, and the applicable killcount or a valid entry bypass.
Death Plateau and Troll Stronghold progress through Dad are one approach; Ghommal's hilt provides an alternative Trollheim route.
An aviansie task is optional; Kree'arra and all three bodyguards count towards it.
Kree'arra and the bodyguards form one encounter. Ranged protection is central while Kree'arra is alive because his ranged hit reaches 69.
Kree'arra's magic attack rolls against ranged defence. His ranged and magic attacks damage all players, so teams have no single designated tank.
Flight Kilisa uses melee up to 15, Wingman Skree magic up to 16, and Flockleader Geerin ranged up to 25.
Keep Kree'arra targeted between attacks and retain ranged protection while he is alive. Untargeted Kree'arra can approach for melee.
Use a corner to prevent knockback, and step under the boss between attacks where the chosen weapon cadence permits.
After Kree'arra dies, kill Wingman Skree with the main ranged weapon or an optional blowpipe, then finish or heal from Kilisa and Geerin.
Optional freezing of Kilisa and blood-spell healing require Ancient Magicks, the relevant level and runes; they are separated into their own preparation reference.
Preparation prayer reference: Protect from Missiles while Kree'arra is alive
risks: Magic armour has less ranged defence, increasing damage from Kree'arra's magic attack and Kilisa.
Confirm the powered staff has sufficient internal charges; ordinary magic weapons do not provide an equivalent direct method.

Start in the southwest corner and align Kilisa with Kree'arra's southwest anchor tile.
Throw red or black chinchompas at Kilisa while maintaining Kree'arra as the off-tick target between throws to prevent his melee approach.

flockleader-geerin-ancient-healing-and-f.name: Ancient Magicks sustain and freezing
flockleader-geerin-ancient-healing-and-f.summary: Blood and ice spells are optional extensions with explicit spell preparation.
guidance: The Armadyl encampment requires 70 Ranged, a crossbow and mith grapple, and the applicable killcount or a valid entry bypass.
Death Plateau and Troll Stronghold progress through Dad are one approach; Ghommal's hilt provides an alternative Trollheim route.
An aviansie task is optional; Kree'arra and all three bodyguards count towards it.
Kree'arra and the bodyguards form one encounter. Ranged protection is central while Kree'arra is alive because his ranged hit reaches 69.
Kree'arra's magic attack rolls against ranged defence. His ranged and magic attacks damage all players, so teams have no single designated tank.
Flight Kilisa uses melee up to 15, Wingman Skree magic up to 16, and Flockleader Geerin ranged up to 25.
After the boss dies, Blood Barrage can heal from stacked Kilisa and Geerin. Blood Blitz is the single-target alternative when Kilisa is dead or nearly dead.

Blood Barrage needs 92 Magic and 4 blood, 4 death and 1 soul rune per cast. Blood Blitz needs 80 Magic and 4 blood plus 2 death runes per cast. Both require Desert Treasure I and Ancient Magicks selected.
Ice Barrage requires 94 Magic with 6 water, 4 death and 2 blood runes per cast and can freeze Kilisa while stacking her with Geerin.

Carry an Ancient-autocasting staff such as a blood ancient sceptre, Kodai wand or eldritch Nightmare staff, plus suitable magic gear. Eldritch specials can restore Prayer; Lightbearer shortens the special-energy recovery wait.
The horn setup can instead use Arceuus Death Charge for special energy; that is a different spellbook preparation and cannot be assumed alongside Ancient Magicks.
risks: A ranged or melee preset does not silently include the level, runes or spellbook for these optional extensions.

Bodyguards may drop two manta rays for 44 healing or three mushroom potatoes for 60; floor juggling can preserve them when inventory is full.

fossil-island-wyverns-travel-and-locatio.name: Travel and locations
fossil-island-wyverns-travel-and-locatio.summary: Choose between the regular cave near Museum Camp and the task-only cave in Mushroom Forest.
guidance: 66 Slayer to kill Spitting, Taloned, and Long-tailed Wyverns
82 Slayer to kill Ancient Wyverns
60 combat to receive the assignment
Bone Voyage completion
Elemental Workshop I completion for the basic shield requirement
Elemental, mind, dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or ancient wyvern shield equipped for icy breath reduction
Fossil Island Wyverns Slayer task for the task-only cave
Fossil Island wyverns are draconic and dragonbane weapons are effective.
All variants use icy breath, which can hit extremely hard without the right shield.
Elemental shield, mind shield, dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, and ancient wyvern shield reduce icy breath damage.
Only the ancient wyvern shield prevents the freezing effect from icy breath.
Anti-dragon shield and antifire potions do not work against Fossil Island wyvern icy breath.
Protect from Magic only provides half the damage reduction of shield protections.

frost-dragons-attacks-and-protection.name: Attacks and protection
frost-dragons-attacks-and-protection.summary: Nullify Frost dragon damage with Protect from Melee and full dragonfire protection.
guidance: 87 Sailing to access Grimstone
Eternal brazier constructed on a boat, or access to another player's boat with one
85 combat to receive Frost dragon assignments
Nieve/Steve or Duradel/Kuradal assignment for on-task kills
Full dragonfire protection through antifire plus anti-dragon shield, or super antifire potion alone
Fairy ring DLP access requires visiting Grimstone at least once
Frost dragons only use melee and short-ranged icy dragonfire.
Their icy dragonfire briefly freezes players who lack adequate protection.
Unlike wyvern icy breath, Frost dragon icy breath is fully negated by normal dragonfire protection.
A regular antifire potion partially reduces icy dragonfire.
A regular antifire potion with an anti-dragon shield, or a super antifire potion alone, fully negates icy dragonfire.
Protect from Melee combined with full dragonfire protection prevents all incoming damage.
Frost dragons can be safespotted because their dragonfire is short-ranged.
They are weakest to crush, then stab, and much more resistant to slash.
They have a 100% elemental weakness to fire spells.
They are dragons, so dragonbane weapons apply.
Being on task increases Dragon metal sheet drop rate from 1/100 to 1/40.

Maintain full dragonfire protection with antifire plus an anti-dragon shield, or with a super antifire potion alone.
Do not treat the icy breath like wyvern breath; Frost dragon icy breath follows normal dragonfire protection rules.
Use a safespot when ranging or maging to avoid melee and short-ranged dragonfire.
Refresh antifire protection before it expires so icy breath cannot freeze the player.

harpie-bug-swarms-task-methods-melee.name: Ordinary melee task
harpie-bug-swarms-task-methods-melee.summary: Ensure Slayer 33, combat level 45, and Firemaking 33, then light and equip a bug lantern (mandatory to deal damage). The best location is east of the Colossal Wyrm Remains in Varlamore, which has safespots and no poison hazards; the Karamja spot north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai also works but needs antipoison. Exploit the 50% fire weakness with fire spells, or use melee given the low defensive bonuses. Swarms are very accurate, so bring 40-50+ Defence gear and food such as lobsters, or keep Protect from Melee active. A cannon can speed up kills, but the bug lantern must stay equipped for it to damage the swarms.

infernal-mages-task-methods-melee.name: Ordinary melee task
infernal-mages-task-methods-melee.summary: Melee Infernal Mages in the north-east room on the first floor of the Slayer Tower. Use your best owned melee equipment and a Slayer helmet or black mask on task. Protect from Magic (37 Prayer) blocks their magic attacks; bring prayer restoration and food. Cannons cannot be used in the tower.
guidance: Priest in Peril

Infernal Mages have 60 Hitpoints, a max hit of 8 and a 4-tick Magic attack. Their Magic level is 75, Defence level 60, and defensive bonuses are 0 against melee/ranged and +40 against Magic. No elemental weakness is listed.
Protect from Magic negates their attacks. They are immune to weak burns.
The superior encounter is the Malevolent Mage; it is not a separately selectable repeatable setup.
No task extension unlock is listed. Mortimer can offer a quantity modifier.
Completed Morytania Diary tiers grant 2.5%, 5%, 7.5% or 10% bonus Slayer experience in the tower.
Use the best owned melee weapon and strength equipment available. The general Slayer training guide recommends an Abyssal whip or stronger alternatives with a defender when the weapon permits one.
Both regular and imbued Slayer helmets or black masks provide their melee task bonus. A Slayer helmet also protects against Banshees and Aberrant spectres on access routes; a black mask does not.

At 37 Prayer or higher, Protect from Magic prevents their incoming damage. Bring prayer potions or super restores to sustain it, and food for emergencies. Without the prayer, expect accurate Magic attacks and take enough food.
Fight individual mages in their first-floor room. They are not aggressive, and the tower does not allow a cannon.

Equipment priorities come from the general Slayer training melee table because Infernal Mage has no dedicated equipment or strategy page. Owned lower-tier alternatives remain eligible through the normal fallback selection.

infernal-mages-task-methods-location-sla.summary: Travel to the north-east room one level above the ground floor; routing targets the Infernal Mage spawns.
guidance: Priest in Peril

Infernal Mages have 60 Hitpoints, a max hit of 8 and a 4-tick Magic attack. Their Magic level is 75, Defence level 60, and defensive bonuses are 0 against melee/ranged and +40 against Magic. No elemental weakness is listed.

Infernal Mages are found only in the Slayer Tower, in the north-east room on the first floor (one level above ground). The Wiki lists 15 spawn tiles.
A Slayer ring teleports to the entrance. Alternatives include fairy ring CKS south of the tower, Salve Graveyard Teleport, or Kharyrll teleport to Canifis, then running north-west.

Fenkenstrain's Castle Teleport followed by a run west, an Ectophial followed by a longer walk, or walking through Paterdomus are further alternatives. Shortest Path checks available transports and their unlocks.
Use the south-east stairs. The normal ground-floor route passes Banshees, so wear Earmuffs or a Slayer helmet while passing them; the eastern broken-window shortcut at 18 Agility avoids that route.

The 61 Agility spiked chain reaches the Aberrant spectre room instead. Wear a Nose peg or Slayer helmet if taking that route; 60 Slayer is needed to equip a Nose peg, not to use the stairs to Infernal Mages.
Cannons are prohibited throughout the Slayer Tower. The Infernal Mage page does not document a safespot; their Magic attacks can still reach ranged attackers.

k-ril-tsutsaroth-general.name: General strategy
k-ril-tsutsaroth-general.summary: Use high magic defence with Protect from Melee for melee-range kills, manage minion damage after K'ril dies, and use blood spells or sustain gear because bones to peaches does not work on ashes.
guidance: Complete Death Plateau and start Troll Stronghold up to defeating Dad, or use Ghommal's hilt to teleport to Trollheim.
Bring one rope for the first God Wars Dungeon entry.
70 Hitpoints is required to enter Zamorak's Fortress.
Zamorak killcount or an appropriate entry bypass is required for repeated boss room access.
K'ril uses melee most often and magic less often; both are single-target.
His melee swipe can poison even through Protect from Melee.
If the target is praying Protect from Melee, K'ril can use Prayer Smash instead of a melee hit, dealing heavy damage and draining prayer. Spectral spirit shield reduces the prayer drain.
His magic attack is only used against players in melee range.
Bodyguards are Balfrug Kreeyath using magic, Tstanon Karlak using melee, and Zakl'n Gritch using ranged.
After K'ril dies, bodyguards retarget random players in the room.
baseline understanding
solo and team kills
Wear gear that can handle K'ril's melee threat while keeping strong magic defence.
Use Protect from Melee during typical melee-range kills.
After K'ril dies, identify which bodyguards are targeting each player.
Kill or control minions while keeping hitpoints high.
For solo sustain, stack Tstanon Karlak and Zakl'n Gritch when possible and use Blood Barrage.
In teams, consider Lunar support spells such as Boost Potion Share and Stat Restore Pot Share.
Ward of Arceuus and Death Charge are optional utility choices when not using Lunar spells.
Preparation prayer reference: Protect from Melee for standard melee-range kills
Preparation prayer reference: Adjust prayers after K'ril dies based on which minions target the player
risks: Prayer Smash can punish Protect from Melee with large damage and prayer drain.
Bones to peaches cannot be used because K'ril and minions drop ashes.

Enter the lair with Protect from Melee and lure the two Kalphite Guardians near the entrance.
Run back to the entrance rope and stand two tiles south so the guardians line up behind each other.
Turn on Protect from Missiles, run three tiles south of the Queen's south-western tile, then immediately run under her.
With the Queen trapped, step out only to attack and step back under or behind the trap before she can retaliate.
Resummon thralls where possible; they add damage while the Queen is trapped.

Kraken can only be killed on a Cave kraken or Kraken task.
Magic is the recommended combat style; Ranged deals 1/7 damage and Melee cannot reach Kraken.
A fishing explosive used on the large whirlpool releases Kraken and all four tentacles immediately.
Without a fishing explosive, all four smaller whirlpools must be disturbed before the large whirlpool can release Kraken.
Kraken and Enormous Tentacles use typeless magical ranged attacks, so protection prayers do not reduce damage.
Kraken's max hit is high but inaccurate; tentacles are more accurate but low damage.
Private instances cost 25,000 coins and dropped items remain for 3 hours, but all ground items are lost when leaving, logging out, or dying.
Auto Retaliate should be off so the player attacks Kraken after the fishing explosive instead of retargeting tentacles.

280px|right|thumb|Map of the wilderness (click to expand) Getting a task from Krystilia is straight-forward. She is in the cell just north of the Edgeville bank. This means that players can teleport there using:

* Amulet of glory to Edgeville and run north-east. * Ring of wealth to the Grand exchange, then run north-west and use the underground level-21 agility shortcut * Monastery teleport, with the Combat bracelet, then run east.
As all tasks are in the Wilderness, the player has many options to teleport there:
* Teleport to the Ferox enclave * Games necklace to Corporeal beast then leave the cave and run from there * Tablets such as Carralanger * Canoes from the river * Other methods of transportation
See [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/images/Wilderness_map.png?a70fc the wilderness map] for locations of enemies in a quick and easy manner.

krystilia-wilderness-reference-requireme.name: Recommended levels and agility
krystilia-wilderness-reference-requireme.summary: Reviewed Krystilia guide reference: Recommended levels and agility.
guidance: Krystilia assignments count only in Wilderness; this guide also applies when other masters permit the selected Wilderness location.

While Krystilia technically has no requirements, players should take into account the speed at which they can kill high defence enemies along with their ability to survive in the Wilderness against both PKers and tough enemies. Those seeking Wilderness slayer tasks should have good stats, as the monsters she assigns can be very high level. Tasks vary substantially; the enemies can be as low combat level as 8, or as high as 470 (especially when it comes to Wilderness boss tasks.)

For this reason, the player should aim for the recommended stats below, ideally: {| |+ | |Attack |Strength |Defence |Ranged |Magic |Prayer |Notes |- |Minimum |60+ Attack |60+ Strength |40+ Defence |61+ Ranged |35+ Magic |43+ Prayer |For protection prayers |- |Recommended |80+ Attack |85+ Strength |80+ Defence |85+ Ranged |70/94 Magic |77+ Prayer |For burst/barrage spells, and Augury and Rigour |}
Note: 43+ prayer for protection prayers, 70/94 magic for burst/barrage spells, and 77+ prayer for piety, augury and rigour

Krystilia's tasks become much more efficient at higher combat levels. Additionally, the player is more readily able to defend themselves against higher level PKers. There are also agility shortcuts that can help to escape from player killers (PKers), the highest of which requires 89 agility. Having 77 will aid in escaping from the Wilderness Slayer Cave, covering most of the important shortcuts. Even access to lower level shortcuts is a bonus.

krystilia-wilderness-reference-equipment.name: General Wilderness preparation
krystilia-wilderness-reference-equipment.summary: Reviewed Krystilia guide reference: General Wilderness preparation.
guidance: Krystilia assignments count only in Wilderness; this guide also applies when other masters permit the selected Wilderness location.

As you are in the Wilderness, the last thing you want to do is skull, so enable PK Skull Prevention. Skulling in the Wilderness means you are limited to keeping only one item in Items Kept on Death only if Protect Item is activated and not deactivated by Smite. If you die while skulled while Protect Item was deactivated or smited, you will lose all items.

Note: Also, Accept Aid should be set to off, as it can be used by PKers in conjunction with Lunar spells to either distract their target or intentionally heal their target to drain more of their prayer with Smite.

Ranged= The webweaver bow, venator bow, and toxic blowpipe are all excellent ranged weapons for wilderness slayer. The webweaver bow, along with other wilderness weapons, can output high raw damage-per-second. This is usually suitable for tasks where the player is killing monsters with high defence levels in single-way combat, or where those monsters are larger than 2x2 (with the exception of lava dragons). These monsters include black dragons, Callisto, and Artio. The venator bow is significantly better than the webweaver bow for tasks where the player is killing 2x2 monsters in a multicombat area. These tasks include ice giants, hellhounds, and lesser demons in the wilderness slayer cave. It also outclasses burst and barrage spells for these monsters, as they are too large to kill with area of effect ancients. The toxic blowpipe can work for tasks where the player needs to kill lots of low-hitpoint monsters, low defence monsters. Examples include scorpions, skeletons, or spiders. That being said, wilderness bosses can be killed for each of these tasks, and is generally recommended for higher players. The exception is Scorpia for scorpions; the area is active with player killers, multi-combat, deep Wilderness, and hard to escape. Players should bring at most 4 expensive items (3 is recommended if in multi-combat) and the rest of the equipment should be cheap enough that the player will not mind losing it. |-| Melee= The ursine chainmace offers the best DPS overall for tasks where the player is fighting monsters with a low defence level in single-way combat, or where those monsters are larger than 2x2. Many tasks fall in this category, such as black demons, greater demons, green dragons, ice warriors, and mammoths. |-| Magic= Barring the use of chinchompas, blood barrage offers the best DPS across all styles for tasks where the player is killing 1x1 monsters in a multicombat area, such as the wilderness slayer cave. Blood barrage is preferable to ice barrage as it allows the enemies to move freely, which is preferable both for those who wish to auto-retaliate the task as well as those who wish to maximize DPS, as a back-and-forth movement between spell casts will cause enemies to continuously stack without tick loss if they are unfrozen.

For tasks where the player is not fighting 1x1 enemies in a multicombat area, the accursed sceptre's powered spell offers good DPS but is outclassed by ranged or melee equipment at nearly all locations. A notable exception is lava dragons, where it is best-in-slot overall. |-| Revenants = This setup aims to maximise DPS against the revenants while miminizing risk. Ranged can usually offer better dps against revenants with less gear used, and d'hide conveniently adds ranged accuracy while giving magic defence. However, you will be more vulnerable to incoming melee and ranged attacks from PKers without a shield. Note: Do not bring anything you are not okay with losing, especially if using the amulet of avarice as this will skull you.

* As revenants have very high accuracy, the bracelet of ethereum is highly recommended when battling them; this reduces damage taken from revenants by 75% when charged. It can be charged with their ether drops. The player should take around 30-50 ether in it, and use the ether drops to refill it (requires closing the looting bag) * The amulet of avarice is the most powerful amulet for killing revenants, giving the same bonuses as a Salve amulet(ei) and a amulet of glory combined, but makes the player skulled until unequipped (and for 20 minutes thereafter), increasing your potential risk substantially and making yourself a target for player killers. However, you will receive many of the revenants' drops in noted form, along with an increased chance to roll on the drop table for a Wilderness weapon or additional amulet of avarice due to being constantly skulled. The decision whether or not to use this item should not be taken lightly. ** If you do not possess or do not wish to use an amulet of avarice, Revenants are considered undead creatures, so the salve amulet and variants will work on them. ** If using an amulet of avarice, players may choose to 1-item with a magic shortbow, or risk the avarice to be able to use the webweaver bow. * Any of the Wilderness weapons will drastically increase your kills per hour, but require 1,000 ether to charge, plus additional ether for usage. The Webweaver bow is by far the best here. No more than 500 extra ether is necessary per trip for a total of 1,500 ether in the weapon. On death, this will be lost and the weapon will have to be recharged and reloaded. See the revenants strategy page for alternatives, albeit for less kills and less profit. * A bracelet with 50 ether will suffice as the bracelet and its ether is always lost upon death and more can be obtained than what is consumed while fighting revenants.

This isn't completely reliable and can result in death. This does not work in singles-plus combat like at revenants. Ensure you are high prayer points before X-logging, if using Protect Item. After 60 seconds, the player can log back in to another world to see if they survived. * Summer pies restore 10% run energy as well as increasing agility, possibly allowing the use of higher level shortcuts and aiding in run regeneration slightly. ** They can also be eaten very quickly (2-ticks per full pie), healing 22. Also used to slay magic axes, a task given by Krystilia. * Chaos talisman or chaos tiara, to enter the chaos runecrafting altar in level 9 wilderness to escape a PKer. This can help most when close to the teleport of the Wilderness obelisk. Can also be used to push a player on or off the wilderness obelisk before a teleport activates.

krystilia-wilderness-reference-task-bloc.name: Task blocks, skips and boss alternatives
krystilia-wilderness-reference-task-bloc.summary: Reviewed Krystilia guide reference: Task blocks, skips and boss alternatives.
guidance: Krystilia assignments count only in Wilderness; this guide also applies when other masters permit the selected Wilderness location.
Prefer three protected valuables as the normal baseline; Protect Item is a conditional fourth item, not a guaranteed retained slot.
A deployed cannon is treated differently on death from its carried parts; carry/deployment risk is explained separately.

Each slayer master has their own unique block list, allowing the player to choose which tasks are blocked unique to their chosen slayer master. For the full list of tasks, see Krystilia's task list further below. Some tasks provide much lower experience rates and points per hour, and thus are deserving of a block. Wilderness slayer has the added dimension of risk of Player killers. Because of the focus on points per hour associated with wilderness slayer, and the different tasks given, Krystilia's block list will look much different to other slayer masters.

What the player blocks depends on many factors; levels, experience bossing, personal risk tolerance, gear and many other variables. Still, some tasks are fairly universally disliked due to their high time to complete. Tasks being fast to complete is very important for wilderness slayer given that the most common reason for choosing to do wilderness slayer is the high amount of slayer reward points that it offers. As a result, if this is the player's aim in performing wilderness slayer, it is recommended to focus on blocking the tasks that will take an extremely long time to complete. The purpose of this is to maximize points per hour and minimize the need to skip tasks, which greatly cuts into the slayer points per hour the player will gain. The following table shows some tasks that should be blocked by the player:

Info: "Weighting" is how likely the task is to be given, in comparison to other tasks. Tasks with high weight are much more likely to be given than those with lower weights. {| class="wikitable sortable lighttable" |+ !Task !Recommended action !Reason |- |Spiritual creatures |Block |Wilderness God Wars Dungeon only. Extremely long time to complete. |- |Bloodveld |Block |Wilderness God Wars Dungeon only. Extremely long time to complete. Low weight, but excessively long completion time encourages blocking to avoid the need to skip this task and lose points per hour. |- |Aviansies |Block or leave locked |Wilderness God Wars Dungeon only. Extremely long time to complete. High weight. |- |Black demons |Block |Long time to complete. High weight. Mediocre experience per hour. |- |Greater demons |Block or complete |Long time to complete. Very high weight. Offers good experience per hour, so this task may be completed if the player is doing wilderness slayer with an emphasis on experience. |- |Green dragons |Block or complete |Long time to complete. May be completed if the player considers the loot sufficient to make up for the long completion time. |- |Fire giants |Block or complete |Somewhat long time to complete. High weight. Deep Wilderness. |- |Revenants |Block or complete |Much slower to complete than many other tasks, so this should be blocked if the player primarily cares about slayer points. However, revenants do offer excellent loot, so if the player wishes, they may complete revenants tasks to obtain this loot and block other tasks instead. |- |Lava dragons |Block or complete |Long time to complete. Like revenants, however, lava dragons offer good loot. The player may choose to complete this task and block others instead if they consider the loot sufficient to make up for the slow completion time. |- |Ice warriors |Block or complete |Fairly long time to complete. High weight. Found in a high-traffic area for PKers. Offers no loot. |- |Ent |Block or complete |Somewhat long time to complete. Moderate weight. Offers no loot other than the logs gained when chopping its remains. |- |Magic axes |Block or complete |Somewhat long time to complete. High weight. Offers no loot. |- |} If the player is completing wilderness slayer tasks to quickly gain slayer points, it is generally recommended to avoid skipping tasks. This is because all wilderness slayer tasks are fairly completable once bloodveld, spiritual creatures, and aviansies are blocked, and skipping tasks greatly decreases the player's points gained per hour.
While some tasks may seem terrible at first glance, many have alternatives that can be killed that are superior.

* Pirates or Zombies: Zombie pirates at the Chaos Temple (Wilderness) are an incredibly good task, and very profitable. As they're undead, the player can use salve amulet (ei); this doesn't stack with the slayer helmet (i), and should therefore be used in place of the much more valuable helmet. They are found in low wilderness, and can be killed with area of effect attacks like cannons, venator bow, and burst/barrage spells. The permanent buffs from teleport anchoring scroll and Wilderness Medium make a massive difference here, and are practically essential.
* Bears, Spiders, Skeletons: Can kill the Wildernes bosses for each respective task (E.g. Spindel or Venenatis for a spider task). Excellent tasks for mid to higher leveled players.

* Hellhounds: Can kill Vet'ion or Calvar'ion, as they both summon four skeleton hellhounds, which count as both skeletons and hellhounds. Can also kill Wilderness slayer cave hellhounds, which can be killed with venator bow and cannon.
* Scorpions: Setting up a cannon inside of scorpia's lair allows this task to be completed within a matter of seconds.
What the player chooses to block is specific to them. Not having a cannon and venator bow will make some tasks much worse. It's ultimately up to each player to decide what is best for them.

High agility is an advantage in the Wilderness. The energy restoration rate is useful, since you often need to travel longer distances on foot in the Wilderness. Furthermore, run energy may be important when fleeing player killers. Additionally, access to the following shortcuts may make both travel and fleeing easier:

*The Runelite plugin "Wilderness player alarm" is an excellent way to be notified that a player is nearby, flashing the screen and giving an audible alert. *Because you will be slaying monsters instead of players, it's advised that you go to Options -> Controls and check the 'PK Skull Prevention'. Doing so negates the chances of being skull-tricked by PKers, as you can no longer accidentally attack players. *Using the Arceuus spellbook with spare runes to cast the respective reanimation spell of the Slayer monster you are assigned to, provided it drops an ensouled head, can earn you some Prayer experience. This works only if you just recently received the drop, however. *Along with blighted anglerfish, bringing a couple of saradomin brews, blighted super restore and Anti-venom can lengthen your chance at survival during player-killer encounters. Prayer-switching is essential against PKers with multiple combat styles. To aid in escapes, bringing Dinh's bulwark to wear along with Black dragonhide armour can increase survivability massively. Quick prayers set to defend against enemy PKers (Protect from Magic, Protect Item and your best offensive magic prayer) can increase the chance that they will splash against you, further assisting in an escape. *If praying, the player may bring blighted super restore for prayer restoration if using fast-draining prayers, such as Piety. As food is crucial to have out in the Wilderness, some players may opt to forgo fast-draining prayers entirely in order to save space for more food. Smite can further increase the risk of overusing certain prayers, hence saving prayer points allows further use of protection prayers and protect item. *Bank your Larran's keys if you gain multiple and feel as though you could die; they are always risked. *At 84 Thieving, you can steal from the Chest (Rogues' Castle) to make the rogues aggressive towards you while also making some extra money. *Aggro is good to have out in the Wilderness especially if you are being flanked by a PKer as it could buy you some time to escape. Also, you could try X-logging in single combat, which is clicking the red X on your screen or game client to close it, before killing a monster or while battling it, depending on how difficult the monster is to take down. Switching to a fun weapon (if brought), auto-attacking and then X-logging is a better tactic of escape when doing this. (red Warning: X-logging does not work in a multi-combat area.) *A clue box can be used to protect your clue scroll within the Wilderness. *You can also use an imp-in-a-box or two to bank your emblems or other high-risk items, but 71 Hunter is required to catch imps, and it will not work if past level 30 Wilderness or if tele-blocked. *Use an expeditious bracelet if you want to finish your task faster. *Use a bracelet of slaughter if you want to extend your task as much as possible, useful if you are hunting for Larran's keys and get an easy task (Spiders, Skeletons, Scorpions for example). *Players may opt to use a Dwarf multicannon to speed up kills. However, this does add additional risk if encountering Player-Killers. Also, if the player steps outside the Wilderness while the cannon continues to fire, accrued kills will NOT count toward their task. Leave the cannon on the ground if a PKer shows up, as a set up cannon is not lost on death, and even if it breaks and despawns a new set can be reobtained for free from Nulodion.

Bigger and Badder unlocks King kurask superior spawns.
Iorwerth Dungeon requires Song of the Elves.
Kurask Lair requires 58 Sailing to dock on Laguna Aurorae for the first time.
Bones to Peaches requires the Mage Training Arena unlock.
Kurasks attack with crush and can hit up to 11.
Protect from Melee negates all normal Kurask damage.
With at least 75 Defence, players can skip prayer and use Bones to Peaches for lower-cost sustain.
King kurask has no special mechanics, but is more accurate and has a max hit of 33.
Kurasks are weakest to stab, ranged, and magic attacks.
The leafy attribute restricts damage to leaf-bladed weapons, broad-tipped ammunition, or Magic Dart.
Cannons and Thralls do not deal damage to Kurasks.
Saradomin godsword, Ancient godsword, and Toxic blowpipe special attacks can still heal as if their rolled damage landed.
Ancient mace and Eldritch nightmare staff special attacks can restore Prayer based on rolled damage.
Guthan's equipment set effect does not activate against Kurasks.
Kurasks have fast health regeneration, healing 1 Hitpoint every five game ticks.
Kurasks have a small aggressive range of 2 centered on their south-west tile.

lesser-nagua-neypotzli-sulphur.summary: Fight the 14 Sulphur Nagua in Neypotzli, making supplies freely inside and dodging the prayer-drain special.
guidance: 48 Slayer and 70 combat
Completion of Perilous Moons
Completion of The Final Dawn for Earthen Nagua in the Crypt of Tonali
75 Hunter to catch moonlight moths for prayer restoration (optional)
Sulphur Nagua use a special attack every 5 auto-attacks that drains 5 prayer points unless the player moves out of melee range.
Frost Nagua periodically mark the player's current tile, draining prayer if the player does not move away before the effect triggers.
Earthen Nagua at 60% or lower hitpoints shuffle their melee defences, becoming much weaker to crush while gaining resistance to stab and slash.
All variants have negative flat armour, amplifying multi-hitsplat weapons.
No location is cannonable and only Neypotzli is safespottable.

lizardman-shaman-canyon-ranged-shayzien.name: Canyon ranged with full Shayzien
lizardman-shaman-canyon-ranged-shayzien.summary: A ranged setup with all five acid-protection slots enforced.
guidance: Full Shayzien tier 5 negates acid-spit damage but does not prevent poison.
A Slayer helmet can replace only the Shayzien helm after the hard Kourend & Kebos Diary AND speaking to Captain Cleive to unlock its protection.
The Wiki recommends 60+ Ranged and 40+ Prayer (43+ preferred), or 80+ Attack and Strength for melee. These are recommendations rather than universal entry gates.
Ranged allows easier movement; shamans have no ranged defence bonus and negative stab defence. Slash, crush and magic face higher defence.
Canyon shamans are multi-combat and cannonable. Northern settlement caves and the Molch temple are single-combat and do not permit a cannon.
Keep every required Shayzien piece equipped; use the tier 5 helmet until the diary and Captain Cleive unlock are both complete.
Use ranged and keep space from the shaman.
Move away from jumps and exploding spawns. The western or southern wall can block jump landing positions; wall positioning does not neutralise every special.
Preparation prayer reference: Protect from Missiles
risks: Poison remains possible while wearing the full protective set.

lizardman-shaman-locations-and-access.summary: Choose the room type and assignment restriction before preparing a trip.
guidance: Full Shayzien tier 5 negates acid-spit damage but does not prevent poison.
A Slayer helmet can replace only the Shayzien helm after the hard Kourend & Kebos Diary AND speaking to Captain Cleive to unlock its protection.

Canyon shamans are multi-combat and cannonable. Northern settlement caves and the Molch temple are single-combat and do not permit a cannon.
The western Lizardman Canyon holds three shamans in multi-combat and allows a cannon.
The caves north of the Lizardman Settlement contain eight shamans, two in each of four single-combat rooms. A lizardman Slayer assignment is required.

The temple beneath Molch has six shamans, two in each of three single-combat rooms, and permits off-task kills. Enter through a dwelling; the strange hole is the exit. Repeated internal barrier crossings cause increasing damage after three and six crossings.
Travel from Xeric's Inferno or fairy ring DJR to the canyon and settlement; Xeric's Lookout is an alternative approach to Molch.

lizardman-shaman-acid-and-helmet-waiver.summary: The diary reward only replaces the helmet slot and must be explicitly activated.

Acid spit otherwise deals up to 30 unblockable damage and can poison. Full tier 5 Shayzien armour negates the damage while still allowing poison.

lizardman-shaman-jump-and-spawns.summary: Walls influence jump landing availability but exploding spawns still require movement.
