A jump targets the previous player position. Its impact covers 3-by-3 tiles in the canyon and 2-by-2 in the temple, with the northeast temple tile at the target.
Blocking the landing tile to the south or west with a wall prevents jumps. Canyon obstacles and the temple western or southern walls provide useful positions.
Three spawns appear: two nearby and one underneath. The one underneath explodes first; their 8-10 damage reaches players within two tiles. Move away or use obstacles to interfere with their path.

lizardman-shaman-inventory-plans.name: Canyon, cave and temple supplies
lizardman-shaman-inventory-plans.summary: Match poison and prayer supplies to room choice and intended trip length.
guidance: Full Shayzien tier 5 negates acid-spit damage but does not prevent poison.
A Slayer helmet can replace only the Shayzien helm after the hard Kourend & Kebos Diary AND speaking to Captain Cleive to unlock its protection.
The Wiki recommends 60+ Ranged and 40+ Prayer (43+ preferred), or 80+ Attack and Strength for melee. These are recommendations rather than universal entry gates.
Ranged allows easier movement; shamans have no ranged defence bonus and negative stab defence. Slash, crush and magic face higher defence.
Canyon shamans are multi-combat and cannonable. Northern settlement caves and the Molch temple are single-combat and do not permit a cannon.

Canyon ranged: two divine ranging potions, one antidote++ or two superantipoisons, optional one or two stamina potions, six to eight prayer potions, cannon and cannonballs, food and an emergency teleport.

Settlement caves: similar ranged supplies without a cannon, with an optional stamina potion. Temple: three or four ranging potions, two antidote++ or three or four superantipoisons, mostly prayer supplies and some food.

molanisks-task-methods-melee.name: Ordinary melee task
molanisks-task-methods-melee.summary: Complete Death to the Dorgeshuun, then bring a Slayer bell, a light source and a rope to descend into the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon (near fairy ring AJQ). ogres-task-methods-melee.summary: The best spot is the level 53 ogres west of Yanille, where you can safespot behind the stone wall and/or use a Dragon cannon. Ogres attack with crush, have low Defence, and are 20% weak to earth spells, so any combat style works. Zogres and Skogres at Jiggig require brutal arrows and can inflict disease.
guidance: Ogres are assigned only by Vannaka (40-90) at combat level 40; there is no Slayer level or quest requirement for the task itself, and no extended range.
Ogres are most commonly found in Kandarin.
Along with ogres, Ogress Warriors and Ogress Shamans, Mogres, Zogres, and Skogres all count towards the task. Jogres do NOT count.
Zogres and Skogres have a lower combat level but can inflict disease, so take caution; brutal arrows work best against them.

otherworldly-beings-task-methods-melee.summary: Complete Lost City and reach combat level 40, then travel to Zanaris (via a fairy ring or the Lost City route). phantom-muspah-general.name: General strategy
phantom-muspah-general.summary: Use ranged as the baseline setup, add magic for the melee form when gear allows, handle specials by movement, and prepare a dedicated shield-phase drain plan.
guidance: Complete Secrets of the North to access Ghorrock Dungeon and refight the Phantom Muspah.
High Ranged is strongly recommended; Magic is recommended for form switching or melee-form control.
Use Protect from Missiles by default in ranged form and switch immediately to Protect from Magic for the charged magic attack.
Bring a crossbow and sapphire bolts or sapphire dragon bolts for the shielded phase if not relying on Smite and corruption spells alone.
Use a Ring of shadows with frozen tablet, icy basalt, Weiss player-owned house portal, or Larry's boat route to reach Weiss.

Ranged form mainly attacks with ranged and occasionally charges a magic projectile. Protect from Missiles should be active by default, then swap to Protect from Magic as soon as the magic animation starts.
Melee form gains danger if allowed to stand still and chain melee hits. Maintain distance, use the stepback timing with Protect from Melee, freeze it, or kite it around the room.
Transformations spawn spikes, including one under the player. Standing on a spike knocks the player back and heals the boss for part of the damage dealt.
Lightning clouds appear during one special attack. Avoid the travelling clouds and keep attacking where possible; Muspah finishes this special to the north-east.
Homing spikes move toward the player. Hide behind hardened spikes when multiple spikes are grouped together.
At low health, Muspah uses a shockwave and enters shielded form with a prayer shield and Soul Split. Stand behind a spike for the shockwave, then drain the prayer shield before finishing the kill.
The shielded phase prayer shield is drained by attacks and by prayer-draining effects. Smite, corruption spells, and sapphire bolt effects all speed it up.
After the shield breaks, Muspah returns to ranged form with faster attacks and more spike pressure.

Range-camp or range-plus-mage setups
Enter with ranged gear and a plan for the melee form: magic switch, freeze, stepback, or ranged kiting.
During ranged form, camp Protect from Missiles and switch to Protect from Magic immediately when Muspah charges the magic projectile.
Move away from transformation spikes, especially the spike that appears on the player's current tile.
During specials, avoid lightning clouds or block homing spikes behind hardened spikes.
At the low-health shockwave, stand behind a spike before Muspah enters shielded form.
Drain the shield with attacks, Smite, corruption spells, and sapphire bolt procs.
After the shield breaks, finish the final ranged form while managing faster attacks and new spikes.
Thrall damage does not count toward most form-switch thresholds, except the final stand transformation.
Muspah defence reductions persist between phases until shielded phase, where defence resets.

risks: Late Protect from Magic swaps can cause high damage and corruption.

scurrius-solo-mid-melee.name: Solo melee (mid level)
scurrius-solo-mid-melee.summary: Melee (mid level) preparation for the free private instance (500 Hitpoints).
guidance: The lair has no quest or Slayer-level gate. The Wiki recommends combat stats around 50 and 43 Prayer for the protection-prayer preparations.
Equipment levels, complete-set conditions, selected spellbook and weapon charge preparation are checked separately.
The private solo form has 500 Hitpoints and combat level 200; the public group form has 1,500 Hitpoints and combat level 250. Both count for Rat assignments.
Phase one starts with melee attacks and occasional falling bricks. At 80% health Scurrius moves to a food pile and breaks binds.

Phase two alternates feeding and ordinary combat. Ten eating animations contain five healing events, each restoring 5 or 10 Hitpoints per player. During feeding Scurrius uses ranged and magic, without melee.
At 30% health (150 solo or 450 group), phase three moves to the centre, accelerates ranged and magic attacks, and removes melee attacks. Healing above 30% returns the encounter to phase two.
Tail Swipe is the fastest and most accurate basic attack. The matching protection prayer negates each basic attack; ranged and magic damage is checked on impact.
Falling Bricks targets the player position at initiation plus random ground positions; damage is 15-22 solo or 15-24 group. Repeated casts can occur in phase three.
Minion waves contain six level-46 giant rats. Any hit kills one; their melee attacks can still deal 0-1 through protection, or up to 4 without it. Phase three can summon up to 12 waves.
Rat bone weapons have no attack delay between summoned-rat attacks. An attack on the boss followed by a minion still incurs the normal boss-attack delay.
Players choosing Scurrius for boss practice and combat experience while completing a Rat assignment.
Review the three-phase encounter before entering; falling bricks and minions remain relevant to every combat style.
Clear remaining giant rats after the boss dies; surviving rats can interrupt food-pile healing.
All equipment alternatives retain their order within the source table; equipped set dependencies implement the source footnotes.
Quantities are the Wiki example trip inventory, not an estimate for a complete assignment. Adjust food and prayer restoration to trip length and experience.
Void armour is eligible only as a complete matching set. The mid-level any-team-cape fallback retains all 50 ordinary numbered team capes; the vestment-cloak row includes all six gods.
Solo guarantees the MVP damage role and uses the weaker private form.
Preparation prayer reference: 43 Prayer unlocks all three protection prayers used by this preparation.
risks: Ground damage and minion chip damage are separate from the protected basic attacks.
Cannons are prohibited; this encounter is not a safespot.

requirements: Completed Daero's training or defeated the Culinaromancer

guidance: The lair has no quest or Slayer-level gate. The Wiki recommends combat stats around 50 and 43 Prayer for the protection-prayer preparations.
Equipment levels, complete-set conditions, selected spellbook and weapon charge preparation are checked separately.
The private solo form has 500 Hitpoints and combat level 200; the public group form has 1,500 Hitpoints and combat level 250. Both count for Rat assignments.
Phase one starts with melee attacks and occasional falling bricks. At 80% health Scurrius moves to a food pile and breaks binds.

Phase two alternates feeding and ordinary combat. Ten eating animations contain five healing events, each restoring 5 or 10 Hitpoints per player. During feeding Scurrius uses ranged and magic, without melee.
At 30% health (150 solo or 450 group), phase three moves to the centre, accelerates ranged and magic attacks, and removes melee attacks. Healing above 30% returns the encounter to phase two.
Tail Swipe is the fastest and most accurate basic attack. The matching protection prayer negates each basic attack; ranged and magic damage is checked on impact.
Falling Bricks targets the player position at initiation plus random ground positions; damage is 15-22 solo or 15-24 group. Repeated casts can occur in phase three.
Minion waves contain six level-46 giant rats. Any hit kills one; their melee attacks can still deal 0-1 through protection, or up to 4 without it. Phase three can summon up to 12 waves.
Rat bone weapons have no attack delay between summoned-rat attacks. An attack on the boss followed by a minion still incurs the normal boss-attack delay.
A short period without being attacked is required; surviving minions can interrupt it even after Scurrius dies.
Use more food while learning; replace food with prayer restoration as avoidable damage falls.
Melee can use normal or divine super combat potions, or separate attack/strength/defence boosts. Ranged can use normal/divine ranging, with bastion alternatives for Defence.
High-level magic can use a saturated heart or forgotten brews; brews reduce Defence and may require extra restores.
Prayer potions, super restores and food or Saradomin brews are the sustain options. Holy wrench or a Prayer cape improves prayer restoration.
Keep a suitable teleport available. High-level examples use a house tablet; a Max cape is an alternative.

sea-snakes-task-methods-melee.name: Ordinary melee task
sea-snakes-task-methods-melee.summary: Complete Royal Trouble, then travel to Miscellania and Etceteria Dungeon. Bring an antipoison of any tier since both hatchlings and young are poisonous. skeletons-melee.name: Melee (Salve)
skeletons-melee.summary: Wear a Salve amulet and clear skeletons with any melee weapon; crush weapons are most accurate.
guidance: No Slayer level is required to receive a Skeletons task.
Krystilia's skeletons must be killed in the Wilderness (e.g. the northern Wilderness section of Edgeville Dungeon).
Lower-level skeletons can hit up to 3 damage; the armed level 45 skeletons in northern Edgeville Dungeon hit up to 5 with slash melee at a 4-tick speed.
They are undead: the Salve amulet applies and they have a 35% earth spell weakness.
Their crush defensive bonus is negative (-5), so crush weapons hit most accurately.
all skeletons tasks
Equip a Salve amulet for the undead damage boost.
For starter masters, kill skeletons in the Edgeville Dungeon or Varrock Sewers.
For Krystilia, kill Wilderness skeletons at the northern Wilderness section of Edgeville Dungeon with risk-appropriate gear.
Key item or prerequisite: Any melee weapon (Dragon scimitar or a crush weapon)
Key item or prerequisite: Salve amulet / Salve amulet (ei)

Arclight and Emberlight disable an altar in one hit regardless of stats. Scorching bow, demonbane spells, Silverlight and Darklight do not share this effect.
Use Emberlight or a charged Arclight on Skotizo.
Deactivate altars as they accumulate; use magic protection while travelling away from melee range.
With strong melee armour, use magic protection and step away between attacks; choose the high magic defence variant for the alternative prayer trade-off.

risks: Arclight needs charges; ownership does not establish sufficient internal charges.

smoke-devil-requirements-and-transportat.name: Requirements and transportation
smoke-devil-requirements-and-transportat.summary: Bank, restore, and enter the Smoke Devil Dungeon with smoke protection and cannon supplies.
guidance: 93 Slayer
Active Smoke devils Slayer task
40 Prayer for Protect from Missiles
Facemask or Slayer helmet for smoke protection
94 Magic for Ice Barrage; Ice Burst can be used at lower Magic
Dwarf multicannon and cannonballs for efficient grouping
High Defence and magic-damage armour such as Virtus or Ancestral are recommended
82+ Construction for ornate pool and jewellery box is recommended, or use ring of dueling for Ferox Enclave and Castle Wars
Smoke devils attack only with ranged, and Protect from Missiles prevents all damage from their attacks.
The dungeon is smoky; players not wearing a facemask or Slayer helmet take periodic 10 damage.
Without face protection, Smoke devil attacks deal very rapid damage and drain stats.
Misclicking a Slayer helmet off the head, or equipping a rune full helm drop by mistake, can quickly lead to death.
Smoke devils have high defence and some magic defence, but their Magic level is low enough that barrage spells remain accurate.
The Smoke Devil Dungeon is large, so the cannon is used primarily to pull and stack monsters for barrage hits.
Valuable common drops such as rune chainbody, fire battlestaves, and air battlestaves help offset rune and cannonball costs; occult necklace drops can make the task profitable.
Bracelet of slaughter is usually favoured over Tormented bracelet because longer tasks maximise Slayer experience.

sourhogs-stab-melee.name: Stab melee with goggles
sourhogs-stab-melee.summary: Wear Reinforced goggles (or a post-quest Slayer helmet) and attack with a stab weapon such as a dragon dagger.
guidance: Quest A Porcine of Interest to access Sourhog Cave; no combat or Slayer level requirement.
Reinforced goggles or a post-quest Slayer helmet to avoid the 20-30 caustic hit and 90% Attack/Defence drain.
Assigned only by Spria.
The Sourhog has 40 Hitpoints, Defence level 25, a normal max hit of 6 and a 5-tick attack.
Without eye protection its caustic saliva hits 20-30 and drains Attack and Defence by 90%.
No elemental weakness; +0 stab and +0 ranged Defence make stab and ranged the most accurate.
standard task completion
Start A Porcine of Interest and enter Sourhog Cave south of Draynor.
Equip Reinforced goggles (or a Slayer helmet after the quest) so the caustic saliva cannot land.
Attack the Sourhog with a stab weapon; its Defence is +0 to stab versus +30 to slash.
Bring a little food; the normal max hit is only 6 with goggles on.
Key item or prerequisite: A stab weapon (e.g. dragon dagger)

terror-dogs-task-methods-melee.summary: Ensure Slayer 40 (unboostable), combat level 60, and completion of Haunted Mine, then teleport to Tarn's Lair with a slayer ring (the trek on foot is long and dangerous). Fight the terror dogs in the room where Tarn Razorlor was beaten. They hit hard and accurately with Crush but have all-zero defensive bonuses, so any strong melee or Ranged setup works well; high-level players often use a Venator bow. Wait for the dogs to become tolerant, or lure one onto the tile in front of the doorway to safespot from Tarn's room with Magic or Ranged.

tormented-demon-max-melee-magic.name: Max Melee/Magic
tormented-demon-max-melee-magic.summary: Use melee with a magic switch whenever the demon protects against the current style. A high-damage hybrid with more equipment switches.
requirements: Arceuus spellbook with Dark Demonbane and Mark of Darkness selected
guidance: While Guthix Sleeps
At least two combat styles and protection prayers.
Tormented demons change protection prayer after taking 150 damage and pause their attacks for six ticks.
Non-demonbane and non-abyssal damage is reduced by the fire shield.
The shield drops at the beginning and following fire bombs; a slow crush weapon, heavy ranged weapon, or manually cast spell can exploit the next hit.
Shield-down attack bonuses depend on weapon speed; powered staves do not qualify as spells for this bonus.
After roughly 30 ticks of ordinary combat the demon becomes defenceless, granting 100% accuracy until the first hit after fire bombs.
Fire bombs bind briefly, disable run, and damage their landing areas even after the demon dies. Open spaces offer more escape room.
With two demons one uses melee and the other ranged or magic. A third uses fire bombs, greatly increasing attention.
Start with a style the demon does not protect against; change style after its protection prayer changes.
Use the second style as a complete usable setup, including ammunition or spell runes.
Use slow crush or heavy ranged weapons for the shield-down hit; set heavy ranged weapons to Accurate.
Use the defenceless period for suitable special attacks or high damage with fewer accuracy switches.
The setup is a preparation reference; the plugin does not issue live prayer or movement prompts.
Rune quantities are trip-planning defaults, not a guarantee for a full assignment.
If choosing an alternative magic staff, check its autocast compatibility and rune supply.

trolls-requirements-and-access.name: Requirements and access
trolls-requirements-and-access.summary: Choose between accessible mountain trolls, better island ice trolls, discouraged river trolls, and quest-boss alternatives.
guidance: 60 combat before assignment
43 Prayer strongly recommended for Protect from Melee
The Fremennik Trials to speak to Mord Gunnars and access Jatizso/Neitiznot for island ice trolls
Dwarf Cannon completion to use a dwarf multicannon
Neitiznot shield for island ice trolls, especially ice troll females
92 Magic and Arceuus spellbook if using Sinister Offering
Hard Morytania Diary if using bonecrusher for passive Prayer experience
Trolls are mostly found in the Fremennik Province and north of Burthorpe.
Quest trolls count toward a Trolls Slayer task except sea trolls.
Troll bosses can be refought in Nightmare Zone after their quests.
Mountain trolls are accessible with no quest requirement and direct damage can be completely blocked by Protect from Melee.

Thrower trolls and troll generals count but are scarce, inconvenient, and have poor or nonexistent drops.

werewolves-task-methods-melee.name: Ordinary melee task
werewolves-task-methods-melee.summary: Werewolves are a Vannaka-only task in Canifis (Priest in Peril required for Morytania access). They wander as level 24 humans and transform into level 88 werewolves when attacked - only the transformed form counts. Their melee defensive bonuses are all +0, so any melee style is accurate, and magic works well too despite a high listed Magic defence; bring a Slayer helmet. The fastest approach is a Dwarf multicannon in the village centre: with 40 Agility, run the Canifis Rooftop Course so the cannon clears werewolves while you earn Agility XP and Marks of grace, or tuck into a building and close the door to stack them for the cannon. Melee players can hold them in human form with Wolfbane (lower max hit) and swap weapons when their HP is low.

Single-combat area, but a Dwarf multicannon set in the village centre hits every werewolf in range; with 40 Agility, cannon-and-run the Canifis Rooftop Course for Agility XP and Marks of grace while the cannon clears the task.
Alternative cannon method: place the cannon, run into a nearby building and close the door so werewolves stack aggressively behind it while the cannon fires (reload from outside periodically).

Safespots: over the central STASH unit, and inside the pub behind the bar or across the two tables (4 werewolves are inside the pub). Attacking stops when a human transforms, so re-target the werewolf form.
Melee: attack with Wolfbane equipped to keep them in human form (lower max hit ~2), then swap weapons when their HP is very low; they regain 38 HP on transforming but overall take less damage.

wingman-skree-solo-defensive-ranged.name: Solo defensive ranged encounter
wingman-skree-solo-defensive-ranged.summary: A defensive crossbow setup handles the complete Armadyl encounter and its magic bodyguard.
guidance: The Armadyl encampment requires 70 Ranged, a crossbow and mith grapple, and the applicable killcount or a valid entry bypass.
Death Plateau and Troll Stronghold progress through Dad are one approach; Ghommal's hilt provides an alternative Trollheim route.
An aviansie task is optional; Kree'arra and all three bodyguards count towards it.
Kree'arra and the bodyguards form one encounter. Ranged protection is central while Kree'arra is alive because his ranged hit reaches 69.
Kree'arra's magic attack rolls against ranged defence. His ranged and magic attacks damage all players, so teams have no single designated tank.
Flight Kilisa uses melee up to 15, Wingman Skree magic up to 16, and Flockleader Geerin ranged up to 25.
Keep Kree'arra targeted between attacks and retain ranged protection while he is alive. Untargeted Kree'arra can approach for melee.
Use a corner to prevent knockback, and step under the boss between attacks where the chosen weapon cadence permits.
After Kree'arra dies, kill Wingman Skree with the main ranged weapon or an optional blowpipe, then finish or heal from Kilisa and Geerin.
The Wiki calls this equipment grid Ranged Tank; it describes defensive equipment, not a designated tank role in a group.
Preparation prayer reference: Protect from Missiles while Kree'arra is alive

wingman-skree-solo-chinchompas.name: Solo chinchompa overlap encounter
wingman-skree-solo-chinchompas.summary: Chinchompas target the low-defence bodyguard and deal area damage to overlapping Kree'arra.
guidance: The Armadyl encampment requires 70 Ranged, a crossbow and mith grapple, and the applicable killcount or a valid entry bypass.
Death Plateau and Troll Stronghold progress through Dad are one approach; Ghommal's hilt provides an alternative Trollheim route.
An aviansie task is optional; Kree'arra and all three bodyguards count towards it.
Kree'arra and the bodyguards form one encounter. Ranged protection is central while Kree'arra is alive because his ranged hit reaches 69.
Kree'arra's magic attack rolls against ranged defence. His ranged and magic attacks damage all players, so teams have no single designated tank.
Flight Kilisa uses melee up to 15, Wingman Skree magic up to 16, and Flockleader Geerin ranged up to 25.
Start in the southwest corner and align Kilisa with Kree'arra's southwest anchor tile.
Throw red or black chinchompas at Kilisa while maintaining Kree'arra as the off-tick target between throws to prevent his melee approach.
Kilisa commonly dies first. Switch to the carried rune crossbow and diamond bolts until the targets overlap again.
When Kree'arra respawns, Geerin can become the alternate overlap target; this is less forgiving and may reduce subsequent blood-spell healing.
Preparation prayer reference: Protect from Missiles while Kree'arra is alive
risks: Chinchompas are costly and targeting errors can let Kree'arra leave the area or use melee.
The bodyguard is the accuracy target; directly throwing at Kree'arra loses the low-defence targeting advantage.

wingman-skree-ancient-healing-and-freezi.name: Ancient Magicks sustain and freezing
wingman-skree-ancient-healing-and-freezi.summary: Blood and ice spells are optional extensions with explicit spell preparation.
guidance: The Armadyl encampment requires 70 Ranged, a crossbow and mith grapple, and the applicable killcount or a valid entry bypass.
Death Plateau and Troll Stronghold progress through Dad are one approach; Ghommal's hilt provides an alternative Trollheim route.
An aviansie task is optional; Kree'arra and all three bodyguards count towards it.
Kree'arra and the bodyguards form one encounter. Ranged protection is central while Kree'arra is alive because his ranged hit reaches 69.
Kree'arra's magic attack rolls against ranged defence. His ranged and magic attacks damage all players, so teams have no single designated tank.
Flight Kilisa uses melee up to 15, Wingman Skree magic up to 16, and Flockleader Geerin ranged up to 25.
After the boss dies, Blood Barrage can heal from stacked Kilisa and Geerin. Blood Blitz is the single-target alternative when Kilisa is dead or nearly dead.

Blood Barrage needs 92 Magic and 4 blood, 4 death and 1 soul rune per cast. Blood Blitz needs 80 Magic and 4 blood plus 2 death runes per cast. Both require Desert Treasure I and Ancient Magicks selected.
Ice Barrage requires 94 Magic with 6 water, 4 death and 2 blood runes per cast and can freeze Kilisa while stacking her with Geerin.

Carry an Ancient-autocasting staff such as a blood ancient sceptre, Kodai wand or eldritch Nightmare staff, plus suitable magic gear. Eldritch specials can restore Prayer; Lightbearer shortens the special-energy recovery wait.
The horn setup can instead use Arceuus Death Charge for special energy; that is a different spellbook preparation and cannot be assumed alongside Ancient Magicks.
risks: A ranged or melee preset does not silently include the level, runes or spellbook for these optional extensions.

wyrms-requirements-and-unlocks.name: Requirements and unlocks
wyrms-requirements-and-unlocks.summary: Prepare 62 Slayer, Karuulm heat protection, Can of Wyrms extension, and alternative-location requirements before routing the task.
guidance: 62 Slayer
Boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots in Karuulm Slayer Dungeon unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete
Bigger and Badder for Shadow Wyrm and Magma strykewyrm superior spawns
Can of Wyrms unlock for extended 200-250 assignments
Partial Perilous Moons progress for Wyrmlings in Neypotzli
60 Sailing and Charred Island access for Lava Strykewyrms
70 Construction for the optional Charred Island bank chest
Wyrms are draconic and vulnerable to dragonbane weapons.
Standard Wyrms use melee and magic in melee range.
Attacking standard Wyrms outside direct melee range causes them to use only Magic.
Protect from Magic negates all damage from standard Wyrms when outside melee range.
Standard Wyrms have flat armour 1 and 50% earth elemental weakness.
Standard Wyrms cannot be cannoned in Karuulm Slayer Dungeon.
Wyrmlings use only melee, can be cannoned in Neypotzli, and cannot spawn Shadow Wyrm.
Lava Strykewyrms use melee and ranged; at distance they use only ranged, so Protect from Missiles is the defensive prayer.
Lava and Magma Strykewyrms have 50% water elemental weakness and cannot be cannoned.
Lava Strykewyrms heal from fire spells.
Magma strykewyrm can burrow to the player's location and hit 20+ if the player does not move.

glory-edgeville.name: Amulet of glory - Edgeville
glory-edgeville.note: Rub in inventory or select Edgeville while equipped. Walk to Krystilia, or enter Edgeville Dungeon for Vannaka. Charged and eternal versions work; uncharged amulets do not. Edgeville bank is a short walk from the arrival point.

glory-draynor.name: Amulet of glory - Draynor Village
glory-draynor.note: Walk to Spria in Draynor Village after arrival. Draynor Village bank is nearby.

games-burthorpe.name: Games necklace - Burthorpe
games-burthorpe.note: Run east to Turael or Aya, south of the general store.

combat-warriors-guild.name: Combat bracelet - Warriors Guild
combat-warriors-guild.note: Continue to Turael or Aya in Burthorpe; entering the Warriors Guild is unnecessary.

passage-wizards-tower.name: Necklace of passage - Wizards Tower
passage-wizards-tower.note: Continue north to Spria in Draynor Village.

passage-outpost.name: Necklace of passage - Outpost
passage-outpost.note: Continue through the Tree Gnome Stronghold gates, then north-west to Nieve or Steve.

slayer-stronghold.name: Slayer ring - Stronghold Slayer Cave
slayer-stronghold.note: Nieve or Steve stands beside the cave. The ring Master dialogue cannot assign a new task; use the teleport and speak in person. The nearby Gnome Stronghold bank requires climbing one set of stairs. Teleport selection uses the ring menu.

slayer-tower.name: Slayer ring - Slayer Tower
slayer-tower.note: Continue south-east to Mazchna or Achtryn in north-eastern Canifis.

slayer-wyrmscraig.name: Slayer ring - Wyrmscraig Cavern
slayer-wyrmscraig.note: Continue through the cavern to Mortimer. This teleport requires the completed quest, beyond the partial quest access needed to receive tasks.

skills-farming-guild.name: Skills necklace - Farming Guild
skills-farming-guild.note: Continue north and climb Mount Karuulm to Konar. Below 45 Farming, arrival is outside the guild; no Farming level is required for this route.

wealth-grand-exchange.name: Ring of wealth - Grand Exchange
wealth-grand-exchange.note: An alternative escape destination. Use Rub in inventory or the equipped teleport option. Grand Exchange bankers are a short walk north. Continue north-west to Edgeville for Krystilia, or use the Edgeville Dungeon entrance for Vannaka.

dueling-ferox.name: Ring of dueling - Ferox Enclave
dueling-ferox.note: Level 20 Wilderness limit. Ferox is a safe enclave; Tele Block prevents entry and teleportation. The bank chest and banker are in the western part of the enclave, near the restoration pools.

royal-seed-pod.name: Royal seed pod
royal-seed-pod.note: Unlimited teleport. Use Commune; walk south-west for Nieve or Steve after returning. Commune is a one-click inventory escape. The Grand Tree bank is upstairs: climb one ladder, then walk to a banker. Arrival is not a safe area on PvP worlds.

grand-seed-pod.name: Grand seed pod
grand-seed-pod.note: Use Squash for the faster indoor-capable escape. Launch requires outdoors. Squash temporarily reduces Farming by 5; one pod is consumed. Squash is a right-click option, not the default Launch action. The Grand Tree bank is upstairs, reached by one ladder after Squash.

ectophial.name: Ectophial
ectophial.note: Only the filled ectophial is usable. It refills automatically after arrival; continue west to Canifis for Mazchna.

lumbridge-tablet.name: Lumbridge teleport (tablet)
lumbridge-tablet.note: Break one tablet; no Magic level or spellbook requirement for using an owned tablet. For banking, enter Lumbridge Castle and climb to the top-floor bank; no Recipe for Disaster cellar access is assumed. Continue west to Draynor Village for Spria.

kharyrll-tablet.name: Kharyrll teleport (tablet)
kharyrll-tablet.note: Break one tablet and continue to Mazchna. No casting Magic level or Ancient spellbook is needed, but Desert Treasure I is required to use the tablet. Canifis bank is beside the arrival pub.

karamja-gloves-duradel.name: Karamja gloves 4
karamja-gloves-duradel.note: Unlimited Slayer Master teleport directly beside Duradel or Kuradal; usable while carried or worn.

karamja-gloves-gem-mine.name: Karamja gloves 3
karamja-gloves-gem-mine.note: Unlimited Gem Mine teleport; climb out, cross the bridge south and continue east to Duradel or Kuradal.

rada-karuulm-unlimited.name: Rada's blessing 4
rada-karuulm-unlimited.note: Unlimited Mount Karuulm teleport beside Konar, usable while carried or worn. Mount Karuulm bank is a short walk from the arrival point.

rada-karuulm-daily.name: Rada's blessing 3
requirements: Mount Karuulm daily teleport charge remains
rada-karuulm-daily.note: Three Mount Karuulm teleports per day; remaining daily uses are not inferred from ownership. Check manually before departure. Mount Karuulm bank is a short walk from the arrival point.

pharaoh-jaleustrophos.name: Pharaoh's sceptre - Jaleustrophos
pharaoh-jaleustrophos.note: Choose Jaleustrophos in the teleport menu. Charged IDs establish at least one use; the total loaded charges are not inferred. Using it from inventory does not require wielding it.

crystal-lletya.name: Teleport crystal - Lletya
crystal-lletya.note: Use the Lletya destination; crystal seeds without charges are excluded. Lletya bank is nearby. Lletya can be configured as the left-click destination; the plugin does not inspect this toggle.

lumbridge-zanaris.name: Lumbridge tablet - walk to Zanaris
lumbridge-zanaris.note: Walk to the Lumbridge Swamp shed and enter Zanaris, then go south to Chaeldar. Pack a dramen or lunar staff and wield it to enter the shed; the chosen staff must be usable with your levels.

astral-contact-turael.name: Astral Contact - Turael
astral-contact-turael.note: Receive the next task remotely on the Lunar spellbook; this does not move the player or provide an escape. Runes are consumed when the contact interface opens.

astral-contact-spria.name: Astral Contact - Spria
astral-contact-spria.note: Receive the next task remotely on the Lunar spellbook; this does not move the player or provide an escape. Runes are consumed when the contact interface opens.

lumbridge-spell.name: Lumbridge Teleport
lumbridge-spell.note: Continue west to Draynor Village for Spria. For banking, enter Lumbridge Castle and climb to the top-floor bank; no Recipe for Disaster cellar access is assumed.

varrock-spell.name: Varrock Teleport
varrock-spell.note: Continue north-west to Edgeville for Krystilia, or enter Edgeville Dungeon for Vannaka. Varrock west bank is available on the onward walk. The Grand Exchange destination requires the Medium Varrock Diary and is a separate route.

falador-spell.name: Falador Teleport
falador-spell.note: Continue north through Taverley to Burthorpe for Turael or Aya. Falador west bank is a short walk from the arrival point.

ardougne-spell.name: Ardougne Teleport
ardougne-spell.note: Requires the Ardougne teleport unlock. This is an escape destination, with any onward journey planned separately. East Ardougne southern bank is available a short walk south of the market.

kharyrll-spell.name: Kharyrll Teleport
kharyrll-spell.note: Continue to Mazchna or Achtryn in north-eastern Canifis. Canifis bank is beside the arrival pub.

battlefront-spell.name: Battlefront Teleport
battlefront-spell.note: Continue north and climb Mount Karuulm to Konar.

lumbridge-zanaris-spell.name: Lumbridge Teleport - Zanaris route
lumbridge-zanaris-spell.note: Walk to the swamp shed and wield a dramen or lunar staff to enter Zanaris; Chaeldar is south of the entrance.

moonclan-spell.name: Moonclan Teleport
moonclan-spell.note: Lunar escape option; retreat to level 20 Wilderness or below before casting. Lunar banking additionally needs a carried seal of passage, Dream Mentor completion for Birds-Eye Jack, or the Elite Fremennik Diary; use the reviewed bank routes for those conditions.

house-tablet.name: Teleport to house (tablet)
house-tablet.note: Break one owned tablet to return home; choose Inside for house facilities. Using the tablet has no Magic level or spellbook requirement. A house does not itself provide a bank.

house-spell.name: Teleport to House
house-spell.note: Cast Teleport to House and choose Inside for house facilities. Requires the Standard spellbook, level 40 Magic and the listed runes. A house does not itself provide a bank.

house-edgeville-tablet.name: House tablet - Edgeville via POH
requirements: POH has an Edgeville teleport (mounted glory or ornate jewellery box)
house-edgeville-tablet.note: Teleport inside your own house, then use its mounted glory or ornate jewellery box to reach Edgeville. The bank is nearby; walk north-east to Krystilia or enter Edgeville Dungeon for Vannaka. Furniture availability needs explicit account confirmation; ownership of a portable glory does not prove it.

house-bank-tablet.name: House tablet - bank via jewellery box
house-bank-tablet.destination: Castle Wars bank via player-owned house
house-bank-tablet.note: Teleport inside your own house, then use the jewellery box Castle Wars option for the nearby bank chest. Any jewellery box tier supports this route; its presence needs explicit account confirmation. No portable ring of dueling or furniture construction level is required to use an existing box.

house-edgeville-spell.name: House spell - Edgeville via POH
requirements: POH has an Edgeville teleport (mounted glory or ornate jewellery box)
house-edgeville-spell.note: Teleport inside your own house, then use its mounted glory or ornate jewellery box to reach Edgeville. The bank is nearby; walk north-east to Krystilia or enter Edgeville Dungeon for Vannaka. Furniture availability needs explicit account confirmation; ownership of a portable glory does not prove it.

house-bank-spell.name: House spell - bank via jewellery box
house-bank-spell.destination: Castle Wars bank via player-owned house
house-bank-spell.note: Teleport inside your own house, then use the jewellery box Castle Wars option for the nearby bank chest. Any jewellery box tier supports this route; its presence needs explicit account confirmation. No portable ring of dueling or furniture construction level is required to use an existing box.

dueling-castle-wars.name: Ring of dueling - Castle Wars
dueling-castle-wars.note: Use Rub in inventory or the equipped Castle Wars option. The bank chest is just a few tiles from arrival. Every listed item ID has at least one teleport charge.

combat-monastery.name: Combat bracelet - Edgeville Monastery
combat-monastery.note: Select Monastery, then walk east to Edgeville for Krystilia or the dungeon entrance for Vannaka. No Prayer level or guild entry is needed; owned charged bracelets work without the recharge quest requirements.

paddewwa-tablet.name: Paddewwa teleport (tablet)
paddewwa-tablet.note: Arrive inside Edgeville Dungeon. Continue through the dungeon to Vannaka, or climb the nearby exit ladder and walk north to Krystilia in Edgeville. Desert Treasure I is required. An owned tablet needs no casting Magic level or Ancient spellbook.

paddewwa-spell.name: Paddewwa Teleport
paddewwa-spell.note: Arrive inside Edgeville Dungeon. Continue through the dungeon to Vannaka, or climb the nearby exit ladder and walk north to Krystilia in Edgeville. Desert Treasure I is required. Casting requires the Ancient spellbook, level 54 Magic, two law runes, one air rune and one fire rune.

varrock-tablet.name: Varrock teleport (tablet)
varrock-tablet.note: Break one owned tablet; using it has no casting Magic level or spellbook requirement. Walk to Varrock west bank, or continue north-west to Edgeville for Krystilia or Vannaka. The Grand Exchange destination needs the Medium Varrock Diary and is a separate route.

falador-tablet.name: Falador teleport (tablet)
falador-tablet.note: Break one owned tablet; using it has no casting Magic level or spellbook requirement. Walk to Falador west bank. For Turael or Aya, continue north through Taverley to Burthorpe.

varrock-grand-exchange-tablet.name: Varrock tablet - Grand Exchange
varrock-grand-exchange-tablet.note: Choose the Grand Exchange destination, unlocked by the Medium Varrock Diary; bankers are nearby. The plugin does not inspect the default Varrock teleport destination. Continue north-west to Edgeville for Krystilia or the dungeon route to Vannaka.

varrock-grand-exchange-spell.name: Varrock spell - Grand Exchange
varrock-grand-exchange-spell.note: Choose the Grand Exchange destination, unlocked by the Medium Varrock Diary; bankers are nearby. The plugin does not inspect the default Varrock teleport destination. Continue north-west to Edgeville for Krystilia or the dungeon route to Vannaka.

moonclan-bank-spell.name: Moonclan Teleport - bank
requirements: Dream Mentor OR Elite Fremennik Diary
moonclan-bank-spell.note: Walk to the nearby Lunar Isle bank. After Dream Mentor, use Birds-Eye Jack; the Elite Fremennik Diary removes the seal requirement for all Lunar bankers. Do not assume that Lunar Diplomacy alone permits banking without a seal.

moonclan-bank-seal-spell.name: Moonclan Teleport - bank with seal of passage
moonclan-bank-seal-spell.note: Carry the seal of passage and walk to the nearby Lunar Isle bank. Holding it in inventory is sufficient; it does not need to replace equipped neckwear.

wildernessEscapeNotes: Most portable teleports work through Wilderness level 20; reviewed dragonstone jewellery, seed pods, Slayer rings and the pharaoh's sceptre work through level 30. Above the item limit, first reach a permitted Wilderness level; carrying an escape item does not make it usable at the current destination.

Tele Block prevents ordinary portable teleports, Wilderness levers and obelisks. Its normal duration is 5 minutes, or 2.5 minutes when Protect from Magic was active as it landed. This trip plan does not verify live Tele Block state or guarantee escape.
Artio, Spindel and Calvar'ion have a 3-tick teleport delay unless the Hard Wilderness Diary is complete. Boss-assignment access does not remove the delay.
In the Revenant Caves, teleporting while in NPC combat has a 2-tick delay that an incoming NPC attack can restart, unless the Hard Wilderness Diary is complete.
A brief PvP teleport lock can follow using a special attack against another player. Return and escape plans are conditional on teleport availability; no live combat timing is inferred.
Ring of life, Defence cape and Escape crystal automatic effects are not guaranteed manual escape substitutes. Chronicle and minigame teleports do not provide Wilderness escape coverage.

Blighted food and restores are used only for a Wilderness combat destination in this ordinary-world planner. Wilderness travel to a non-Wilderness room such as the King Black Dragon lair does not make those supplies usable there.
Blighted teleport spell sacks supply offensive Tele Block or Teleport to Target casts; they do not teleport the carrier to safety.
lootingBagNotes: A looting bag occupies one of the 28 inventory slots and holds up to 28 loot stacks. Its contents are unavailable as food, potions, runes or equipment during the trip; it does not create extra usable supply slots.

Only tradeable items can be deposited in the Wilderness, including Ferox Enclave on an ordinary world. Contents are normally recovered through a bank. Only one looting bag may be possessed; a looting bag note must first be exchanged at a bank.
On a Wilderness PvP death the bag is always lost; the killer receives its contents except food and potions. On a Wilderness PvM death the bag is destroyed and all contents go to the gravestone.

Destroying the bag outside Wilderness on an ordinary world, including Ferox Enclave, destroys all contents. Destroying it in Wilderness drops contents publicly and destroys unnoted cooked food, potions and vials of water.
